summary.en: Saudi Arabia has a special regulation for domestic workers. It gives you a contract, monthly pay, a weekly day off, limits on working hours, and says your employer must not keep your passport.

summary.om: Saudi Arabiyaan hojjettoota manaaf dambii addaa qabdi. Dambiin kun waliigaltee, mindaa ji'aa, guyyaa boqonnaa torbanii fi daangaa sa'aatii hojii isiniif kenna; hojjechiisaan paaspoortii keessan qabachuu akka hin qabnes ibsa.

body.en:
## Your contract

- Your work must follow a contract on the Ministry's official form. [1]
- The contract is in Arabic. It must also be translated into a language you understand. [1]
- It must say your job, your pay, how you are paid, your hours, your day off and how long the contract lasts. [1]
- Your contract is still valid even if it was never written down. You can ask for a written contract at any time. [1]
- There can be a trial period of up to 90 days. During it, either side can end the contract. [1]
- Domestic workers must be at least 21 years old. [1]
- Your employer pays for recruitment, your residence permit (iqama) and work permit. You should not pay these. [1]

**What you can do:** Keep a photo of your contract on your phone and send a copy to someone you trust at home. [1]

## Your pay

- Your pay is the amount written in your contract. We did not find an official minimum wage for domestic workers. [1]
- Your employer must pay you every month, in Saudi riyals, using the payment methods the Ministry sets. [1]
- Employers are expected to pay salaries through the wage protection channels on the Musaned platform. [2]
- Your employer can only take money from your pay in a few cases, like an advance you received. They can never take more than one quarter of your pay. [1]
- If your employer does not pay you for three months, you can ask to move to a new employer without their permission. [2]

**What you can do:** Write down each date you were paid and how much. Keep any receipts or bank messages. This helps if you need to complain. [1]

## Working hours and rest

- You cannot be made to work more than 10 hours a day. [1]
- After 5 hours of work, you must get a break of at least 30 minutes for rest, prayer and food. [1]
- You must get at least 8 hours of rest in a row each day. [1]
- You get one full day off every week (at least 24 hours) with full pay. The day is agreed in your contract. [1]
- If you work on your day off, you must get another day off or extra pay. [1]

## Your passport

- Your employer must not keep your passport, your other papers or your belongings. [1]
- Your employer must let you contact your family, your embassy and the authorities. [1]
- Sadly, many employers still take passports. This is not your fault. [6]

**What you can do:** Keep a photo of your passport and iqama on your phone. If your passport is taken, you can complain to the Ministry on 19911, or contact the Ethiopian embassy. You will find them in the app's help directory. [1] [4]

## Health care

- You have the right to health care under Saudi law. [1]
- If you are sick and have a medical report, you can get up to 30 days of sick leave. The first 15 days are on full pay. The next 15 days are on half pay. [1]
- Your employer cannot end your contract because you are sick before those 30 days are used up. [1]
- Your employer must not give you dangerous work that harms your health or dignity. [1]
- Your employer must give you a safe place to sleep, and food or money for food. [1]
- Physical or verbal attacks and sexual harassment are forbidden. [1]

## Leave, ending your contract and changing employer

**Leave and going home**

- After 2 years, if you both agree to renew your contract, you get 30 days of paid leave. [1]
- After 2 years you also get a return ticket home. If you are leaving for good, you get a one-way ticket. [1]
- When your contract ends, you get an end-of-service payment of one month's pay for every four years worked. [1]
- When your contract ends, your employer must pay everything you are owed within one week. If you end the contract, they have two weeks. [1]

**When you can end your contract and keep your rights**

You can end your contract and keep your rights if your employer: [1]

- breaks the contract or the regulation;
- lied to you about the job;
- is violent with you, or a family member is;
- gives you dangerous work;
- rents you out to other people.

**Moving to a new employer without permission**

The Ministry can move you to a new employer without your current employer's agreement in some cases. These include: [2]

- three months of unpaid wages;
- no residence permit (iqama), or it was not renewed;
- being rented out to others;
- dangerous work;
- proven bad treatment by the employer or the family;
- your employer delaying your complaint, or not coming to the committee twice;
- your employer ending the contract during the trial period.

**Absence reports ("huroob")**

- If you leave the house, your employer can file an "absence from work" report. [2] [3]
- After the report you have 60 days. In that time you must move to a new employer or leave the country. If you do neither, you are treated as breaking residency law. [3]
- If you arrived less than two years ago, you must leave the country within those 60 days. [3]

**What you can do:** If you can, complain to the Ministry (19911) or your embassy before you leave the house. A complaint on record helps protect you. But if you are in danger, your safety comes first. Use the SOS button or call 911. [1] [3]

## Where to complain

- **Ministry of Human Resources (MHRSD):** call 19911. It deals with complaints from domestic workers and employers. Ask for an Amharic speaker. [1] [4] [6]
- **Musaned:** your contract, salary and transfer requests are handled on this platform. [2]
- **Human Rights Commission:** call 19922, or file a complaint online. Complaints are kept confidential. [5]
- **Ethiopian embassy (Riyadh) or consulate (Jeddah):** see the help directory.
- After your contract ends, you have 12 months to take a claim to court. [1]

**What you can do:** Before you call, write down your full name, iqama number, employer's name and phone number, and what happened with dates.

## Emergency numbers

- **911:** unified emergency number [7]
- **999:** police [7]
- **997:** ambulance [7]
- **998:** Civil Defense (fire) [7]

If you are in danger, press the SOS button in the app. Your trusted contacts will be alerted. The help directory has more numbers.
body.am:
## የሥራ ውልዎ

- ሥራዎ በሚኒስቴሩ ይፋዊ የውል ቅጽ መሠረት መሆን አለበት። [1]
- ውሉ በዓረብኛ ነው። በሚገባዎት ቋንቋም መተርጎም አለበት። [1]
- ውሉ ሥራዎን፣ ደመወዝዎን፣ እንዴት እንደሚከፈልዎ፣ የሥራ ሰዓትዎን፣ የእረፍት ቀንዎን እና ውሉ ምን ያህል ጊዜ እንደሚቆይ መግለጽ አለበት። [1]
- ውልዎ በጽሑፍ ባይጻፍም እንኳ የጸና ነው። በማንኛውም ጊዜ የጽሑፍ ውል መጠየቅ ይችላሉ። [1]
- እስከ 90 ቀን የሚደርስ የሙከራ ጊዜ ሊኖር ይችላል። በዚህ ጊዜ ማንኛውም ወገን ውሉን ማቋረጥ ይችላል። [1]
- የቤት ሠራተኞች ቢያንስ 21 ዓመት መሆን አለባቸው። [1]
- የቅጥር ወጪን፣ የመኖሪያ ፈቃድ (ኢቃማ) እና የሥራ ፈቃድ ክፍያን የሚከፍለው አሠሪዎ ነው። እርስዎ እነዚህን መክፈል የለብዎትም። [1]

**ማድረግ የሚችሉት:** የውልዎን ፎቶ በስልክዎ ያስቀምጡ፤ ቅጂውንም በሀገር ቤት ለሚያምኑት ሰው ይላኩ። [1]

## ደመወዝዎ

- ደመወዝዎ በውልዎ ላይ የተጻፈው መጠን ነው። ለቤት ሠራተኞች ይፋዊ ዝቅተኛ ደመወዝ አላገኘንም። [1]
- አሠሪዎ በየወሩ፣ በሳዑዲ ሪያል፣ ሚኒስቴሩ በሚወስናቸው የክፍያ መንገዶች መክፈል አለበት። [1]
- አሠሪዎች ደመወዝን በሙሳነድ (Musaned) መድረክ ላይ ባሉት የደመወዝ ጥበቃ መንገዶች እንዲከፍሉ ይጠበቃል። [2]
- አሠሪዎ ከደመወዝዎ ገንዘብ መቀነስ የሚችለው በጥቂት ሁኔታዎች ብቻ ነው፤ ለምሳሌ የተቀበሉት ቅድሚያ ክፍያ ካለ። ከደመወዝዎ ከአንድ አራተኛ በላይ በፍጹም መቀነስ አይችሉም። [1]
- አሠሪዎ ለሦስት ወር ካልከፈለዎት፣ ያለ እሱ ፈቃድ ወደ አዲስ አሠሪ ለመዛወር መጠየቅ ይችላሉ። [2]

**ማድረግ የሚችሉት:** የተከፈለዎትን እያንዳንዱን ቀንና መጠን ይጻፉ። ደረሰኞችን ወይም የባንክ መልዕክቶችን ያስቀምጡ። ቅሬታ ማቅረብ ቢያስፈልግዎ ይረዳዎታል። [1]

## የሥራ ሰዓትና እረፍት

- በቀን ከ10 ሰዓት በላይ እንዲሠሩ ሊገደዱ አይችሉም። [1]
- ከ5 ሰዓት ሥራ በኋላ ለእረፍት፣ ለጸሎትና ለምግብ ቢያንስ የ30 ደቂቃ እረፍት ማግኘት አለብዎት። [1]
- በየቀኑ ቢያንስ 8 ተከታታይ ሰዓት እረፍት ማግኘት አለብዎት። [1]
- በየሳምንቱ ሙሉ ደመወዝ ያለው አንድ ሙሉ የእረፍት ቀን (ቢያንስ 24 ሰዓት) ያገኛሉ። ቀኑ በውልዎ ላይ ይስማማል። [1]
- በእረፍት ቀንዎ ከሠሩ፣ ሌላ የእረፍት ቀን ወይም ተጨማሪ ክፍያ ማግኘት አለብዎት። [1]

## ፓስፖርትዎ

- አሠሪዎ ፓስፖርትዎን፣ ሌሎች ሰነዶችዎን ወይም ንብረቶችዎን መያዝ የለበትም። [1]
- አሠሪዎ ቤተሰብዎን፣ ኤምባሲዎንና የሚመለከታቸውን ባለሥልጣናት እንዲያገኙ መፍቀድ አለበት። [1]
- የሚያሳዝነው ብዙ አሠሪዎች አሁንም ፓስፖርት ይይዛሉ። ይህ የእርስዎ ጥፋት አይደለም። [6]

**ማድረግ የሚችሉት:** የፓስፖርትዎንና የኢቃማዎን ፎቶ በስልክዎ ያስቀምጡ። ፓስፖርትዎ ከተወሰደ በ19911 ለሚኒስቴሩ ቅሬታ ማቅረብ ወይም የኢትዮጵያ ኤምባሲን ማግኘት ይችላሉ። ቁጥሮቹን በመተግበሪያው የእርዳታ ማውጫ ውስጥ ያገኛሉ። [1] [4]

## የጤና እንክብካቤ

- በሳዑዲ ሕግ መሠረት የጤና እንክብካቤ የማግኘት መብት አለዎት። [1]
- ከታመሙና የሕክምና ማስረጃ ካለዎት፣ እስከ 30 ቀን የሕመም ፈቃድ ማግኘት ይችላሉ። የመጀመሪያዎቹ 15 ቀናት በሙሉ ደመወዝ ናቸው። ቀጣዮቹ 15 ቀናት በግማሽ ደመወዝ ናቸው። [1]
- እነዚያ 30 ቀናት ሳያልቁ አሠሪዎ በመታመምዎ ምክንያት ውልዎን ማቋረጥ አይችልም። [1]
- አሠሪዎ ጤናዎን ወይም ክብርዎን የሚጎዳ አደገኛ ሥራ ሊሰጥዎ አይገባም። [1]
- አሠሪዎ ደህንነቱ የተጠበቀ የመኝታ ቦታ እና ምግብ ወይም የምግብ ገንዘብ መስጠት አለበት። [1]
- አካላዊ ወይም የቃል ጥቃት እና ጾታዊ ትንኮሳ የተከለከሉ ናቸው። [1]

## ፈቃድ፣ ውል ማቋረጥ እና አሠሪ መቀየር

**ፈቃድና ወደ ሀገር መመለስ**

- ከ2 ዓመት በኋላ ሁለታችሁም ውሉን ለማደስ ከተስማማችሁ፣ ደመወዝ ያለው የ30 ቀን ፈቃድ ያገኛሉ። [1]
- ከ2 ዓመት በኋላ ወደ ሀገርዎ የደርሶ መልስ ትኬት ያገኛሉ። ለመጨረሻ ጊዜ የሚሄዱ ከሆነ የአንድ መንገድ ትኬት ያገኛሉ። [1]
- ውልዎ ሲያልቅ ለእያንዳንዱ አራት ዓመት ሥራ የአንድ ወር ደመወዝ የአገልግሎት ማብቂያ ክፍያ ያገኛሉ። [1]
- ውልዎ ሲያልቅ አሠሪዎ ያለብዎትን ሁሉ በአንድ ሳምንት ውስጥ መክፈል አለበት። ውሉን ያቋረጡት እርስዎ ከሆኑ ሁለት ሳምንት አለው። [1]

**ውልዎን አቋርጠው መብትዎን የሚጠብቁበት ጊዜ**

አሠሪዎ የሚከተሉትን ካደረገ ውልዎን አቋርጠው መብትዎን መጠበቅ ይችላሉ፦ [1]

- ውሉን ወይም ደንቡን ከጣሰ፤
- ስለ ሥራው ዋሽቶዎት ከሆነ፤
- እሱ ወይም የቤተሰቡ አባል ጥቃት ካደረሰብዎት፤
- አደገኛ ሥራ ከሰጠዎት፤
- ለሌሎች ሰዎች ካከራየዎት።

**ያለ ፈቃድ ወደ አዲስ አሠሪ መዛወር**

በአንዳንድ ሁኔታዎች ሚኒስቴሩ የአሁኑ አሠሪዎ ሳይስማማ ወደ አዲስ አሠሪ ሊያዛውርዎት ይችላል። እነዚህም፦ [2]

- ለሦስት ወር ያልተከፈለ ደመወዝ፤
- የመኖሪያ ፈቃድ (ኢቃማ) አለመኖር ወይም አለመታደስ፤
- ለሌሎች መከራየት፤
- አደገኛ ሥራ፤
- በአሠሪው ወይም በቤተሰቡ የተረጋገጠ መጥፎ አያያዝ፤
- አሠሪዎ ቅሬታዎን ሲያዘገይ ወይም ለኮሚቴው ሁለት ጊዜ ሳይቀርብ ሲቀር፤
- አሠሪዎ በሙከራ ጊዜ ውሉን ሲያቋርጥ።

**የመጥፋት (ሁሩብ) ሪፖርት**

- ቤቱን ለቀው ከወጡ፣ አሠሪዎ "ከሥራ መቅረት" ሪፖርት ሊያቀርብ ይችላል። [2] [3]
- ከሪፖርቱ በኋላ 60 ቀን አለዎት። በዚያ ጊዜ ውስጥ ወደ አዲስ አሠሪ መዛወር ወይም ሀገሩን መልቀቅ አለብዎት። ሁለቱንም ካላደረጉ የመኖሪያ ሕግን እንደጣሱ ይቆጠራሉ። [3]
- የመጡት ከሁለት ዓመት በታች ከሆነ፣ በእነዚያ 60 ቀናት ውስጥ ሀገሩን መልቀቅ አለብዎት። [3]

**ማድረግ የሚችሉት:** ከቻሉ ቤቱን ከመልቀቅዎ በፊት ለሚኒስቴሩ (19911) ወይም ለኤምባሲዎ ቅሬታ ያቅርቡ። የተመዘገበ ቅሬታ ይጠብቅዎታል። ነገር ግን አደጋ ላይ ከሆኑ ደህንነትዎ ይቀድማል። የSOS ቁልፉን ይጫኑ ወይም 911 ይደውሉ። [1] [3]

## ቅሬታ የት እንደሚያቀርቡ

- **የሰው ሀብት ሚኒስቴር (MHRSD):** 19911 ይደውሉ። ከቤት ሠራተኞችና ከአሠሪዎች የሚቀርቡ ቅሬታዎችን ይመለከታል። አማርኛ ተናጋሪ ይጠይቁ። [1] [4] [6]
- **ሙሳነድ (Musaned):** ውልዎ፣ ደመወዝዎና የዝውውር ጥያቄዎች በዚህ መድረክ ይስተናገዳሉ። [2]
- **የሰብአዊ መብቶች ኮሚሽን:** 19922 ይደውሉ ወይም በኦንላይን ቅሬታ ያቅርቡ። ቅሬታዎች በሚስጥር ይያዛሉ። [5]
- **የኢትዮጵያ ኤምባሲ (ሪያድ) ወይም ቆንስላ (ጅዳ):** የእርዳታ ማውጫውን ይመልከቱ።
- ውልዎ ካለቀ በኋላ ክስ ወደ ፍርድ ቤት ለማቅረብ 12 ወር አለዎት። [1]

**ማድረግ የሚችሉት:** ከመደወልዎ በፊት ሙሉ ስምዎን፣ የኢቃማ ቁጥርዎን፣ የአሠሪዎን ስምና ስልክ ቁጥር እንዲሁም የሆነውን ነገር ከቀኑ ጋር ይጻፉ።

## የአስቸኳይ ጊዜ ስልክ ቁጥሮች

- **911:** የተዋሃደ የአስቸኳይ ጊዜ ቁጥር [7]
- **999:** ፖሊስ [7]
- **997:** አምቡላንስ [7]
- **998:** ሲቪል መከላከያ (እሳት) [7]

አደጋ ላይ ከሆኑ በመተግበሪያው ውስጥ ያለውን የSOS ቁልፍ ይጫኑ። የሚያምኗቸው ሰዎች መልዕክት ይደርሳቸዋል። የእርዳታ ማውጫው ተጨማሪ ቁጥሮች አሉት።
body.om:
## Waliigaltee hojii keessan

- Hojiin keessan unka waliigaltee seeraa Ministeerichaa irratti hundaa'uu qaba. [1]
- Waliigalteen Afaan Arabaatiin barreeffama. Afaan isin hubattanittis hiikamuu qaba. [1]
- Waliigalteen hojii keessan, mindaa keessan, akkamitti akka isiniif kaffalamu, sa'aatii hojii, guyyaa boqonnaa fi yeroo waliigalteen turu ibsuu qaba. [1]
- Waliigalteen keessan yoo barreeffamaan hin jirre illee seera qabeessa. Yeroo kamiyyuu waliigaltee barreeffamaa gaafachuu dandeessu. [1]
- Yeroon yaalii hanga guyyaa 90 ta'uu danda'a. Yeroo kana keessa gareen kamiyyuu waliigaltee addaan kutuu danda'a. [1]
- Hojjettoonni manaa yoo xiqqaate umurii waggaa 21 ta'uu qabu. [1]
- Baasii qacarrii, hayyama jireenyaa (iqaamaa) fi hayyama hojii kan kaffalu hojjechiisaa keessan. Isin kana kaffaluu hin qabdan. [1]

**Wanti isin gochuu dandeessan:** Suuraa waliigaltee keessanii bilbila keessan irratti kuusaa. Garagalchaa isaas nama biyya keessatti amantaniif ergaa. [1]

## Mindaa keessan

- Mindaan keessan hanga waliigaltee keessan irratti barreeffame. Mindaa xiqqaa seeraa hojjettoota manaaf murtaa'e hin arganne. [1]
- Hojjechiisaan keessan ji'a ji'aan, qarshii Riyaala Saudiitiin, karaa kaffaltii Ministeerichi murteesseen kaffaluu qaba. [1]
- Hojjechiisaan mindaa karaa eegumsa mindaa waltajjii Musaned irra jiruun akka kaffalu eegama. [2]
- Hojjechiisaan mindaa keessan irraa kan hir'isuu danda'u haala muraasa qofa keessatti; fakkeenyaaf, kaffaltii dursaa yoo fudhattan. Kurmaana mindaa keessanii ol gonkumaa hir'isuu hin danda'u. [1]
- Hojjechiisaan ji'a sadiif yoo isiniif hin kaffalle, hayyama isaa malee gara hojjechiisaa haaraatti ce'uu gaafachuu dandeessu. [2]

**Wanti isin gochuu dandeessan:** Guyyaa fi hanga isiniif kaffalame hunda barreessaa. Nagahee ykn ergaa baankii kuusaa. Komii dhiyeessuuf yoo barbaachise isin gargaara. [1]

## Sa'aatii hojii fi boqonnaa

- Guyyaatti sa'aatii 10 ol akka hojjettan dirqamsiifamuu hin dandeessan. [1]
- Sa'aatii 5 hojjechuun booda, boqonnaa, kadhannaa fi nyaataaf yoo xiqqaate daqiiqaa 30 boqochuu qabdu. [1]
- Guyyaa guyyaan yoo xiqqaate sa'aatii 8 walitti aansee boqochuu qabdu. [1]
- Torbanitti guyyaa boqonnaa guutuu tokko (yoo xiqqaate sa'aatii 24) mindaa guutuun argattu. Guyyaan kun waliigaltee keessan keessatti murtaa'a. [1]
- Guyyaa boqonnaa keessan yoo hojjettan, guyyaa boqonnaa biraa ykn kaffaltii dabalataa argachuu qabdu. [1]

## Paaspoortii keessan

- Hojjechiisaan keessan paaspoortii keessan, sanadoota biroo ykn meeshaalee keessan qabachuu hin qabu. [1]
- Hojjechiisaan keessan maatii keessan, embaasii keessanii fi qaamolee mootummaa akka quunnamtan hayyamuu qaba. [1]
- Akka carraa ta'ee, hojjechiisonni hedduun ammas paaspoortii ni qabatu. Kun dogoggora keessan miti. [6]

**Wanti isin gochuu dandeessan:** Suuraa paaspoortii fi iqaamaa keessanii bilbila keessan irratti kuusaa. Paaspoortiin keessan yoo fudhatame, 19911 irratti Ministeerichatti komii dhiyeessuu ykn Embaasii Itoophiyaa quunnamuu dandeessu. Lakkoofsota isaanii galmee gargaarsaa appichaa keessatti argattu. [1] [4]

## Kunuunsa fayyaa

- Akka seera Saudiitti kunuunsa fayyaa argachuuf mirga qabdu. [1]
- Yoo dhukkubsattanii ragaa yaalaa qabaattan, hanga guyyaa 30 boqonnaa dhukkubaa argachuu dandeessu. Guyyoonni 15 jalqabaa mindaa guutuudhaan. Guyyoonni 15 itti aanan walakkaa mindaatiin. [1]
- Guyyoonni 30 sun osoo hin xumuramin, hojjechiisaan dhukkubsachuu keessaniif jecha waliigaltee keessan addaan kutuu hin danda'u. [1]
- Hojjechiisaan hojii balaafamaa fayyaa ykn ulfina keessan miidhu isinitti kennuu hin qabu. [1]
- Hojjechiisaan iddoo rafuu nageenya qabu, akkasumas nyaata ykn maallaqa nyaataa kennuu qaba. [1]
- Miidhaan qaamaa ykn jechaa fi dararaan saalaa dhorkaa dha. [1]

## Boqonnaa, waliigaltee xumuruu fi hojjechiisaa jijjiiruu

**Boqonnaa fi gara biyyaatti deebi'uu**

- Waggaa 2 booda, lamaan keessan waliigaltee haaromsuuf yoo walii galtan, boqonnaa guyyaa 30 mindaa qabu argattu. [1]
- Waggaa 2 booda tikeetii deemsaa fi deebii gara biyya keessaniitti argattu. Yoo dhumaaf deemtan tikeetii karaa tokkoo argattu. [1]
- Waliigalteen keessan yommuu xumuramu, waggaa afur hojjettan hundaaf mindaa ji'a tokkoo kaffaltii xumura tajaajilaa argattu. [1]
- Waliigalteen yommuu xumuramu, hojjechiisaan wanta isiniif ta'u hunda torban tokko keessatti kaffaluu qaba. Yoo isin waliigaltee addaan kuttan, torban lama qaba. [1]

**Yeroo waliigaltee addaan kuttanii mirga keessan eegattan**

Hojjechiisaan keessan kanneen armaan gadii yoo raawwate, waliigaltee addaan kuttanii mirga keessan eegachuu dandeessu: [1]

- waliigaltee ykn dambii yoo cabse;
- waa'ee hojichaa yoo isin sobe;
- inni ykn miseensi maatii isaa yoo isin miidhe;
- hojii balaafamaa yoo isinitti kenne;
- namoota biraatti yoo isin kireesse.

**Hayyama malee gara hojjechiisaa haaraatti ce'uu**

Haala tokko tokko keessatti, Ministeerichi hojjechiisaan keessan osoo hin waliigalin gara hojjechiisaa haaraatti isin ce'uu danda'a. Kanneen keessaa: [2]

- mindaa ji'a sadii hin kaffalamne;
- hayyama jireenyaa (iqaamaa) dhabuu ykn haaromsamuu dhabuu;
- namoota biraatti kireeffamuu;
- hojii balaafamaa;
- haala gadhee hojjechiisaa ykn maatii isaatiin raawwatame kan mirkanaa'e;
- hojjechiisaan komii keessan yoo harkisu, ykn koreetti al lama yoo hin dhiyaatin;
- hojjechiisaan yeroo yaalii keessatti waliigaltee yoo addaan kute.

**Gabaasa baduu ("huruub")**

- Mana sana yoo dhiiftanii baatan, hojjechiisaan keessan gabaasa "hojii irraa hafuu" galchuu danda'a. [2] [3]
- Gabaasa sana booda guyyaa 60 qabdu. Yeroo kana keessatti gara hojjechiisaa haaraatti ce'uu ykn biyya keessaa ba'uu qabdu. Lamaan isaanii yoo hin raawwatin, akka seera jireenyaa cabsitanitti lakkaa'amtu. [3]
- Yoo erga dhuftanii waggaa lama hin guutin, guyyoota 60 sana keessatti biyya keessaa ba'uu qabdu. [3]

**Wanti isin gochuu dandeessan:** Yoo dandeessan, mana sana dhiisuu keessan dura Ministeerichatti (19911) ykn embaasii keessanitti komii dhiyeessaa. Komiin galmeeffame isin eega. Garuu balaa keessa yoo jirtan, nageenyi keessan dursa. Qabduu SOS tuqaa ykn 911 bilbilaa. [1] [3]

## Eessatti komii dhiyeessuu

- **Ministeera Qabeenya Namaa (MHRSD):** 19911 bilbilaa. Komii hojjettoota manaa fi hojjechiisotaa ilaala. Nama Afaan Amaaraa dubbatu gaafadhaa. [1] [4] [6]
- **Musaned:** waliigalteen, mindaan fi gaaffiin jijjiirraa keessan waltajjii kana irratti raawwatama. [2]
- **Komishinii Mirgoota Namoomaa:** 19922 bilbilaa ykn toora interneetiin komii dhiyeessaa. Komiiwwan iccitiin qabamu. [5]
- **Embaasii Itoophiyaa (Riyaad) ykn qonsilaa (Jiddaa):** galmee gargaarsaa ilaalaa.
- Erga waliigalteen keessan xumuramee booda, himata mana murtiitti dhiyeessuuf ji'a 12 qabdu. [1]

**Wanti isin gochuu dandeessan:** Osoo hin bilbilin dura, maqaa guutuu keessan, lakkoofsa iqaamaa keessan, maqaa fi lakkoofsa bilbilaa hojjechiisaa keessanii, akkasumas wanta ta'e guyyaa isaa wajjin barreessaa.

## Lakkoofsota bilbilaa ariifachiisaa

- **911:** lakkoofsa ariifachiisaa tokkoomfame [7]
- **999:** poolisii [7]
- **997:** ambulaansii [7]
- **998:** Ittisa Siivilii (ibidda) [7]

Balaa keessa yoo jirtan, appicha keessatti qabduu SOS tuqaa. Namoonni isin amantan ni beeksifamu. Galmeen gargaarsaa lakkoofsota dabalataa qaba.

title.en: Your rights as a domestic worker in the United Arab Emirates
title.am: በተባበሩት ዓረብ ኤሚሬቶች እንደ ቤት ሠራተኛ ያለዎት መብቶች
title.om: Mirgoota keessan akka hojjettuu manaatti Imireetota Arabaa Tokkoomanii keessatti

summary.en: A UAE law protects domestic workers. You have the right to a written contract, pay on time, rest every day and every week, and to keep your own passport.
summary.am: የUAE ሕግ የቤት ሠራተኞችን ይጠብቃል። የጽሑፍ ውል፣ በሰዓቱ የሚከፈል ደመወዝ፣ የዕለትና የሳምንት እረፍት እንዲሁም የራስዎን ፓስፖርት የመያዝ መብት አለዎት።
summary.om: Seerri UAE hojjettoota manaa ni eega. Waliigaltee barreeffamaa, mindaa yeroon kaffalamu, boqonnaa guyyaa fi torbanii, akkasumas paaspoortii ofii qabachuuf mirga qabdu.

body.en:
## Your contract

Your employer must sign a work contract with you. It must use the form approved by the Ministry of Human Resources and Emiratisation (MOHRE). Your employer must give you a copy [2].

The contract must show the type of work, where you work, your wage, how you are paid, your leave, your rest periods, and when the contract can end [1][2]. The contract lasts two years and can be renewed [2]. A probation (trial) period can last up to six months [2].

The law says contracts must be in Arabic and also in a language you understand. If the two versions are different, the Arabic text wins [2].

Your employer may not make you do a different kind of job without your agreement. Your employer may not make you work for other people, except under the ministry's rules [2].

The law bans work by anyone under 18, sexual harassment, forced labour and human trafficking [1][2].

**What you can do:** Keep a photo of your contract on your phone and in a safe place. If you never got a copy, ask MOHRE [1][2].

## Your pay

Your wage is the amount written in your contract. We did not find an official minimum wage for domestic workers in the UAE [1].

Your employer must pay you every month, in UAE dirhams, no later than 10 days after the pay date. Payment should be shown by a written receipt or another way MOHRE accepts [2].

Your employer and the recruitment agency may not take money from you to get or keep the job [1][2]. Your employer must give you a place to live, food and work clothes if you work full time [2].

Your employer can only take money from your pay in a few cases set by law. For example, if you badly damage their property, they need your agreement or MOHRE's approval, and it cannot be more than a quarter of your wage [2].

**What you can do:** Write down each payment: date and amount. Take a photo of any receipt. If your pay is late or missing, you can complain to MOHRE [2][3].

## Working hours and rest

You have the right to:

- At least 12 hours of rest every day. At least 8 of those hours must be in a row [1][2].
- One paid day off every week. If you work on your day off, you must get another day off or one extra day's pay [2].
- At least 30 days of paid holiday every year [1][2].
- A return ticket home every two years for your holiday, paid by your employer [1][2].

**What you can do:** Keep a simple note of the hours you work and your days off. It can help if you need to complain later.

## Your passport

Your passport and ID card belong to you. The law says your employer must respect your right to keep your own identity documents [1][2].

**What you can do:** Keep a photo of your passport, visa and Emirates ID on your phone. If your employer or agency takes your passport and will not give it back, you can complain to MOHRE and contact your embassy or consulate. See the help directory [2][4].

## Health care

Your employer must pay for your medical treatment, or give you health insurance, under UAE health rules [2].

You can take up to 30 days of sick leave a year with a medical report from an approved health authority. The first 15 days are fully paid. The next 15 days are half paid [2].

If you are hurt at work, your employer must pay compensation [2].

**What you can do:** If you are very sick or badly hurt, call 998 for an ambulance. Ask the doctor for a written medical report and keep a copy [2][7].

## Leave, ending your contract and changing employer

The contract can end when its time is over, or earlier if you and your employer both agree [2].

If your employer breaks the law, for example by not paying you or by treating you badly, you can end the contract [2]. If your employer ends the contract for a reason that is not your fault, they must pay for your ticket home and pay what they owe you [2]. When a contract ends, your employer must pay all your money within 10 days [2]. Unused holiday must be paid in cash [2].

You may move to a new employer if you follow the contract and MOHRE's rules [2].

**Leaving the house without telling anyone can be risky.** Your employer can file an "absence from work" (absconding) report with MOHRE if you are gone for more than seven days and they cannot reach you [5]. The law says that if you leave work without your employer knowing, you must tell MOHRE within two days [2]. This is not your fault. It is a way to protect yourself.

**What you can do:** If you need to leave, try to contact MOHRE or your embassy first, or within two days. Tell them why you left. If you are in danger, call 999 first [2][7].

## Where to complain

You can make a labour complaint to MOHRE. MOHRE tries to solve it with both sides within two weeks. If that fails, it sends the case to court with its advice [1][2].

Workers do not pay court fees, and courts must deal with these cases quickly [1][2]. But claims must be made within three months after the job ends [1][2]. Do not wait too long.

How to reach MOHRE [3][4]:

- Call centre: 600 590000 (24 hours). From outside the UAE: +971 6 803 4000.
- Email: ask@mohre.gov.ae
- The MOHRE app or a service centre.

To report human trafficking or violence [6]:

- Ewaa shelters hotline: 800 SAVE (800 7283).
- Dubai Foundation for Women and Children: 800111.
- Dubai Police human trafficking centre: +971 4 608 2347.
- Ministry of Interior hotline for violence against women and children: 116111.

Your embassy in Abu Dhabi or consulate in Dubai can also help. Their numbers are in the help directory.

## Emergency numbers

- Police: 999 [7]
- Ambulance: 998 [7]
- Fire: 997 [7]

If you are in danger, press the SOS button in the app or call 999. You can find more numbers in the help directory.

## የሥራ ውልዎ

አሠሪዎ ከእርስዎ ጋር የሥራ ውል መፈረም አለበት። ውሉ የሰው ሀብትና ኤሚሬታይዜሽን ሚኒስቴር (MOHRE) ያጸደቀውን ቅጽ መጠቀም አለበት። አሠሪዎ የውሉን ቅጂ ለእርስዎ መስጠት አለበት [2]።

ውሉ የሥራውን ዓይነት፣ የሥራ ቦታውን፣ ደመወዝዎን፣ ክፍያው እንዴት እንደሚፈጸም፣ ፈቃድዎን፣ የእረፍት ጊዜዎን እና ውሉ መቼ ሊያበቃ እንደሚችል ማሳየት አለበት [1][2]። ውሉ ለሁለት ዓመት ይቆያል፤ ሊታደስም ይችላል [2]። የሙከራ ጊዜ እስከ ስድስት ወር ሊሆን ይችላል [2]።

ሕጉ ውሎች በዓረብኛ እና እርስዎ በሚረዱት ቋንቋ መሆን አለባቸው ይላል። ሁለቱ የተለያዩ ከሆኑ የዓረብኛው ጽሑፍ ያሸንፋል [2]።

አሠሪዎ ያለ እርስዎ ፈቃድ የተለየ ዓይነት ሥራ ሊያሠራዎ አይችልም። በሚኒስቴሩ ደንብ ካልሆነ በስተቀር ለሌሎች ሰዎች ሊያሠራዎ አይችልም [2]።

ሕጉ ከ18 ዓመት በታች የሆኑትን ማሠራትን፣ ጾታዊ ትንኮሳን፣ የግዳጅ ሥራን እና የሰዎች ዝውውርን ይከለክላል [1][2]።

**ማድረግ የሚችሉት፦** የውልዎን ፎቶ በስልክዎ እና በአስተማማኝ ቦታ ያስቀምጡ። ቅጂ ካልተሰጠዎት MOHREን ይጠይቁ [1][2]።

## ደመወዝዎ

ደመወዝዎ በውልዎ ላይ የተጻፈው መጠን ነው። በUAE ለቤት ሠራተኞች ይፋዊ ዝቅተኛ ደመወዝ አላገኘንም [1]።

አሠሪዎ በየወሩ፣ በUAE ድርሃም፣ የክፍያ ቀኑ ካለፈ ከ10 ቀን ሳይዘገይ መክፈል አለበት። ክፍያው በጽሑፍ ደረሰኝ ወይም MOHRE በሚቀበለው ሌላ መንገድ መረጋገጥ አለበት [2]።

አሠሪዎም ሆነ የቅጥር ኤጀንሲው ሥራውን ለማግኘት ወይም ለማቆየት ከእርስዎ ገንዘብ መውሰድ አይችሉም [1][2]። ሙሉ ጊዜ የሚሠሩ ከሆነ አሠሪዎ የመኖሪያ ቦታ፣ ምግብ እና የሥራ ልብስ መስጠት አለበት [2]።

አሠሪዎ ከደመወዝዎ ገንዘብ መቀነስ የሚችለው ሕጉ በሚፈቅዳቸው ጥቂት ሁኔታዎች ብቻ ነው። ለምሳሌ ንብረታቸውን በከባድ ሁኔታ ካበላሹ፣ የእርስዎ ስምምነት ወይም የMOHRE ፈቃድ ያስፈልጋቸዋል፤ ከደመወዝዎ ሩብ መብለጥም አይችልም [2]።

**ማድረግ የሚችሉት፦** እያንዳንዱን ክፍያ ይጻፉ፦ ቀን እና መጠን። የደረሰኝ ፎቶ ያንሱ። ደመወዝዎ ከዘገየ ወይም ካልተከፈለ ለMOHRE ቅሬታ ማቅረብ ይችላሉ [2][3]።

## የሥራ ሰዓትና እረፍት

የሚከተሉት መብቶች አሉዎት፦

- በየቀኑ ቢያንስ 12 ሰዓት እረፍት። ከእነዚህም ቢያንስ 8 ሰዓቱ ተከታታይ መሆን አለበት [1][2]።
- በየሳምንቱ አንድ የሚከፈልበት የእረፍት ቀን። በእረፍት ቀንዎ ከሠሩ ሌላ የእረፍት ቀን ወይም የአንድ ቀን ተጨማሪ ክፍያ ማግኘት አለብዎት [2]።
- በየዓመቱ ቢያንስ 30 ቀን የሚከፈልበት የዓመት ፈቃድ [1][2]።
- በየሁለት ዓመቱ ለፈቃድ ወደ ሀገር ቤት የደርሶ መልስ ትኬት፣ በአሠሪዎ የሚከፈል [1][2]።

**ማድረግ የሚችሉት፦** የሠሩበትን ሰዓት እና የእረፍት ቀናትዎን በቀላሉ ይጻፉ። በኋላ ቅሬታ ማቅረብ ቢያስፈልግዎ ይረዳዎታል።

## ፓስፖርትዎ

ፓስፖርትዎ እና መታወቂያዎ የእርስዎ ናቸው። ሕጉ አሠሪዎ የራስዎን የመታወቂያ ሰነዶች የመያዝ መብትዎን ማክበር አለበት ይላል [1][2]።

**ማድረግ የሚችሉት፦** የፓስፖርትዎን፣ የቪዛዎን እና የኤሚሬትስ መታወቂያዎን ፎቶ በስልክዎ ያስቀምጡ። አሠሪዎ ወይም ኤጀንሲው ፓስፖርትዎን ወስዶ ካልመለሰ ለMOHRE ቅሬታ ማቅረብ እና ኤምባሲዎን ወይም ቆንስላዎን ማነጋገር ይችላሉ። የእርዳታ ማውጫውን ይመልከቱ [2][4]።

## የጤና እንክብካቤ

አሠሪዎ በUAE የጤና ደንብ መሠረት የሕክምና ወጪዎን መክፈል ወይም የጤና መድን መስጠት አለበት [2]።

ከተፈቀደ የጤና ተቋም የሕክምና ማስረጃ ካለዎት በዓመት እስከ 30 ቀን የሕመም ፈቃድ መውሰድ ይችላሉ። የመጀመሪያዎቹ 15 ቀናት ሙሉ ክፍያ አላቸው። ቀጣዮቹ 15 ቀናት ግማሽ ክፍያ አላቸው [2]።

በሥራ ላይ ጉዳት ከደረሰብዎ አሠሪዎ ካሳ መክፈል አለበት [2]።

**ማድረግ የሚችሉት፦** በጣም ከታመሙ ወይም ከባድ ጉዳት ከደረሰብዎ ለአምቡላንስ 998 ይደውሉ። ከሐኪሙ የጽሑፍ የሕክምና ማስረጃ ይጠይቁ እና ቅጂውን ያስቀምጡ [2][7]።

## ፈቃድ፣ ውል ማቋረጥ እና አሠሪ መቀየር

ውሉ ጊዜው ሲያልቅ ወይም እርስዎና አሠሪዎ ሁለታችሁም ከተስማማችሁ ቀደም ብሎ ሊያበቃ ይችላል [2]።

አሠሪዎ ሕጉን ከጣሰ፣ ለምሳሌ ደመወዝ ካልከፈለ ወይም መጥፎ አያያዝ ካደረገብዎ፣ ውሉን ማቋረጥ ይችላሉ [2]። አሠሪዎ በእርስዎ ጥፋት ባልሆነ ምክንያት ውሉን ካቋረጠ፣ ወደ ሀገርዎ የሚመለሱበትን ትኬት መክፈል እና ያለበትን ዕዳ መክፈል አለበት [2]። ውሉ ሲያበቃ አሠሪዎ ገንዘብዎን በሙሉ በ10 ቀን ውስጥ መክፈል አለበት [2]። ያልተጠቀሙበት የዓመት ፈቃድ በጥሬ ገንዘብ መከፈል አለበት [2]።

ውሉን እና የMOHRE ደንቦችን ከተከተሉ ወደ አዲስ አሠሪ መዛወር ይችላሉ [2]።

**ለማንም ሳይናገሩ ከቤት መውጣት አደገኛ ሊሆን ይችላል።** ከሰባት ቀን በላይ ከጠፉ እና አሠሪዎ ሊያገኝዎ ካልቻለ፣ አሠሪዎ ለMOHRE "ከሥራ መጥፋት" (ጠፍታለች) ሪፖርት ማቅረብ ይችላል [5]። ሕጉ አሠሪዎ ሳያውቅ ሥራ ከለቀቁ በሁለት ቀን ውስጥ ለMOHRE ማሳወቅ አለብዎት ይላል [2]። ይህ የእርስዎ ጥፋት አይደለም። ራስዎን የሚጠብቁበት መንገድ ነው።

**ማድረግ የሚችሉት፦** መውጣት ካስፈለገዎ በመጀመሪያ ወይም በሁለት ቀን ውስጥ MOHREን ወይም ኤምባሲዎን ለማነጋገር ይሞክሩ። ለምን እንደወጡ ይንገሯቸው። አደጋ ላይ ከሆኑ መጀመሪያ 999 ይደውሉ [2][7]።

## ቅሬታ የት እንደሚያቀርቡ

ለMOHRE የሥራ ቅሬታ ማቅረብ ይችላሉ። MOHRE ጉዳዩን በሁለት ሳምንት ውስጥ ከሁለቱም ወገኖች ጋር ለመፍታት ይሞክራል። ካልተሳካ ጉዳዩን ከምክረ ሐሳቡ ጋር ወደ ፍርድ ቤት ይልካል [1][2]።

ሠራተኞች የፍርድ ቤት ክፍያ አይከፍሉም፤ ፍርድ ቤቶችም እነዚህን ጉዳዮች በፍጥነት ማየት አለባቸው [1][2]። ነገር ግን ጥያቄዎች ሥራው ካበቃ በኋላ በሦስት ወር ውስጥ መቅረብ አለባቸው [1][2]። ብዙ አይዘግዩ።

MOHREን እንዴት ማግኘት እንደሚችሉ [3][4]፦

- የጥሪ ማዕከል፦ 600 590000 (24 ሰዓት)። ከUAE ውጭ፦ +971 6 803 4000።
- ኢሜይል፦ ask@mohre.gov.ae
- የMOHRE መተግበሪያ ወይም የአገልግሎት ማዕከል።

የሰዎች ዝውውርን ወይም ጥቃትን ለማሳወቅ [6]፦

- የኤዋ መጠለያዎች የስልክ መስመር፦ 800 SAVE (800 7283)።
- የዱባይ የሴቶችና ሕፃናት ፋውንዴሽን፦ 800111።
- የዱባይ ፖሊስ የሰዎች ዝውውር ማዕከል፦ +971 4 608 2347።
- በሴቶችና ሕፃናት ላይ ለሚደርስ ጥቃት የሀገር ውስጥ ሚኒስቴር መስመር፦ 116111።

በአቡ ዳቢ ያለው ኤምባሲዎ ወይም በዱባይ ያለው ቆንስላዎም ሊረዳዎ ይችላል። ስልክ ቁጥሮቻቸው በእርዳታ ማውጫው ውስጥ አሉ።

## የአስቸኳይ ጊዜ ስልክ ቁጥሮች

- ፖሊስ፦ 999 [7]
- አምቡላንስ፦ 998 [7]
- እሳት አደጋ፦ 997 [7]

አደጋ ላይ ከሆኑ በመተግበሪያው ውስጥ ያለውን የSOS ቁልፍ ይጫኑ ወይም 999 ይደውሉ። ተጨማሪ ቁጥሮችን በእርዳታ ማውጫው ውስጥ ማግኘት ይችላሉ።
body.om:
## Waliigaltee hojii keessan

Hojjechiisaan keessan waliigaltee hojii isin waliin mallatteessuu qaba. Waliigalteen kun unka Ministeerri Qabeenya Namaa fi Emiraatii (MOHRE) raggaasise fayyadamuu qaba. Hojjechiisaan keessan garagalcha isaa isiniif kennuu qaba [2].

Waliigalteen gosa hojii, bakka hojii, mindaa keessan, akkaataa kaffaltii, boqonnaa keessan, yeroo boqonnaa fi yoom akka waliigalteen xumuramuu danda'u agarsiisuu qaba [1][2]. Waliigalteen waggaa lama tura, haaromfamuus ni danda'a [2]. Yeroon yaalii hanga ji'a jahaatti ta'uu danda'a [2].

Seerri akka waliigalteen Afaan Arabaatiin fi afaan isin hubattaniin ta'u ni ajaja. Lamaan isaanii yoo garaagarummaa qabaatan, barreeffamni Arabaa mo'ata [2].

Hojjechiisaan keessan fedhii keessan malee gosa hojii biraa isin hojjechiisuu hin danda'u. Seera ministeerichaatiin ala namoota biraatiif isin hojjechiisuu hin danda'u [2].

Seerri namoota umuriin isaanii 18 gadi ta'e hojjechiisuu, dararaa saalaa, hojii dirqamaa fi daldala namaa ni dhorka [1][2].

**Wanta gochuu dandeessan:** Suuraa waliigaltee keessanii bilbila keessan irratti fi bakka nagaa ta'e kaa'aa. Garagalcha yoo hin argatin, MOHRE gaafadhaa [1][2].

## Mindaa keessan

Mindaan keessan hamma waliigaltee keessan irratti barreeffameedha. UAE keessatti hojjettoota manaatiif mindaa xiqqaa seera qabeessa ta'e hin arganne [1].

Hojjechiisaan keessan ji'a ji'aan, Dirhamii UAE'tiin, guyyaa kaffaltii booda guyyoota 10 keessatti kaffaluu qaba. Kaffaltiin ragaa barreeffamaan ykn karaa biraa MOHRE fudhatuun mirkanaa'uu qaba [2].

Hojjechiisaan keessanis ta'e eejansiin qaxarii hojii argachuuf ykn itti fufuuf isin irraa maallaqa fudhachuu hin danda'an [1][2]. Yeroo guutuu yoo hojjettan, hojjechiisaan keessan bakka jireenyaa, nyaata fi uffata hojii isiniif kennuu qaba [2].

Hojjechiisaan keessan mindaa keessan irraa maallaqa hir'isuu kan danda'u haala muraasa seerri hayyamu qofa keessatti. Fakkeenyaaf, qabeenya isaanii yoo baay'ee balleessitan, waliigaltee keessan ykn hayyama MOHRE barbaadu; hir'isni kunis kurmaana mindaa keessanii caaluu hin danda'u [2].

**Wanta gochuu dandeessan:** Kaffaltii hunda barreessaa: guyyaa fi hamma. Suuraa ragaa kaffaltii kaasaa. Mindaan keessan yoo turee ykn hin kaffalamin, MOHRE'tti komii dhiyeessuu dandeessu [2][3].

## Sa'aatii hojii fi boqonnaa

Mirgoota armaan gadii qabdu:

- Guyyaa guyyaan yoo xiqqaate sa'aatii 12 boqonnaa. Isaan keessaa yoo xiqqaate sa'aatii 8 walitti aansee ta'uu qaba [1][2].
- Torbanitti guyyaa boqonnaa kaffaltii qabu tokko. Guyyaa boqonnaa keessan yoo hojjettan, guyyaa boqonnaa biraa ykn kaffaltii guyyaa tokkoo dabalataa argachuu qabdu [2].
- Waggaatti yoo xiqqaate guyyoota 30 boqonnaa waggaa kaffaltii qabu [1][2].
- Waggaa lamaan tokko boqonnaaf tikeetii deemsaa fi deebii gara biyyaatti, kan hojjechiisaan kaffalu [1][2].

**Wanta gochuu dandeessan:** Sa'aatii hojjettanii fi guyyoota boqonnaa keessanii salphaatti barreessaa. Booda komii dhiyeessuu yoo barbaachise isin gargaara.

## Paaspoortii keessan

Paaspoortiin fi waraqaan eenyummaa keessanii kan keessaniidha. Seerri akka hojjechiisaan keessan mirga sanadoota eenyummaa keessanii ofii keessan qabachuu kabaju ni ajaja [1][2].

**Wanta gochuu dandeessan:** Suuraa paaspoortii, viizaa fi waraqaa eenyummaa Imireets keessanii bilbila keessan irratti kaa'aa. Hojjechiisaan ykn eejansiin paaspoortii keessan fudhatee yoo deebisuu dide, MOHRE'tti komii dhiyeessuu fi ejjennoo ykn qonsilaa keessan quunnamuu dandeessu. Galmee gargaarsaa ilaalaa [2][4].

## Kunuunsa fayyaa

Hojjechiisaan keessan akkaataa seera fayyaa UAE'tiin baasii yaalii keessanii kaffaluu ykn inshuraansii fayyaa isiniif kennuu qaba [2].

Ragaa yaalii dhaabbata fayyaa hayyama qabu irraa yoo qabaattan, waggaatti hanga guyyoota 30 boqonnaa dhukkubaa fudhachuu dandeessu. Guyyoonni 15 jalqabaa kaffaltii guutuu qabu. Guyyoonni 15 itti aanan walakkaa kaffaltii qabu [2].

Hojii irratti yoo miidhamtan, hojjechiisaan keessan beenyaa kaffaluu qaba [2].

**Wanta gochuu dandeessan:** Yoo baay'ee dhukkubsattan ykn baay'ee miidhamtan, ambulaansiif 998 bilbilaa. Doktara irraa ragaa yaalii barreeffamaa gaafadhaa, garagalcha isaas kaa'aa [2][7].

## Boqonnaa, waliigaltee xumuruu fi hojjechiisaa jijjiiruu

Waliigalteen yeroon isaa yommuu xumuramu, ykn isinii fi hojjechiisaan keessan lachuu yoo waliigaltan dursee xumuramuu danda'a [2].

Hojjechiisaan keessan seera yoo cabse, fakkeenyaaf mindaa yoo hin kaffalin ykn yoo isin miidhe, waliigaltee xumuruu dandeessu [2]. Hojjechiisaan keessan sababa balleessaa keessan hin taaneen waliigaltee yoo xumure, tikeetii gara biyyaatti deebiitii fi wanta isiniif qabu kaffaluu qaba [2]. Waliigalteen yommuu xumuramu, hojjechiisaan keessan maallaqa keessan hunda guyyoota 10 keessatti kaffaluu qaba [2]. Boqonnaan waggaa itti hin fayyadamin maallaqaan kaffalamuu qaba [2].

Waliigaltee fi seera MOHRE yoo hordoftan, gara hojjechiisaa haaraatti ce'uu dandeessu [2].

**Utuu nama tokkollee hin beeksisin mana keessaa ba'uun balaa qabaachuu danda'a.** Guyyoota torbaa ol yoo baddanii fi hojjechiisaan keessan isin argachuu yoo hin dandeenye, hojjechiisaan keessan MOHRE'tti gabaasa "hojii irraa baduu" (ni baqatte) galchuu danda'a [5]. Seerri akka utuu hojjechiisaan hin beekin hojii yoo dhiistan guyyoota lama keessatti MOHRE beeksiftan ni ajaja [2]. Kun balleessaa keessan miti. Karaa ittiin of eegdaniidha.

**Wanta gochuu dandeessan:** Ba'uu yoo barbaachise, dursaa ykn guyyoota lama keessatti MOHRE ykn ejjennoo keessan quunnamuuf yaalaa. Maaliif akka baatan itti himaa. Balaa keessa yoo jirtan, jalqaba 999 bilbilaa [2][7].

## Eessatti komii dhiyeessuu

MOHRE'tti komii hojii dhiyeessuu dandeessu. MOHRE torban lama keessatti gareewwan lamaan waliin dhimmicha furuuf yaala. Yoo hin milkoofne, dhimmicha gorsa isaa waliin gara mana murtiitti erga [1][2].

Hojjettoonni kaffaltii mana murtii hin kaffalan, manni murtiis dhimmoota kana saffisaan ilaaluu qaba [1][2]. Garuu gaaffiin hojiin erga xumuramee ji'oota sadii keessatti dhiyaachuu qaba [1][2]. Baay'ee hin turinaa.

Akkaataa MOHRE itti quunnamtan [3][4]:

- Wiirtuu bilbilaa: 600 590000 (sa'aatii 24). UAE alaa: +971 6 803 4000.
- Imeelii: ask@mohre.gov.ae
- Appii MOHRE ykn wiirtuu tajaajilaa.

Daldala namaa ykn miidhaa gabaasuuf [6]:

- Sarara hirkoowwan Ewaa: 800 SAVE (800 7283).
- Dhaabbata Dubaayii Dubartootaa fi Daa'immanii: 800111.
- Wiirtuu daldala namaa Poolisii Dubaayii: +971 4 608 2347.
- Sarara Ministeera Dhimma Keessaa miidhaa dubartootaa fi daa'immanii: 116111.

Ejjennoon keessan Abuu Dhaabii ykn qonsilaan keessan Dubaayii jiru isin gargaaruu danda'a. Lakkoofsi bilbilaa isaanii galmee gargaarsaa keessa jira.

## Lakkoofsota bilbilaa ariifachiisaa

- Poolisii: 999 [7]
- Ambulaansii: 998 [7]
- Ibidda: 997 [7]

Balaa keessa yoo jirtan, qabduu SOS appii keessa jiru tuqaa ykn 999 bilbilaa. Lakkoofsota dabalataa galmee gargaarsaa keessatti argachuu dandeessu.

title.en: Your rights as a domestic worker in Kuwait
title.am: በኩዌት እንደ ቤት ሠራተኛ ያለዎት መብቶች
title.om: Mirgoota keessan akka hojjettuu manaa Kuweet keessatti

summary.en: Kuwait's Domestic Workers Law (Law No. 68 of 2015) protects you. You have the right to a contract, monthly pay with no deductions, a weekly day off, 30 days of paid leave, and to keep your own passport.
summary.am: የኩዌት የቤት ሠራተኞች ሕግ (ሕግ ቁጥር 68/2015) ይጠብቅዎታል። ውል፣ ያለ ቅናሽ የሚከፈል ወርሃዊ ደመወዝ፣ የሳምንት እረፍት ቀን፣ ደመወዝ ያለው የ30 ቀን ፈቃድ እና ፓስፖርትዎን ራስዎ የመያዝ መብት አለዎት።
summary.om: Seerri Hojjettoota Manaa Kuweet (Seera Lakk. 68 bara 2015) isin eega. Waliigaltee, mindaa ji'aa hir'isa malee, guyyaa boqonnaa torbanii, boqonnaa guyyaa 30 mindaa qabu fi paaspoortii keessan ofii qabachuuf mirga qabdu.

body.en:
## Your contract

- Your work is covered by a written contract made by the domestic workers department of the Public Authority for Manpower (PAM). [1] [2]
- The contract is in Arabic and English. There are four copies. One copy is for you. Ask for it and keep it. [1]
- The contract says your job, your pay, your hours, your day off, your leave and your end-of-service payment. [1]
- You only work in your employer's house. They cannot send you to work in other homes. [1]
- A contract usually lasts one year or more. It renews by itself unless one side says no at least two months before the end. [1]
- Recruitment agencies must not charge you any fees, in Kuwait or abroad. [2]

**What you can do:** Keep a photo of your contract on your phone and send a copy to someone you trust at home. [1]

## Your pay

- Your pay is the amount written in your contract. [1]
- Your employer must pay you at the end of every month, starting from your first day of work. [2]
- No money can be taken from your pay for any reason. [2]
- A bank transfer receipt or a signed cash receipt is proof that you were paid. [2]
- If you work extra hours, this is limited to 2 hours a day. You must get extra pay equal to half a day's wage. [3]

**What you can do:** Keep every receipt. Write down each date you were paid and how much. If you are not paid, you can complain to PAM. [1]

## Working hours and rest

- You cannot be made to work more than 12 hours a day, and this includes your rest times. [1] [3]
- After 5 hours of work in a row, you must get at least 1 hour of rest. [1]
- You should get at least 8 hours of rest in a row at night. [1]
- You get one paid day off every week (24 hours in a row). You and your employer agree on which day. [1]
- If you must work on your day off, you should get another day off and extra pay. [1]
- You get 30 days of paid leave every year. [1]

## Your passport

- Your passport and civil ID belong to you. Your employer must not keep them unless you agree. [1] [3]
- The agreement between Kuwait and Ethiopia says passports and mobile phones of Ethiopian domestic workers must not be taken. [5]
- You have the right to stay in contact with your family. [1]

**What you can do:** Keep a photo of your passport and civil ID on your phone. If your passport is taken, you can complain to PAM or your embassy. [1]

## Health care

- Your employer must give you food, clothing, medicine, medical treatment and a place to live. [2]
- If you are hurt at work, your employer must pay for treatment and compensate you. [3]
- If you are sick, you have the right to rest as the doctor says. [1]
- Your employer must not give you dangerous work, or work that harms your health or dignity. [1] [3]

## Leave, ending your contract and changing employer

- When your contract ends, you get an end-of-service payment of one month's pay for every year you worked. [1]
- When your contract ends, your employer pays for your plane ticket home. They must also pay if they broke the contract. [1]
- You cannot be sent to work outside Kuwait without your agreement. If this happens, your employer must pay for you to go home. [1]

**Absconding reports**

- If you leave the house without telling anyone, your employer can file an "absconding" report. This can lead to losing your residence permit, arrest and deportation. [1]
- If you file a complaint with PAM first, it is registered and your name is marked. Then your employer cannot file an absconding report against you. [1]
- While your complaint is open, PAM can extend your residence permit if it has run out. [1]

**What you can do:** If you can, file a complaint with PAM or your embassy before you leave the house. If you cannot get there, ask someone you trust to call for you. But if you are in danger, your safety comes first. Use the SOS button or call 112. [1]

## Where to complain

- **PAM domestic workers department:** this is the main place for complaints about pay, passports, abuse, food or housing. You can go in person, or your embassy can file for you. [1] [6]
- PAM tries to settle the problem with your employer. If that fails, your case goes to the labour court quickly. You do not pay court fees. [1]
- **Women's shelter:** while your complaint is open, PAM can place you in the government shelter for women. It gives food, medical care and help with your case or going home. [1] [4]
- **Anti-trafficking hotline (Ministry of Interior):** 1888688. [1]
- **Kuwait Society for Human Rights:** free advice. See the help directory. [1]
- **Ethiopian embassy:** see the help directory.

**What you can do:** Before you complain, write down your name, civil ID number, nationality, contract start and end dates, your pay, your employer's name and address, and what happened. [1]

## Emergency numbers

- **112:** police, ambulance and fire [1]

If you are in danger, press the SOS button in the app. Your trusted contacts will be alerted. The help directory has more numbers.
body.am:
## የሥራ ውልዎ

- ሥራዎ በሰው ኃይል የሕዝብ ባለሥልጣን (PAM) የቤት ሠራተኞች መምሪያ በተዘጋጀ የጽሑፍ ውል ይሸፈናል። [1] [2]
- ውሉ በዓረብኛና በእንግሊዝኛ ነው። አራት ቅጂዎች አሉ። አንዱ ቅጂ የእርስዎ ነው። ይጠይቁትና ያስቀምጡት። [1]
- ውሉ ሥራዎን፣ ደመወዝዎን፣ የሥራ ሰዓትዎን፣ የእረፍት ቀንዎን፣ ፈቃድዎንና የአገልግሎት ማብቂያ ክፍያዎን ይገልጻል። [1]
- የሚሠሩት በአሠሪዎ ቤት ብቻ ነው። በሌሎች ቤቶች እንዲሠሩ ሊልኩዎት አይችሉም። [1]
- ውል ብዙውን ጊዜ አንድ ዓመት ወይም ከዚያ በላይ ይቆያል። አንዱ ወገን ውሉ ከማለቁ ቢያንስ ሁለት ወር በፊት "አልቀጥልም" ካላለ በራሱ ይታደሳል። [1]
- አስቀጣሪ ኤጀንሲዎች በኩዌትም ሆነ በውጭ ምንም ክፍያ ሊያስከፍሉዎት አይገባም። [2]

**ማድረግ የሚችሉት:** የውልዎን ፎቶ በስልክዎ ያስቀምጡ፤ ቅጂውንም በሀገር ቤት ለሚያምኑት ሰው ይላኩ። [1]

## ደመወዝዎ

- ደመወዝዎ በውልዎ ላይ የተጻፈው መጠን ነው። [1]
- አሠሪዎ ከመጀመሪያው የሥራ ቀንዎ ጀምሮ በየወሩ መጨረሻ መክፈል አለበት። [2]
- በምንም ምክንያት ከደመወዝዎ ገንዘብ መቀነስ አይቻልም። [2]
- የባንክ ማስተላለፊያ ደረሰኝ ወይም የተፈረመ የጥሬ ገንዘብ ደረሰኝ እንደተከፈለዎት ማረጋገጫ ነው። [2]
- ተጨማሪ ሰዓት ከሠሩ፣ ይህ በቀን እስከ 2 ሰዓት ብቻ ነው። የግማሽ ቀን ደመወዝ የሚያህል ተጨማሪ ክፍያ ማግኘት አለብዎት። [3]

**ማድረግ የሚችሉት:** እያንዳንዱን ደረሰኝ ያስቀምጡ። የተከፈለዎትን እያንዳንዱን ቀንና መጠን ይጻፉ። ካልተከፈለዎት ለPAM ቅሬታ ማቅረብ ይችላሉ። [1]

## የሥራ ሰዓትና እረፍት

- የእረፍት ጊዜን ጨምሮ በቀን ከ12 ሰዓት በላይ እንዲሠሩ ሊገደዱ አይችሉም። [1] [3]
- ከ5 ተከታታይ ሰዓት ሥራ በኋላ ቢያንስ 1 ሰዓት እረፍት ማግኘት አለብዎት። [1]
- ሌሊት ቢያንስ 8 ተከታታይ ሰዓት እረፍት ማግኘት አለብዎት። [1]
- በየሳምንቱ ደመወዝ ያለው አንድ የእረፍት ቀን (24 ተከታታይ ሰዓት) ያገኛሉ። ቀኑን እርስዎና አሠሪዎ ትስማማላችሁ። [1]
- በእረፍት ቀንዎ መሥራት ካለብዎት፣ ሌላ የእረፍት ቀንና ተጨማሪ ክፍያ ማግኘት አለብዎት። [1]
- በየዓመቱ ደመወዝ ያለው የ30 ቀን ፈቃድ ያገኛሉ። [1]

## ፓስፖርትዎ

- ፓስፖርትዎና የሲቪል መታወቂያዎ የእርስዎ ናቸው። እርስዎ ካልፈቀዱ በስተቀር አሠሪዎ ሊይዛቸው አይገባም። [1] [3]
- በኩዌትና በኢትዮጵያ መካከል ያለው ስምምነት የኢትዮጵያውያን የቤት ሠራተኞች ፓስፖርትና ሞባይል ስልክ መወሰድ እንደሌለበት ይገልጻል። [5]
- ከቤተሰብዎ ጋር የመገናኘት መብት አለዎት። [1]

**ማድረግ የሚችሉት:** የፓስፖርትዎንና የሲቪል መታወቂያዎን ፎቶ በስልክዎ ያስቀምጡ። ፓስፖርትዎ ከተወሰደ ለPAM ወይም ለኤምባሲዎ ቅሬታ ማቅረብ ይችላሉ። [1]

## የጤና እንክብካቤ

- አሠሪዎ ምግብ፣ ልብስ፣ መድኃኒት፣ ሕክምናና የመኖሪያ ቦታ መስጠት አለበት። [2]
- በሥራ ላይ ከተጎዱ አሠሪዎ ለሕክምና መክፈልና ካሳ መስጠት አለበት። [3]
- ከታመሙ ሐኪሙ እንደሚለው የማረፍ መብት አለዎት። [1]
- አሠሪዎ አደገኛ ሥራ ወይም ጤናዎንና ክብርዎን የሚጎዳ ሥራ ሊሰጥዎ አይገባም። [1] [3]

## ፈቃድ፣ ውል ማቋረጥ እና አሠሪ መቀየር

- ውልዎ ሲያልቅ ለሠሩበት ለእያንዳንዱ ዓመት የአንድ ወር ደመወዝ የአገልግሎት ማብቂያ ክፍያ ያገኛሉ። [1]
- ውልዎ ሲያልቅ አሠሪዎ ወደ ሀገርዎ የአውሮፕላን ትኬት ይከፍላል። ውሉን ያፈረሰው አሠሪው ከሆነም መክፈል አለበት። [1]
- ያለ እርስዎ ፈቃድ ከኩዌት ውጭ እንዲሠሩ ሊላኩ አይችሉም። ይህ ከሆነ አሠሪዎ ወደ ሀገርዎ ለመመለስዎ መክፈል አለበት። [1]

**የመጥፋት (አብስኮንዲንግ) ሪፖርት**

- ለማንም ሳይናገሩ ቤቱን ለቀው ከወጡ፣ አሠሪዎ "ጠፍታለች" የሚል ሪፖርት ሊያቀርብ ይችላል። ይህ የመኖሪያ ፈቃድ ማጣትን፣ መታሰርንና ከሀገር መባረርን ሊያስከትል ይችላል። [1]
- መጀመሪያ ለPAM ቅሬታ ካቀረቡ፣ ቅሬታው ይመዘገባል፤ ስምዎም ምልክት ይደረግበታል። ከዚያ አሠሪዎ የመጥፋት ሪፖርት ሊያቀርብብዎ አይችልም። [1]
- ቅሬታዎ በሂደት ላይ እያለ የመኖሪያ ፈቃድዎ ጊዜው ካለፈ PAM ሊያራዝመው ይችላል። [1]

**ማድረግ የሚችሉት:** ከቻሉ ቤቱን ከመልቀቅዎ በፊት ለPAM ወይም ለኤምባሲዎ ቅሬታ ያቅርቡ። መሄድ ካልቻሉ የሚያምኑትን ሰው እንዲደውልልዎ ይጠይቁ። ነገር ግን አደጋ ላይ ከሆኑ ደህንነትዎ ይቀድማል። የSOS ቁልፉን ይጫኑ ወይም 112 ይደውሉ። [1]

## ቅሬታ የት እንደሚያቀርቡ

- **የPAM የቤት ሠራተኞች መምሪያ:** ስለ ደመወዝ፣ ፓስፖርት፣ ጥቃት፣ ምግብ ወይም መኖሪያ ቅሬታ የሚቀርብበት ዋና ቦታ ነው። በአካል መሄድ ይችላሉ፤ ወይም ኤምባሲዎ ሊያቀርብልዎ ይችላል። [1] [6]
- PAM ችግሩን ከአሠሪዎ ጋር ለመፍታት ይሞክራል። ካልተሳካ ጉዳይዎ በፍጥነት ወደ ሠራተኛ ፍርድ ቤት ይሄዳል። የፍርድ ቤት ክፍያ አይከፍሉም። [1]
- **የሴቶች መጠለያ:** ቅሬታዎ በሂደት ላይ እያለ PAM በመንግሥት የሴቶች መጠለያ ሊያስቀምጥዎ ይችላል። ምግብ፣ ሕክምና እና ለጉዳይዎ ወይም ወደ ሀገር ለመመለስ እርዳታ ይሰጣል። [1] [4]
- **የሰዎች ንግድ መከላከያ የስልክ መስመር (የአገር ውስጥ ሚኒስቴር):** 1888688። [1]
- **የኩዌት የሰብአዊ መብቶች ማኅበር:** ነፃ ምክር ይሰጣል። የእርዳታ ማውጫውን ይመልከቱ። [1]
- **የኢትዮጵያ ኤምባሲ:** የእርዳታ ማውጫውን ይመልከቱ።

**ማድረግ የሚችሉት:** ቅሬታ ከማቅረብዎ በፊት ስምዎን፣ የሲቪል መታወቂያ ቁጥርዎን፣ ዜግነትዎን፣ ውሉ የጀመረበትንና የሚያልቅበትን ቀን፣ ደመወዝዎን፣ የአሠሪዎን ስምና አድራሻ እንዲሁም የሆነውን ነገር ይጻፉ። [1]

## የአስቸኳይ ጊዜ ስልክ ቁጥሮች

- **112:** ፖሊስ፣ አምቡላንስና እሳት አደጋ [1]

አደጋ ላይ ከሆኑ በመተግበሪያው ውስጥ ያለውን የSOS ቁልፍ ይጫኑ። የሚያምኗቸው ሰዎች መልዕክት ይደርሳቸዋል። የእርዳታ ማውጫው ተጨማሪ ቁጥሮች አሉት።
