title.am: ከመሄድሽ በፊት የወሊድ መከላከያና የሥነ ተዋልዶ ጤና
title.om: Ittisa ulfaa fi fayyaa saalaa osoo hin deemin dura

summary.en: Your body, your choice. Learn about contraception, protection from infections, and the laws on pregnancy in some destination countries, so you can decide what is right for you.
summary.am: ሰውነትሽ፣ ምርጫሽ። ለአንቺ የሚስማማውን እንድትወስኚ ስለ ወሊድ መከላከያ፣ ከበሽታ ስለመጠበቅና በአንዳንድ የመዳረሻ አገሮች ስላሉ የእርግዝና ሕጎች ተማሪ።
summary.om: Qaama kee, filannoo kee. Waan siif ta'u akka murteessituuf waa'ee ittisa ulfaa, dhukkuba irraa of eeguu fi seerota ulfaa biyyoota tokko tokko keessa jiranii baradhu.

body.en:
This is about your body and your choices. Nobody else should decide for you. Whatever you choose, you deserve good information and respect.

## Why think about this now?

Abroad, it may be hard to see a doctor, buy contraception, or get a private health check. Some countries also have strict laws about sex and pregnancy outside marriage (see below). Getting ready in Ethiopia gives you more control.

## Contraception options

There are many methods. A health worker can help you choose. [1]

- **Implant** (a small rod in the arm) and **IUD** (a small device in the womb): very effective and they last for years. [1] You do not need to remember anything each day.
- **Injection**: works well if you get it on time. [1] It may be hard to get the next one abroad.
- **Pills**: work well if you take them correctly, every day. [1]
- **Condoms**: the only method that also protects you from sexually transmitted infections (STIs), including HIV. [1]

## Emergency contraception

If you had sex without protection, or protection failed, emergency contraception can prevent pregnancy. It works best when used as soon as possible, and within 5 days. [2] Emergency pills do **not** cause an abortion, and they cannot harm a pregnancy that has already started. [2] A copper IUD is the most effective kind. [2]

## Where to get help in Ethiopia

- **MSI Ethiopia** (Marie Stopes) offers contraception and other sexual health care. It works across 11 regions. [3]
- **Family Guidance Association of Ethiopia (FGAE)** offers contraception, youth-friendly services, and HIV and STI services. It has clinics in Addis Ababa, Adama, Harar, Mekelle, Dessie, Bahir Dar, Hawassa and Jimma. [4]
- You can also ask at a health centre or clinic you trust.

Find their contact details in the **help directory**.

## Laws about pregnancy abroad

In some destination countries, sex outside marriage is a crime. In Qatar, sex outside marriage is illegal, and if a woman becomes pregnant outside marriage, both partners could face prison or deportation. [6] Human Rights Watch reports that in Qatar, hospitals must report unmarried pregnant women to the authorities, and a woman may face arrest even if the pregnancy came from rape. [5]

We tell you this to protect you, not to judge you. Laws are different in each country, and they change.

## If someone hurts you

If anyone forces you or touches you without your consent, it is **never your fault**. You deserve care and safety.

## What you can do

1. Visit a clinic before you leave. Ask about the method that suits you.
2. If you choose an implant or IUD, get it early so you can check it feels right.
3. Pack condoms if you want them.
4. Ask about an HIV and STI test, so you know your health.
5. Read the "Your rights" page for your destination country.
6. If you are hurt, or think you may be pregnant abroad, use **SOS** if you are in danger, and look in the **help directory** for safe health and legal help.
body.am:
ይህ ስለ ሰውነትሽና ስለ ምርጫሽ ነው። ሌላ ማንም ሰው ላንቺ መወሰን የለበትም። የመረጥሽው ምንም ይሁን፣ ጥሩ መረጃና ክብር ይገባሻል።

## ለምን አሁን ማሰብ ያስፈልጋል?

በውጭ አገር ሐኪም ማየት፣ የወሊድ መከላከያ መግዛት ወይም በግል የጤና ምርመራ ማድረግ ሊከብድ ይችላል። አንዳንድ አገሮችም ከጋብቻ ውጭ ስለሚደረግ ወሲብና እርግዝና ጥብቅ ሕጎች አሏቸው (ከታች ተመልከቺ)። በኢትዮጵያ እያለሽ መዘጋጀት የበለጠ ቁጥጥር ይሰጥሻል።

## የወሊድ መከላከያ አማራጮች

ብዙ ዘዴዎች አሉ። የጤና ባለሙያ እንድትመርጪ ሊረዳሽ ይችላል። [1]

- **በክንድ የሚቀበር** (ትንሽ ዘንግ በክንድ ውስጥ) እና **በማሕፀን ውስጥ የሚቀመጥ (IUD)** (በማሕፀን ውስጥ የሚቀመጥ ትንሽ መሣሪያ)፦ በጣም ውጤታማ ናቸው፣ ለዓመታትም ይቆያሉ። [1] በየቀኑ ምንም ነገር ማስታወስ አያስፈልግሽም።
- **መርፌ**፦ በሰዓቱ ከወሰድሽው በደንብ ይሠራል። [1] በውጭ አገር ቀጣዩን መርፌ ማግኘት ሊከብድ ይችላል።
- **እንክብል**፦ በትክክል በየቀኑ ከወሰድሽው በደንብ ይሠራል። [1]
- **ኮንዶም**፦ ኤች አይ ቪን ጨምሮ ከአባላዘር በሽታዎች (STIs) የሚከላከል ብቸኛው ዘዴ ነው። [1]

## የአደጋ ጊዜ የወሊድ መከላከያ

ያለ መከላከያ ወሲብ ከፈጸምሽ፣ ወይም መከላከያው ካልሠራ፣ የአደጋ ጊዜ የወሊድ መከላከያ እርግዝናን ሊከላከል ይችላል። በተቻለ ፍጥነት፣ በ5 ቀን ውስጥ ሲወሰድ የበለጠ ይሠራል። [2] የአደጋ ጊዜ እንክብሎች ውርጃ **አያስከትሉም**፣ ቀድሞ የተጀመረን እርግዝናም ሊጎዱ አይችሉም። [2] የመዳብ IUD ከሁሉ የበለጠ ውጤታማው ዓይነት ነው። [2]

## በኢትዮጵያ እርዳታ የምታገኚበት

- **ኤም ኤስ አይ ኢትዮጵያ** (ማሪ ስቶፕስ) የወሊድ መከላከያና ሌሎች የሥነ ተዋልዶ ጤና አገልግሎቶች ይሰጣል። በ11 ክልሎች ይሠራል። [3]
- **የቤተሰብ መምሪያ ማኅበር ኢትዮጵያ (FGAE)** የወሊድ መከላከያ፣ ለወጣቶች ተስማሚ አገልግሎቶች፣ እና የኤች አይ ቪና የአባላዘር በሽታ አገልግሎቶች ይሰጣል። በአዲስ አበባ፣ አዳማ፣ ሐረር፣ መቐለ፣ ደሴ፣ ባሕር ዳር፣ ሐዋሳና ጅማ ክሊኒኮች አሉት። [4]
- በምታምኚው ጤና ጣቢያ ወይም ክሊኒክም መጠየቅ ትችያለሽ።

አድራሻቸውን **በእርዳታ ማውጫው** ውስጥ ፈልጊ።

## በውጭ አገር ስለ እርግዝና ያሉ ሕጎች

በአንዳንድ የመዳረሻ አገሮች ከጋብቻ ውጭ ወሲብ ወንጀል ነው። በኳታር ከጋብቻ ውጭ ወሲብ ሕገ ወጥ ነው፤ አንዲት ሴት ከጋብቻ ውጭ ካረገዘች ሁለቱም ወገኖች እስር ወይም ከአገር መባረር ሊደርስባቸው ይችላል። [6] ሂዩማን ራይትስ ዎች እንደሚለው፣ በኳታር ሆስፒታሎች ያላገቡ ነፍሰ ጡር ሴቶችን ለባለሥልጣናት ሪፖርት ማድረግ አለባቸው፤ እርግዝናው በአስገድዶ መድፈር ቢመጣም ሴቲቱ ልትታሰር ትችላለች። [5]

ይህን የምንነግርሽ ልንጠብቅሽ እንጂ ልንፈርድብሽ አይደለም። ሕጎች በየአገሩ ይለያያሉ፣ ይቀየራሉም።

## አንድ ሰው ቢጎዳሽ

ማንም ሰው ቢያስገድድሽ ወይም ያለ ፈቃድሽ ቢነካሽ፣ ይህ **በፍጹም ያንቺ ጥፋት አይደለም**። እንክብካቤና ደህንነት ይገባሻል።

## ምን ማድረግ ትችያለሽ

1. ከመሄድሽ በፊት ክሊኒክ ሂጂ። ለአንቺ የሚስማማውን ዘዴ ጠይቂ።
2. በክንድ የሚቀበር ወይም IUD ከመረጥሽ፣ ምቹ መሆኑን ለማረጋገጥ ቀደም ብለሽ አስገቢ።
3. ከፈለግሽ ኮንዶም ያዢ።
4. ጤናሽን እንድታውቂ የኤች አይ ቪና የአባላዘር በሽታ ምርመራ ጠይቂ።
5. ለምትሄጂበት አገር "መብቶችሽ" የሚለውን ገጽ አንብቢ።
6. ከተጎዳሽ፣ ወይም በውጭ አገር ያረገዝሽ ከመሰለሽ፣ አደጋ ላይ ከሆንሽ **SOS** ተጠቀሚ፣ ለደህንነቱ የተጠበቀ የጤናና የሕግ እርዳታ **የእርዳታ ማውጫውን** ተመልከቺ።
body.om:
Kun waa'ee qaama keetii fi filannoo keetii ti. Namni biraa kamiyyuu siif murteessuu hin qabu. Wanti ati filattu maal iyyuu yoo ta'e, odeeffannoo gaarii fi kabaja argachuu qabda.

## Maaliif amma yaaduu?

Biyya alaatti doktara argachuun, ittisa ulfaa bitachuun ykn qorannoo fayyaa dhuunfaa gochuun ulfaachuu danda'a. Biyyoonni tokko tokkos waa'ee saal-qunnamtii fi ulfa gaa'ela alaa seera cimaa qabu (gadii ilaali). Itoophiyaa keessatti qophaa'uun to'annoo caalaa siif kenna.

## Filannoowwan ittisa ulfaa

Malli baay'een jira. Ogeessi fayyaa akka filattu si gargaaruu danda'a. [1]

- **Imiplaantii** (ulee xiqqaa irree keessa kaa'amu) fi **IUD** (meeshaa xiqqaa gadameessa keessa kaa'amu): baay'ee bu'a qabeeyyii dha, waggoota hedduuf turu. [1] Guyyaa guyyaan waan yaadattu hin qabdu.
- **Lilmoo**: yeroo isaatti yoo fudhatte gaarii hojjeta. [1] Biyya alaatti isa itti aanu argachuun ulfaachuu danda'a.
- **Kiniinii**: guyyaa guyyaan sirriitti yoo fudhatte gaarii hojjeta. [1]
- **Kondomii**: mala qofa dhukkuboota saalaan daddarban (STIs), HIV dabalatee, irraa si eegu dha. [1]

## Ittisa ulfaa yeroo hatattamaa

Yoo eegumsa malee saal-qunnamtii raawwatte, ykn eegumsi yoo hojii dide, ittisni ulfaa yeroo hatattamaa ulfa ittisuu danda'a. Hamma danda'ametti dafee, guyyaa 5 keessatti yoo fudhatame caalaatti hojjeta. [2] Kiniiniin yeroo hatattamaa ulfa **hin baasu**, ulfa duraan jalqabe illee miidhuu hin danda'u. [2] IUDn sibiila diimaa (kooppar) gosa bu'a qabeessa hunda caalu dha. [2]

## Itoophiyaa keessatti eessatti gargaarsa argatta

- **MSI Itoophiyaa** (Marie Stopes) ittisa ulfaa fi tajaajila fayyaa saalaa biroo ni kenna. Naannolee 11 keessatti hojjeta. [3]
- **Waldaan Qajeelcha Maatii Itoophiyaa (FGAE)** ittisa ulfaa, tajaajila dargaggootaaf mijatu, fi tajaajila HIV fi dhukkuboota saalaan daddarbanii ni kenna. Finfinnee, Adaamaa, Harar, Maqaleetti, Dessee, Baahir Daar, Hawaasaa fi Jimmaatti kiliinikoota qaba. [4]
- Buufata fayyaa ykn kiliinika ati amantu keessattis gaafachuu dandeessa.

Odeeffannoo quunnamtii isaanii **galmee gargaarsaa** keessaa barbaadi.

## Seerota waa'ee ulfaa biyya alaa

Biyyoota itti deemamu tokko tokko keessatti saal-qunnamtiin gaa'ela alaa yakka dha. Qaxar keessatti saal-qunnamtiin gaa'ela alaa seeraan ala dha; dubartiin tokko gaa'ela alaa yoo ulfoofte, lamaan isaaniiyyuu hidhaa ykn biyyaa ari'amuun isaan mudachuu danda'a. [6] Human Rights Watch akka jedhutti, Qaxar keessatti hospitaalonni dubartoota ulfa qaban kan hin heerumne aangawootaaf gabaasuu qabu; ulfi sun gudeeddii irraa yoo dhufellee dubartittiin hidhamuu dandeessi. [5]

Kana kan siif himnu si eeguuf malee sirratti murteessuuf miti. Seerri biyya biyyaan adda, ni jijjiirama illee.

## Namni tokko yoo si miidhe

Namni kamiyyuu yoo si dirqisiise ykn fedhii kee malee si tuqe, kun **gonkumaa dogoggora kee miti**. Kunuunsa fi nageenya argachuu qabda.

## Maal gochuu dandeessa

1. Osoo hin deemin dura kiliinika deemi. Mala siif ta'u gaafadhu.
2. Yoo imiplaantii ykn IUD filatte, akka siif mijatu mirkaneeffachuuf dursii kaa'adhu.
3. Yoo barbaadde kondomii qabadhu.
4. Fayyaa kee beekuuf qorannoo HIV fi dhukkuboota saalaan daddarbanii gaafadhu.
5. Fuula "Mirgoota kee" kan biyya itti deemtuu dubbisi.
6. Yoo miidhamte, ykn biyya alaatti ulfa qabachuu kee yoo shakkite, balaa keessa yoo jirte **SOS** fayyadami, gargaarsa fayyaa fi seeraa nageenya qabuuf **galmee gargaarsaa** ilaali.

title.en: Copy your important documents
title.om: Ragaalee kee barbaachisoo garagalchi

summary.en: Take photos of your passport, visa, contract and other papers before you leave. Keep copies in safe places, and keep important numbers on paper too.
summary.am: ከመሄድሽ በፊት የፓስፖርትሽን፣ የቪዛሽን፣ የውልሽንና የሌሎች ሰነዶችሽን ፎቶ አንሺ። ቅጂዎቹን በደህና ቦታዎች አስቀምጪ፣ አስፈላጊ ቁጥሮችንም በወረቀት ያዢ።
summary.om: Osoo hin deemin dura suuraa paaspoortii, viizaa, waliigaltee fi ragaalee kee biroo kaasi. Garagalchoota bakka nagaa qabu kaa'i, lakkoofsota barbaachisoo waraqaa irrattis qabadhu.

body.en:
Papers can get lost, stolen or taken away. If you have copies, it is much easier to get help, prove who you are, and get new papers. Do this before you leave home.

## What to copy

Take a clear photo of each of these:

- your **passport** (the photo page and the visa page)
- your **visa** and any **work permit**
- your **contract**, every page [1]
- your Ethiopian **ID card** or kebele ID
- your **birth certificate** and any training certificates
- your **medical certificate**
- the **agency's licence**, name, address and phone number
- your **ticket**

Check that each photo is sharp and you can read every word.

## Write numbers on paper

Your phone can break, run out of battery, or be taken. Write these on a small piece of paper and keep it hidden in a safe place, like inside your clothes or bag:

- two or three family phone numbers
- your trusted person's number
- the Ethiopian embassy or consulate number in the country you are going to (find it in the **help directory** in this app)
- your agency's number
- your employer's name and address, when you know it

## Your papers belong to you

You have the right to keep your passport, residence permit and work permit in a safe place of your choice. [1] Fair recruitment rules say workers' identity documents and contracts should not be taken, destroyed or kept by others. [2]

Do not give your **original** passport or ID to a broker or to anyone you do not trust. If someone needs to see it, show it, or give a copy.

## What you can do

1. Take photos of all your papers. Do it today, not at the airport.
2. Print one set of copies. Give it to your trusted person at home.
3. Keep a second paper set in your bag, separate from the originals.
4. Save the photos in a safe online place with a strong password, such as your email. Then you can open them from any phone.
5. Write the important numbers on paper too.
6. If your passport is ever taken from you, read "My employer took my passport" in this app, and contact your embassy. Look in the **help directory** for the number.
body.am:
ሰነዶች ሊጠፉ፣ ሊሰረቁ ወይም ሊወሰዱ ይችላሉ። ቅጂዎች ካሉሽ እርዳታ ማግኘት፣ ማንነትሽን ማረጋገጥና አዲስ ሰነድ ማውጣት በጣም ይቀልልሻል። ይህን ከቤትሽ ከመውጣትሽ በፊት አድርጊው።

## ምን መቅዳት አለብሽ

የእያንዳንዳቸውን ግልጽ ፎቶ አንሺ፦

- **ፓስፖርትሽ** (የፎቶ ገጹና የቪዛ ገጹ)
- **ቪዛሽ** እና ማንኛውም **የሥራ ፈቃድ**
- **ውልሽ**፣ ሁሉንም ገጾች [1]
- የኢትዮጵያ **መታወቂያሽ** ወይም የቀበሌ መታወቂያ
- **የልደት ሰርተፊኬትሽ** እና ማንኛውም የሥልጠና ሰርተፊኬት
- **የሕክምና ሰርተፊኬትሽ**
- **የኤጀንሲውን ፈቃድ**፣ ስም፣ አድራሻና ስልክ ቁጥር
- **ትኬትሽ**

እያንዳንዱ ፎቶ ጥርት ያለ መሆኑንና እያንዳንዱን ቃል ማንበብ እንደምትችዪ አረጋግጪ።

## ቁጥሮችን በወረቀት ላይ ጻፊ

ስልክሽ ሊሰበር፣ ባትሪው ሊያልቅ ወይም ሊወሰድ ይችላል። እነዚህን በትንሽ ወረቀት ላይ ጽፈሽ በልብስሽ ወይም በቦርሳሽ ውስጥ በደህና ቦታ ደብቂው፦

- የሁለት ወይም የሦስት የቤተሰብ አባላት ስልክ ቁጥር
- የምታምኚው ሰው ቁጥር
- በምትሄጂበት አገር ያለው የኢትዮጵያ ኤምባሲ ወይም ቆንስላ ቁጥር (በዚህ መተግበሪያ **የእርዳታ ማውጫ** ውስጥ ፈልጊው)
- የኤጀንሲሽ ቁጥር
- ስታውቂው፣ የአሠሪሽ ስምና አድራሻ

## ሰነዶችሽ የአንቺ ናቸው

ፓስፖርትሽን፣ የመኖሪያ ፈቃድሽንና የሥራ ፈቃድሽን በመረጥሽው ደህና ቦታ የማስቀመጥ መብት አለሽ። [1] የፍትሐዊ ቅጥር ደንቦች የሠራተኞች የማንነት ሰነዶችና ውሎች በሌሎች መወሰድ፣ መጥፋት ወይም መያዝ እንደሌለባቸው ይገልጻሉ። [2]

**ዋናውን** ፓስፖርትሽን ወይም መታወቂያሽን ለደላላ ወይም ለማታምኚው ሰው አትስጪ። አንድ ሰው ማየት ካስፈለገው፣ አሳዪው ወይም ቅጂውን ስጪ።

## ምን ማድረግ ትችያለሽ

1. የሰነዶችሽን ሁሉ ፎቶ አንሺ። ዛሬ አድርጊው፣ አውሮፕላን ጣቢያ ላይ አይደለም።
2. አንድ ዙር ቅጂ አትሚ። በአገር ቤት ላለው የምታምኚው ሰው ስጪ።
3. ሁለተኛ የወረቀት ቅጂ ከዋናዎቹ ለይተሽ በቦርሳሽ ያዢ።
4. ፎቶዎቹን ጠንካራ የይለፍ ቃል ባለው ደህና የኢንተርኔት ቦታ፣ ለምሳሌ በኢሜይልሽ አስቀምጪ። ከዚያ ከማንኛውም ስልክ ልትከፍቻቸው ትችያለሽ።
5. አስፈላጊ ቁጥሮችን በወረቀትም ጻፊ።
6. ፓስፖርትሽ ከተወሰደብሽ፣ በዚህ መተግበሪያ "አሠሪዬ ፓስፖርቴን ወሰደብኝ" የሚለውን አንብቢ፣ እና ኤምባሲሽን አግኚ። ቁጥሩን **በእርዳታ ማውጫው** ውስጥ ፈልጊ።
body.om:
Ragaaleen bada'uu, hatamuu ykn fudhatamuu danda'u. Garagalcha yoo qabaatte, gargaarsa argachuun, eenyummaa kee mirkaneessuun fi ragaa haaraa baafachuun baay'ee siif salphata. Kana osoo mana keessaa hin ba'in dura godhi.

## Maal garagalchuu qabda

Tokkoon tokkoo isaanii suuraa ifa ta'e kaasi:

- **paaspoortii kee** (fuula suuraa fi fuula viizaa)
- **viizaa kee** fi **hayyama hojii** kamiyyuu
- **waliigaltee kee**, fuula hunda [1]
- **waraqaa eenyummaa** Itoophiyaa ykn kan gandaa
- **ragaa dhalootaa** fi ragaa leenjii kamiyyuu
- **ragaa fayyaa (meedikaalaa)**
- **hayyama ejansichaa**, maqaa, teessoo fi lakkoofsa bilbilaa
- **tikeetii kee**

Suuraan hundi ifa ta'uu fi jecha hunda dubbisuu dandeessu mirkaneessi.

## Lakkoofsota waraqaa irratti barreessi

Bilbilli kee cabuu, baatiriin isaa dhumuu ykn fudhatamuu danda'a. Kanneen kana waraqaa xiqqaa irratti barreessii uffata ykn boorsaa kee keessa bakka nagaa qabu dhoksi:

- lakkoofsa bilbilaa maatii lama ykn sadii
- lakkoofsa nama amanattuu
- lakkoofsa embaasii ykn qonsilaa Itoophiyaa kan biyya itti deemtu keessa jiru (appii kana keessa **galmee gargaarsaa** irraa barbaadi)
- lakkoofsa ejansii kee
- yeroo beektu, maqaa fi teessoo hojjechiisaa kee

## Ragaaleen kee kan kee ti

Paaspoortii, hayyama jireenyaa fi hayyama hojii kee bakka nagaa ati filatte kaa'uuf mirga qabda. [1] Seerri qacarrii haqa qabeessaa ragaaleen eenyummaa fi waliigalteewwan hojjettootaa namoota biraan fudhatamuu, balleeffamuu ykn qabamuu akka hin qabne ibsa. [2]

Paaspoortii ykn waraqaa eenyummaa kee **isa dhugaa (orjinaalii)** deelaalaaf ykn nama ati hin amanneef hin kennin. Namni tokko ilaaluu yoo barbaade, itti agarsiisi ykn garagalcha kenni.

## Maal gochuu dandeessa

1. Ragaalee kee hunda suuraa kaasi. Har'a godhi, buufata xiyyaaraatti miti.
2. Garagalcha tokko maxxansi. Nama amanattu kan biyya keessa jiruuf kenni.
3. Garagalcha waraqaa lammaffaa isa dhugaa irraa addaan baasii boorsaa kee keessa qabadhu.
4. Suuraawwan bakka interneetii nageenya qabu, kan jecha icciitii cimaa qabu, fakkeenyaaf iimeelii kee keessa olkaa'i. Achiis bilbila kamiin iyyuu banuu dandeessa.
5. Lakkoofsota barbaachisoo waraqaa irrattis barreessi.
6. Yoo paaspoortiin kee sirraa fudhatame, appii kana keessaa "Hojjechiisaan koo paaspoortii koo fudhate" kan jedhu dubbisi, embaasii kees qunnami. Lakkoofsa isaa **galmee gargaarsaa** keessaa barbaadi.

summary.en: You will need a medical check before you go. Plan for your medicines, because some medicines are controlled in Gulf countries.
summary.am: ከመሄድሽ በፊት የሕክምና ምርመራ ያስፈልግሻል። አንዳንድ መድኃኒቶች በገልፍ አገሮች ቁጥጥር ስለሚደረግባቸው ለመድኃኒቶችሽ አስቀድመሽ አቅጂ።

body.en:
Your health is the most important thing you take with you. A little planning now can save you a lot of worry later.

## The medical check before you go

You must have a medical examination at a health centre chosen by the Ethiopian government, and get a medical certificate. [2] Under the law, the worker usually pays the medical exam fee and vaccination fee. [2]

If you are going to a Gulf country (Saudi Arabia, UAE, Kuwait, Qatar), the check is part of the **Wafid** programme of the Gulf Health Council. Wafid checks that workers are fit to work and free from certain infectious and long-term illnesses. It uses clinical checks, lab tests and X-rays, and gives a health certificate with a barcode. [1]

Ask the clinic which tests they will do and what the results mean. You have the right to understand your own results.

## Existing illness and medicines

If you have an illness like asthma, diabetes, epilepsy, high blood pressure or HIV, or you take medicine every day, plan before you go.

- Ask your doctor for a **written prescription** in English.
- Ask your doctor whether your medicine is a **controlled medicine**.
- Some medicines that are legal in Ethiopia are **illegal** in some Gulf countries. For example, some medicines that are legal in other countries are illegal in Qatar. [4]
- In the UAE, you must carry a prescription for the medicine you bring. Controlled medicines need approval from the Ministry of Health **before** you travel. [3]

Never carry medicine for another person, even a small packet. Never carry anything if you do not know what it is.

## Health care abroad

Your employer should give you access to health care and medicine, and should buy life and disability insurance for you. [2] Ask your agency what health care and insurance your contract includes, and write it down.

## What you can do

1. Go to your medical check. Ask what each test is for.
2. Keep a photo of your medical certificate.
3. If you take medicine, get a prescription and ask if it is controlled.
4. Check the rules of your destination country before you pack any medicine. The embassy of that country can advise you. [3]
5. Ask your agency about health insurance and how to see a doctor abroad.
6. Think about contraception and sexual health before you go. Read "Contraception and sexual health before you go".
7. If you get sick abroad, read the "Sick or injured" article in this app and look in the **help directory**.
body.am:
ጤናሽ ይዘሽው የምትሄጂው ከሁሉ የበለጠ አስፈላጊ ነገር ነው። አሁን ትንሽ ማቀድ በኋላ ብዙ ጭንቀት ያድንሻል።

## ከመሄድሽ በፊት የሚደረግ የሕክምና ምርመራ

የኢትዮጵያ መንግሥት በመረጠው የጤና ተቋም የሕክምና ምርመራ ማድረግና የሕክምና ሰርተፊኬት ማግኘት አለብሽ። [2] በሕጉ መሠረት፣ የሕክምና ምርመራና የክትባት ክፍያን ብዙውን ጊዜ ሠራተኛዋ ትከፍላለች። [2]

ወደ ገልፍ አገር (ሳዑዲ አረቢያ፣ የተባበሩት አረብ ኤሚሬቶች፣ ኩዌት፣ ኳታር) የምትሄጂ ከሆነ፣ ምርመራው የገልፍ ጤና ምክር ቤት **ዋፊድ (Wafid)** ፕሮግራም አካል ነው። ዋፊድ ሠራተኞች ለሥራ ብቁ መሆናቸውንና ከአንዳንድ ተላላፊና የረጅም ጊዜ በሽታዎች ነፃ መሆናቸውን ያረጋግጣል። የሐኪም ምርመራ፣ የላብራቶሪ ምርመራና ራጅ ይጠቀማል፤ ባርኮድ ያለው የጤና ሰርተፊኬትም ይሰጣል። [1]

ክሊኒኩ ምን ምን ምርመራ እንደሚያደርግና ውጤቱ ምን ማለት እንደሆነ ጠይቂ። የራስሽን ውጤት የመረዳት መብት አለሽ።

## ያለብሽ ሕመምና መድኃኒቶች

እንደ አስም፣ የስኳር በሽታ፣ የሚጥል በሽታ፣ የደም ግፊት ወይም ኤች አይ ቪ ያለ ሕመም ካለብሽ፣ ወይም በየቀኑ መድኃኒት የምትወስጂ ከሆነ፣ ከመሄድሽ በፊት እቅድ አውጪ።

- ሐኪምሽን በእንግሊዝኛ የተጻፈ **የሐኪም ማዘዣ** ጠይቂ።
- መድኃኒትሽ **ቁጥጥር የሚደረግበት መድኃኒት** መሆኑን ሐኪምሽን ጠይቂ።
- በኢትዮጵያ ሕጋዊ የሆኑ አንዳንድ መድኃኒቶች በአንዳንድ የገልፍ አገሮች **ሕገ ወጥ** ናቸው። ለምሳሌ፣ በሌሎች አገሮች ሕጋዊ የሆኑ አንዳንድ መድኃኒቶች በኳታር ሕገ ወጥ ናቸው። [4]
- በተባበሩት አረብ ኤሚሬቶች፣ ለምትይዢው መድኃኒት የሐኪም ማዘዣ መያዝ አለብሽ። ቁጥጥር የሚደረግባቸው መድኃኒቶች ከመጓዝሽ **በፊት** ከጤና ሚኒስቴር ፈቃድ ያስፈልጋቸዋል። [3]

ለሌላ ሰው መድኃኒት በፍጹም አትያዢ፣ ትንሽ እሽግ ቢሆንም። ምን እንደሆነ የማታውቂውን ነገር በፍጹም አትያዢ።

## በውጭ አገር የጤና አገልግሎት

አሠሪሽ የጤና አገልግሎትና መድኃኒት እንድታገኚ ማድረግ፣ እንዲሁም የሕይወትና የአካል ጉዳት ኢንሹራንስ ሊገዛልሽ ይገባል። [2] ውልሽ ምን ዓይነት የጤና አገልግሎትና ኢንሹራንስ እንደሚያካትት ኤጀንሲሽን ጠይቂና ጻፊው።

## ምን ማድረግ ትችያለሽ

1. ወደ ሕክምና ምርመራሽ ሂጂ። እያንዳንዱ ምርመራ ለምን እንደሆነ ጠይቂ።
2. የሕክምና ሰርተፊኬትሽን ፎቶ ያዢ።
3. መድኃኒት የምትወስጂ ከሆነ፣ የሐኪም ማዘዣ ውሰጂና ቁጥጥር የሚደረግበት መሆኑን ጠይቂ።
4. ማንኛውንም መድኃኒት ከማሸግሽ በፊት የምትሄጂበትን አገር ሕግ አረጋግጪ። የዚያ አገር ኤምባሲ ሊመክርሽ ይችላል። [3]
5. ስለ ጤና ኢንሹራንስና በውጭ አገር ሐኪም እንዴት እንደምታዪ ኤጀንሲሽን ጠይቂ።
6. ከመሄድሽ በፊት ስለ ወሊድ መከላከያና ስለ ሥነ ተዋልዶ ጤና አስቢ። "ከመሄድሽ በፊት የወሊድ መከላከያና የሥነ ተዋልዶ ጤና" የሚለውን አንብቢ።
7. በውጭ አገር ከታመምሽ፣ በዚህ መተግበሪያ "መታመም ወይም መጎዳት" የሚለውን ጽሑፍ አንብቢና **የእርዳታ ማውጫውን** ተመልከቺ።
body.om:
Fayyaan kee waan ati of faana fudhattu hunda caalaa barbaachisaa dha. Amma xiqqoo karoorfachuun booda yaaddoo baay'ee irraa si oolcha.

## Qorannoo fayyaa osoo hin deemin dura

Dhaabbata fayyaa mootummaan Itoophiyaa filate keessatti qorannoo fayyaa gochuu fi ragaa fayyaa argachuu qabda. [2] Akka seeraatti, kaffaltii qorannoo fayyaa fi talaallii yeroo baay'ee hojjettuun ofii kaffalti. [2]

Yoo gara biyya Galoo (Saawud Arabiyaa, Imireetota Arabaa Gamtoomanii, Kuweet, Qaxar) deemte, qorannoon kun kutaa sagantaa **Wafid** kan Mana Maree Fayyaa Galoo ti. Wafid hojjettoonni hojiif fayya qabeessa ta'uu fi dhukkuboota daddarboo fi yeroo dheeraa tokko tokko irraa bilisa ta'uu isaanii mirkaneessa. Qorannoo ogeessaa, laaboraatorii fi raajii fayyadama; ragaa fayyaa baarkoodii qabu ni kenna. [1]

Kiliinikichi qorannoo maal maal akka godhuu fi bu'aan isaa maal jechuu akka ta'e gaafadhu. Bu'aa kee ofii hubachuuf mirga qabda.

## Dhukkuba qabdu fi qoricha

Yoo dhukkuba akka asmii, sukkaaraa, dhukkuba kufaa, dhiibbaa dhiigaa ykn HIV qabaatte, ykn guyyaa guyyaan qoricha fudhatta ta'e, osoo hin deemin dura karoorfadhu.

- Doktara kee **ajaja qorichaa (preskiripshinii) barreeffame** Afaan Ingiliziin gaafadhu.
- Qorichi kee **qoricha to'annoo jala jiru** ta'uu isaa doktara kee gaafadhu.
- Qorichoonni Itoophiyaa keessatti seera qabeessa ta'an tokko tokko biyyoota Galoo tokko tokko keessatti **seeraan ala** dha. Fakkeenyaaf, qorichoonni biyyoota biroo keessatti seera qabeessa ta'an tokko tokko Qaxar keessatti seeraan ala dha. [4]
- Imireetota Arabaa Gamtoomanii keessatti, qoricha fudhattuuf ajaja qorichaa qabachuu qabda. Qorichoonni to'annoo jala jiran osoo hin imaliin **dura** Ministeera Fayyaa irraa hayyama barbaadu. [3]

Qoricha nama biraa gonkumaa hin baatin, paakeejii xiqqaa ta'ullee. Waan maal akka ta'e hin beekne gonkumaa hin baatin.

## Tajaajila fayyaa biyya alaa

Hojjechiisaan kee tajaajila fayyaa fi qoricha akka argattu gochuu, akkasumas inshuraansii lubbuu fi miidhaa qaamaa siif bituu qaba. [2] Waliigalteen kee tajaajila fayyaa fi inshuraansii akkamii akka of keessaa qabu ejansii kee gaafadhuu barreeffadhu.

## Maal gochuu dandeessa

1. Qorannoo fayyaa keetiif deemi. Qorannoon tokkoon tokkoon maaliif akka ta'e gaafadhu.
2. Suuraa ragaa fayyaa kee qabadhu.
3. Yoo qoricha fudhatta ta'e, ajaja qorichaa fudhadhuu to'annoo jala jiraachuu isaa gaafadhu.
4. Qoricha kamiyyuu osoo hin qabatin dura seera biyya itti deemtuu mirkaneessi. Embaasiin biyya sanaa si gorsuu danda'a. [3]
5. Waa'ee inshuraansii fayyaa fi biyya alaatti akkamitti doktara akka argattu ejansii kee gaafadhu.
6. Osoo hin deemin dura waa'ee ittisa ulfaa fi fayyaa saalaa yaadi. "Ittisa ulfaa fi fayyaa saalaa osoo hin deemin dura" kan jedhu dubbisi.
7. Yoo biyya alaatti dhukkubsatte, appii kana keessaa barreeffama "Dhukkubsachuu ykn miidhamuu" jedhu dubbisi, **galmee gargaarsaa** illee ilaali.

title.en: Laws that may be different abroad
title.om: Seerota biyya alaatti adda ta'uu danda'an

summary.en: Some things that are normal at home can be against the law in your new country. Knowing the main rules helps you stay safe.
summary.am: በአገር ቤት የተለመዱ አንዳንድ ነገሮች በአዲሱ አገርሽ ሕግን የሚጥሱ ሊሆኑ ይችላሉ። ዋና ዋናዎቹን ደንቦች ማወቅ ደህንነትሽን ይጠብቃል።
summary.om: Wantoonni biyya keessatti baramoo ta'an tokko tokko biyya kee haaraa keessatti seeraan ala ta'uu danda'u. Seerota ijoo beekuun nageenya kee eega.

body.en:
Every country has its own laws. Some things that are normal in Ethiopia may be a crime where you are going. This is not to scare you. It is so you can protect yourself.

## Relationships and sex

In some destination countries, sex outside marriage is against the law. In Saudi Arabia, sex outside marriage is illegal, and serious cases can lead to prison or deportation. [1] In Qatar, sex outside marriage and living together without marriage are illegal. If a woman becomes pregnant outside marriage, both partners could face prison or deportation. [2]

Read "Contraception and sexual health before you go" for more.

## Alcohol and drugs

In Saudi Arabia, alcohol is illegal, and there is zero tolerance for drugs. Even a small amount can mean prison. [1] Qatar also has zero tolerance for drugs. [2]

Never carry a parcel or bag for someone else, even a friend. You cannot know what is inside.

## Medicines

Some medicines that are legal at home are illegal in Gulf countries. [2] In the UAE, controlled medicines need approval before you travel, and you must carry a prescription. [4] Read "Getting ready for your health".

## Photos and social media

- Only take photos of people if they say yes. In Qatar, taking or sharing pictures of people without their consent can lead to prison. [2] Saudi Arabia also asks you to get consent first. [1]
- Do not post photos of your employer, their children or their home.
- Be careful what you post or share online. In Saudi Arabia, posts seen as disturbing public order can bring long prison sentences, and old posts can count too. [1] In Qatar, people have been prosecuted for posts that seem to insult others. [2]

## Dress

In Saudi Arabia, men and women should wear loose clothes that cover the elbows and knees in public. [1] Ask your agency what is expected where you will live.

## "Absconding" reports

In Saudi Arabia, a worker who leaves her employer without permission can be reported for **"absconding"** and can face prison and deportation, even if she was escaping abuse. Some employers make false reports to avoid paying wages. [3] This is unfair, and it is not your fault. If you ever need to leave a bad employer, plan it safely. Read "Leaving a bad employer" and contact your embassy or a trusted organisation first if you can.

## Your ID

Carry your ID card with you. [5] Keep photos of all your papers. Read "Copy your important documents".

## What you can do

1. Before you travel, read the "Your rights" page for your country.
2. Do not carry anything for anyone else.
3. Ask before taking photos of people. Think before you post.
4. If you are arrested or in trouble with the police, stay calm. Ask to contact your embassy.
5. Find your embassy and legal help in the **help directory**. Use **SOS** if you are in danger.
body.am:
እያንዳንዱ አገር የራሱ ሕግ አለው። በኢትዮጵያ የተለመዱ አንዳንድ ነገሮች በምትሄጂበት አገር ወንጀል ሊሆኑ ይችላሉ። ይህ ልናስፈራራሽ አይደለም። ራስሽን እንድትጠብቂ ነው።

## ግንኙነትና ወሲብ

በአንዳንድ የመዳረሻ አገሮች ከጋብቻ ውጭ ወሲብ ሕግን የሚጥስ ነው። በሳዑዲ አረቢያ ከጋብቻ ውጭ ወሲብ ሕገ ወጥ ነው፤ ከባድ ጉዳዮች እስር ወይም ከአገር መባረር ሊያስከትሉ ይችላሉ። [1] በኳታር ከጋብቻ ውጭ ወሲብና ሳይጋቡ አብሮ መኖር ሕገ ወጥ ናቸው። አንዲት ሴት ከጋብቻ ውጭ ካረገዘች፣ ሁለቱም ወገኖች እስር ወይም ከአገር መባረር ሊደርስባቸው ይችላል። [2]

ለበለጠ መረጃ "ከመሄድሽ በፊት የወሊድ መከላከያና የሥነ ተዋልዶ ጤና" የሚለውን አንብቢ።

## አልኮልና አደንዛዥ ዕፅ

በሳዑዲ አረቢያ አልኮል ሕገ ወጥ ነው፤ ለአደንዛዥ ዕፅ ደግሞ ምንም ትዕግሥት የለም። ትንሽ መጠን እንኳ እስር ሊያስከትል ይችላል። [1] ኳታርም ለአደንዛዥ ዕፅ ምንም ትዕግሥት የላትም። [2]

ለሌላ ሰው እሽግ ወይም ቦርሳ በፍጹም አትያዢ፣ ጓደኛሽም ቢሆን። ውስጡ ምን እንዳለ ማወቅ አትችዪም።

## መድኃኒቶች

በአገር ቤት ሕጋዊ የሆኑ አንዳንድ መድኃኒቶች በገልፍ አገሮች ሕገ ወጥ ናቸው። [2] በተባበሩት አረብ ኤሚሬቶች ቁጥጥር የሚደረግባቸው መድኃኒቶች ከጉዞ በፊት ፈቃድ ያስፈልጋቸዋል፤ የሐኪም ማዘዣም መያዝ አለብሽ። [4] "ለጤናሽ መዘጋጀት" የሚለውን አንብቢ።

## ፎቶና ማኅበራዊ ሚዲያ

- የሰዎችን ፎቶ የምታነሺው እነሱ ሲፈቅዱ ብቻ ነው። በኳታር ያለ ፈቃዳቸው የሰዎችን ፎቶ ማንሳት ወይም ማጋራት እስር ሊያስከትል ይችላል። [2] ሳዑዲ አረቢያም አስቀድመሽ ፈቃድ እንድትጠይቂ ትጠይቃለች። [1]
- የአሠሪሽን፣ የልጆቻቸውን ወይም የቤታቸውን ፎቶ አትለጥፊ።
- በኢንተርኔት የምትለጥፊውንና የምታጋሪውን ተጠንቀቂ። በሳዑዲ አረቢያ የሕዝብን ሰላም የሚያውኩ ተብለው የሚታዩ ጽሑፎች ረጅም እስር ሊያስከትሉ ይችላሉ፤ የቆዩ ጽሑፎችም ሊቆጠሩ ይችላሉ። [1] በኳታር ሌሎችን የሚሰድቡ የሚመስሉ ጽሑፎችን በለጠፉ ሰዎች ላይ ክስ ተመሥርቷል። [2]

## አለባበስ

በሳዑዲ አረቢያ ወንዶችም ሴቶችም በሕዝብ ቦታ ክርንንና ጉልበትን የሚሸፍን ሰፊ ልብስ መልበስ አለባቸው። [1] በምትኖሪበት ቦታ ምን እንደሚጠበቅ ኤጀንሲሽን ጠይቂ።

## "ጠፍታለች" የሚል ሪፖርት

በሳዑዲ አረቢያ ያለ ፈቃድ አሠሪዋን የምትለቅ ሠራተኛ **"ጠፍታለች (absconding)"** ተብላ ሪፖርት ልትደረግና እስርና ከአገር መባረር ሊደርስባት ይችላል፣ ከጥቃት እየሸሸች ቢሆንም እንኳ። አንዳንድ አሠሪዎች ደመወዝ ላለመክፈል የሐሰት ሪፖርት ያቀርባሉ። [3] ይህ ፍትሐዊ አይደለም፣ ያንቺም ጥፋት አይደለም። መጥፎ አሠሪን መልቀቅ ካስፈለገሽ፣ በደህንነት አቅጅ። "መጥፎ አሠሪን መልቀቅ" የሚለውን አንብቢ፣ ከተቻለም አስቀድመሽ ኤምባሲሽን ወይም የምታምኚውን ድርጅት አግኚ።

## መታወቂያሽ

መታወቂያሽን ሁልጊዜ ይዘሽ ሂጂ። [5] የሰነዶችሽን ሁሉ ፎቶ ያዢ። "አስፈላጊ ሰነዶችሽን ቅጂ" የሚለውን አንብቢ።

## ምን ማድረግ ትችያለሽ

1. ከመጓዝሽ በፊት ለአገርሽ ያለውን "መብቶችሽ" የሚለውን ገጽ አንብቢ።
2. ለማንም ሰው ምንም ነገር አትያዢ።
3. የሰዎችን ፎቶ ከማንሳትሽ በፊት ጠይቂ። ከመለጠፍሽ በፊት አስቢ።
4. ከታሰርሽ ወይም ከፖሊስ ጋር ችግር ከገጠመሽ፣ ተረጋጊ። ኤምባሲሽን ማግኘት እንደምትፈልጊ ጠይቂ።
5. ኤምባሲሽንና የሕግ እርዳታ **በእርዳታ ማውጫው** ውስጥ ፈልጊ። አደጋ ላይ ከሆንሽ **SOS** ተጠቀሚ።
body.om:
Biyyi hundi seera mataa isaa qaba. Wantoonni Itoophiyaa keessatti baramoo ta'an tokko tokko biyya ati itti deemtu keessatti yakka ta'uu danda'u. Kun si sodaachisuuf miti. Akka ofii kee eegduuf.

## Hariiroo fi saal-qunnamtii

Biyyoota itti deemamu tokko tokko keessatti saal-qunnamtiin gaa'ela alaa seeraan ala dha. Saawud Arabiyaa keessatti saal-qunnamtiin gaa'ela alaa seeraan ala dha; dhimmoonni cimoon hidhaa ykn biyyaa ari'amuu fiduu danda'u. [1] Qaxar keessatti saal-qunnamtiin gaa'ela alaa fi osoo hin fuudhin/heerumin waliin jiraachuun seeraan ala dha. Dubartiin tokko gaa'ela alaa yoo ulfoofte, lamaan isaaniiyyuu hidhaa ykn biyyaa ari'amuun isaan mudachuu danda'a. [2]

Odeeffannoo dabalataaf "Ittisa ulfaa fi fayyaa saalaa osoo hin deemin dura" dubbisi.

## Alkoolii fi araada

Saawud Arabiyaa keessatti alkooliin seeraan ala dha; araadaaf immoo obsi tokkollee hin jiru. Hamma xiqqaan illee hidhaa fiduu danda'a. [1] Qaxar illee araadaaf obsa tokkollee hin qabdu. [2]

Paakeejii ykn boorsaa nama biraa gonkumaa hin baatin, hiriyyaa kee ta'ullee. Waan keessa jiru beekuu hin dandeessu.

## Qorichoota

Qorichoonni biyya keessatti seera qabeessa ta'an tokko tokko biyyoota Galoo keessatti seeraan ala dha. [2] Imireetota Arabaa Gamtoomanii keessatti qorichoonni to'annoo jala jiran osoo hin imaliin dura hayyama barbaadu, ajaja qorichaas qabachuu qabda. [4] "Fayyaa keetiif qophaa'uu" kan jedhu dubbisi.

## Suuraa fi miidiyaa hawaasaa

- Suuraa namootaa kan kaaftu yoo isaan eeyyaman qofa. Qaxar keessatti suuraa namootaa eeyyama isaanii malee kaasuun ykn qooduun hidhaa fiduu danda'a. [2] Saawud Arabiyaanis dursitee eeyyama akka gaafattu si gaafatti. [1]
- Suuraa hojjechiisaa kee, daa'imman isaanii ykn mana isaanii hin maxxansin.
- Waan interneetii irratti maxxansitu ykn qooddu irratti of eeggadhu. Saawud Arabiyaa keessatti barreeffamoonni nagaa uummataa jeequ jedhamanii ilaalaman hidhaa dheeraa fiduu danda'u; barreeffamoonni duraaniis lakkaa'amuu danda'u. [1] Qaxar keessatti namoonni barreeffama namoota biroo arrabsuu fakkaatu maxxansan himatamaniiru. [2]

## Uffannaa

Saawud Arabiyaa keessatti dhiiraa fi dubartiin bakka uummataatti uffata bal'aa irree fi jilba haguugu uffachuu qabu. [1] Bakka ati jiraattutti maaltu akka eegamu ejansii kee gaafadhu.

## Gabaasa "baqatte (absconding)"

Saawud Arabiyaa keessatti hojjettuun eeyyama malee hojjechiisaa ishee dhiiste **"baqatte (absconding)"** jedhamtee gabaafamuu, hidhaa fi biyyaa ari'amuun ishee mudachuu danda'a, yoo miidhaa jalaa baqachaa jirte illee. Hojjechiisaan tokko tokko mindaa kaffaluu dhiisuuf gabaasa sobaa dhiheessu. [3] Kun haqa miti, dogoggora kees miti. Yoo hojjechiisaa hamaa dhiisuun si barbaachise, nageenyaan karoorfadhu. "Hojjechiisaa hamaa dhiisuu" dubbisi, yoo danda'ame dursitee embaasii kee ykn dhaabbata ati amantu qunnami.

## Waraqaa eenyummaa kee

Waraqaa eenyummaa kee yeroo hunda of harkaa qabadhu. [5] Ragaalee kee hunda suuraa qabadhu. "Ragaalee kee barbaachisoo garagalchi" dubbisi.

## Maal gochuu dandeessa

1. Osoo hin imaliin dura fuula "Mirgoota kee" kan biyya keetii dubbisi.
2. Nama kamiifuu waan tokkollee hin baatin.
3. Suuraa namootaa osoo hin kaasin dura gaafadhu. Osoo hin maxxansin dura yaadi.
4. Yoo hidhamte ykn poolisii waliin rakkoon si mudate, tasgabbaa'i. Embaasii kee qunnamuu akka barbaaddu gaafadhu.
5. Embaasii kee fi gargaarsa seeraa **galmee gargaarsaa** keessaa barbaadi. Balaa keessa yoo jirte **SOS** fayyadami.

title.en: Licensed agencies and illegal brokers
title.am: ፈቃድ ያላቸው ኤጀንሲዎችና ሕገ ወጥ ደላሎች
title.om: Ejansiiwwan hayyama qaban fi deelaalota seeraan alaa

summary.en: Go abroad only through an agency licensed by the Ministry of Labour and Skills. Before you pay or sign anything, check that the agency is legal. Illegal brokers and smuggling routes put your life and your rights in danger.
summary.am: ወደ ውጭ አገር የምትሄጂው በሥራና ክህሎት ሚኒስቴር ፈቃድ በተሰጠው ኤጀንሲ በኩል ብቻ ይሁን። ምንም ከመክፈልሽ ወይም ከመፈረምሽ በፊት ኤጀንሲው ሕጋዊ መሆኑን አረጋግጪ። ሕገ ወጥ ደላሎችና የኮንትሮባንድ መንገዶች ሕይወትሽንና መብትሽን አደጋ ላይ ይጥላሉ።
summary.om: Biyya alaa kan deemtu ejansii Ministeerri Hojii fi Ogummaa hayyama kenneef qofaan haa ta'u. Osoo homaa hin kaffalin ykn hin mallatteessin dura, ejansichi seeraan kan hojjetu ta'uu isaa mirkaneeffadhu. Deelaalonni seeraan alaa fi karaan kontirobaandii lubbuu fi mirga kee balaa keessa galchu.

body.en:
Many women find work abroad through someone they know: a neighbour, a relative, a "broker" in town. These people may be kind. But only a **licensed agency** can legally send you abroad for domestic work. Choosing the safe way protects you if something goes wrong later. [5]

## Licensed agency or broker?

The law for working abroad is Ethiopia's Overseas Employment Proclamation No. 1389/2025. It replaced the older laws No. 923/2016 and No. 1246/2021. [5]

Under this law, only the **Ministry of Labour and Skills (MoLS)** can give an agency a licence to send workers abroad. Licences are handled through the government's Labour Market Information System (LMIS). [5]

- A licence lasts **one year**. The agency must renew it every year. [5]
- Agencies that had a licence under the old law had to get a new one within three months of the new law. If they did not, their old licence is no longer valid. So an old licence paper does not prove the agency is legal today. [5]
- When MoLS suspends or cancels a licence, it must tell the public. [5]

A licensed agency must:

- **not take any money or gifts from you** for finding you a job. An agency that does this can lose its licence. [5]
- show its MoLS licence on the wall of its office [5]
- never send anyone under 18 to work abroad [5]
- give you a contract in a language you understand, approved by MoLS before you travel [5]
- not keep your passport. If you ask for it, the agency must give it back within one week. [5]
- not work from a travel agency or a ticket office [5]

You pay only for your passport, police clearance, birth certificate, and your training and certificate of competence (COC). The employer pays for your visa, tickets, medical check, work permit and the other costs. [5]

A **broker** works outside these rules. Research with Ethiopian women found that many use local brokers because the legal way seems slow or costly. But brokers often make big promises that are not true. Women who travel this way are more at risk of trafficking and are cut off from official help when problems happen. [4]

## How to check if an agency is legal

Before you pay or sign anything:

1. **Ask to see the licence.** It must be on the wall of the office. Check the agency's name, the countries it may send workers to, and the date. A licence lasts only one year. [5]
2. **Ask MoLS.** Call the Ministry of Labour and Skills (its number is in the **help directory**), email **info@mols.gov.et**, or visit your regional labour office. Ask: "Is this agency licensed now?" [6] [5]
3. **Register in LMIS.** Make sure you are registered in the Labour Market Information System, starting at a One Stop Service Center. Hiring outside LMIS is not allowed. [5] [7]
4. **Check your contract is approved.** MoLS must approve your contract before you travel. [5]
5. **Use the LeMengede app.** This MoLS app has safe migration information, complaint information and an SOS feature. [8]

We could not find a public online list of licensed agencies yet. Until there is one, asking MoLS or your regional labour office is the safest way to check. You can also use the agency check in this app.

## Warning signs

Stop and ask MoLS if someone:

- asks you for money or gifts for the job [5]
- has no office or licence, will not show you the licence, or meets you in a cafe or on the street [10]
- works from a travel agency or a ticket office [5]
- offers you a tourist or visit visa to go and work [10]
- says you can skip the training, the COC or the medical check [10]
- tells you to say you are older than you are, or wants to send someone under 18 [5]
- wants to send you by road or boat, not by plane
- has no written contract for you, or says "sign now, read later"
- wants to keep your passport or ID [5]
- promises a salary that sounds too good to be true

None of this is your fault. These are tricks that many people fall for.

## The dangerous road through Djibouti and Yemen

Some brokers send people by land and sea through Djibouti or Somalia to Yemen, and then towards Saudi Arabia. This is sometimes called the "Eastern route". The UN migration agency (IOM) reports that people on this route face kidnapping, torture for ransom, exploitation and trafficking. Many cross deserts with little food or water. [3]

No job is worth this risk. You deserve to travel safely, by plane, with real papers.

## How to report an agency or a broker

You have the right to complain, even if you have already paid or signed.

- **Ministry of Labour and Skills:** you, your lawyer or a family member can complain about an agency, by speaking or in writing. If you speak, the officer must write it down and ask you to sign. The Ministry should decide within 15 working days. [5]
- **Regional labour offices** can also take complaints. [5]
- Complain within **three years**. After that, it may be too late. [5]
- If you think someone is trafficking or smuggling people, the free national anti-trafficking hotline **8797** gives information and free legal aid. It is also in the **help directory**. [9]

Bring what you have: receipts, messages, the agency's name and address, and the names of the people you met.

## What you can do

1. Ask for the agency's full name and licence. Check it with MoLS, or use the agency check in this app.
2. Visit the agency office yourself. Take a trusted person with you.
3. Do not pay money to anyone for the job. Ask MoLS what you should pay, if anything.
4. Go to the pre-departure training. Ask questions there.
5. Tell your trusted person the agency's name and address.
6. If someone is pushing you, threatening you, or holding your papers, look in the **help directory** for support in Ethiopia. If you are in danger, use **SOS**.
body.am:
ብዙ ሴቶች በውጭ አገር ሥራ የሚያገኙት በሚያውቁት ሰው በኩል ነው፤ በጎረቤት፣ በዘመድ ወይም በከተማው ባለ "ደላላ"። እነዚህ ሰዎች ደግ ሊሆኑ ይችላሉ። ነገር ግን ለቤት ሠራተኝነት በሕጋዊ መንገድ ወደ ውጭ ሊልክሽ የሚችለው **ፈቃድ ያለው ኤጀንሲ** ብቻ ነው። ደህንነቱ የተጠበቀውን መንገድ መምረጥ ወደፊት ችግር ቢፈጠር ይጠብቅሻል። [5]

## ፈቃድ ያለው ኤጀንሲ ወይስ ደላላ?

በውጭ አገር ለመሥራት የሚመለከተው ሕግ የኢትዮጵያ የውጭ አገር ሥራ ስምሪት አዋጅ ቁጥር 1389/2025 ነው። ይህ አዋጅ የቀድሞዎቹን አዋጅ ቁጥር 923/2016 እና 1246/2021 ተክቷል። [5]

በዚህ ሕግ መሠረት፣ ሠራተኞችን ወደ ውጭ የመላክ ፈቃድ ለኤጀንሲ መስጠት የሚችለው **የሥራና ክህሎት ሚኒስቴር (MoLS)** ብቻ ነው። ፈቃዶቹ የሚስተናገዱት በመንግሥት የሥራ ገበያ መረጃ ሥርዓት (LMIS) በኩል ነው። [5]

- ፈቃድ የሚያገለግለው **ለአንድ ዓመት** ብቻ ነው። ኤጀንሲው በየዓመቱ ማደስ አለበት። [5]
- በቀድሞው ሕግ ፈቃድ የነበራቸው ኤጀንሲዎች አዲሱ ሕግ ከወጣ በሦስት ወር ውስጥ አዲስ ፈቃድ ማውጣት ነበረባቸው። ካላወጡ የቀድሞው ፈቃዳቸው አይሠራም። ስለዚህ የድሮ የፈቃድ ወረቀት ኤጀንሲው ዛሬ ሕጋዊ መሆኑን አያረጋግጥም። [5]
- ሚኒስቴሩ የአንድን ኤጀንሲ ፈቃድ ሲያግድ ወይም ሲሰርዝ ለሕዝብ ማሳወቅ አለበት። [5]

ፈቃድ ያለው ኤጀንሲ፦

- ሥራ ስላገኘልሽ **ከአንቺ ምንም ገንዘብ ወይም ስጦታ መቀበል የለበትም**። ይህን ያደረገ ኤጀንሲ ፈቃዱን ሊያጣ ይችላል። [5]
- የሚኒስቴሩን ፈቃድ በቢሮው ግድግዳ ላይ ማሳየት አለበት [5]
- ዕድሜዋ ከ18 ዓመት በታች የሆነችን ማንንም ወደ ውጭ መላክ የለበትም [5]
- በምትረጂው ቋንቋ የተጻፈና ከመጓዝሽ በፊት በሚኒስቴሩ የጸደቀ ውል ሊሰጥሽ ይገባል [5]
- ፓስፖርትሽን መያዝ የለበትም። ከጠየቅሽው በአንድ ሳምንት ውስጥ መመለስ አለበት። [5]
- ከጉዞ ወኪል ወይም ከትኬት ቢሮ ውስጥ ሆኖ መሥራት የለበትም [5]

አንቺ የምትከፍዪው ለፓስፖርትሽ፣ ለፖሊስ ማስረጃ፣ ለልደት ሰርተፊኬት፣ እና ለሥልጠናሽና ለሙያ ብቃት ማረጋገጫ (COC) ብቻ ነው። ቪዛ፣ ትኬት፣ የሕክምና ምርመራ፣ የሥራ ፈቃድና ሌሎቹን ወጪዎች የሚከፍለው አሠሪው ነው። [5]

**ደላላ** ከእነዚህ ሕጎች ውጭ ይሠራል። ከኢትዮጵያውያን ሴቶች ጋር የተደረገ ጥናት እንደሚያሳየው፣ ሕጋዊው መንገድ የሚዘገይ ወይም ውድ ስለሚመስል ብዙዎች የአካባቢ ደላሎችን ይጠቀማሉ። ነገር ግን ደላሎች ብዙ ጊዜ እውነት ያልሆነ ትልቅ ተስፋ ይሰጣሉ። በዚህ መንገድ የሚሄዱ ሴቶች ለሰዎች ንግድ የበለጠ ተጋላጭ ናቸው፤ ችግር ሲደርስባቸውም ከመንግሥት እርዳታ ይርቃሉ። [4]

## ኤጀንሲው ሕጋዊ መሆኑን እንዴት ማረጋገጥ ትችያለሽ

ምንም ከመክፈልሽ ወይም ከመፈረምሽ በፊት፦

1. **ፈቃዱን እንዲያሳዩሽ ጠይቂ።** በቢሮው ግድግዳ ላይ መሆን አለበት። የኤጀንሲውን ስም፣ ሠራተኛ ሊልክባቸው የተፈቀደለትን አገሮችና ቀኑን ተመልከቺ። ፈቃድ የሚያገለግለው ለአንድ ዓመት ብቻ ነው። [5]
2. **ሚኒስቴሩን ጠይቂ።** ለሥራና ክህሎት ሚኒስቴር ደውዪ (ስልክ ቁጥሩ **በእርዳታ ማውጫው** ውስጥ አለ)፣ በ **info@mols.gov.et** ኢሜይል ላኪ፣ ወይም የክልልሽን የሥራ ቢሮ ጎብኚ። "ይህ ኤጀንሲ አሁን ፈቃድ አለው?" ብለሽ ጠይቂ። [6] [5]
3. **በLMIS ተመዝገቢ።** ከአንድ ማዕከል አገልግሎት (One Stop Service Center) ጀምሮ በሥራ ገበያ መረጃ ሥርዓት (LMIS) መመዝገብሽን አረጋግጪ። ከLMIS ውጭ የሚደረግ ቅጥር አይፈቀድም። [5] [7]
4. **ውልሽ መጽደቁን አረጋግጪ።** ከመጓዝሽ በፊት ሚኒስቴሩ ውልሽን ማጽደቅ አለበት። [5]
5. **የለመንገዴ (LeMengede) መተግበሪያን ተጠቀሚ።** ይህ የሚኒስቴሩ መተግበሪያ ስለ ደህንነቱ የተጠበቀ ፍልሰት፣ ስለ አቤቱታ አቀራረብ መረጃና የSOS አገልግሎት አለው። [8]

ፈቃድ ያላቸው ኤጀንሲዎች ዝርዝር በይፋ በኢንተርኔት ላይ እስካሁን አላገኘንም። ዝርዝሩ እስኪወጣ ድረስ ሚኒስቴሩን ወይም የክልልሽን የሥራ ቢሮ መጠየቅ በጣም አስተማማኙ መንገድ ነው። በዚህ መተግበሪያ ያለውን የኤጀንሲ ማረጋገጫም መጠቀም ትችያለሽ።

## የማስጠንቀቂያ ምልክቶች

አንድ ሰው እንዲህ ካደረገ ቆም ብለሽ ሚኒስቴሩን ጠይቂ፦

- ለሥራው ገንዘብ ወይም ስጦታ ከጠየቀሽ [5]
- ቢሮ ወይም ፈቃድ ከሌለው፣ ፈቃዱን ሊያሳይሽ ካልፈለገ፣ ወይም በካፌ ወይም በመንገድ ላይ ካገኘሽ [10]
- ከጉዞ ወኪል ወይም ከትኬት ቢሮ ውስጥ ሆኖ የሚሠራ ከሆነ [5]
- ለሥራ በቱሪስት ወይም በጉብኝት ቪዛ እንድትሄጂ ከነገረሽ [10]
- ሥልጠናውን፣ COCን ወይም የሕክምና ምርመራውን መዝለል ትችያለሽ ካለሽ [10]
- ዕድሜሽን ከፍ አድርገሽ እንድትናገሪ ከነገረሽ፣ ወይም ከ18 ዓመት በታች የሆነችን ሊልክ ከፈለገ [5]
- በአውሮፕላን ሳይሆን በመኪና ወይም በጀልባ ሊልክሽ ከፈለገ
- የተጻፈ ውል ከሌለው፣ ወይም "አሁን ፈርሚ፣ በኋላ ታነቢዋለሽ" ካለሽ
- ፓስፖርትሽን ወይም መታወቂያሽን ሊይዝ ከፈለገ [5]
- እውነት የማይመስል ከፍተኛ ደመወዝ ቃል ከገባልሽ

ከእነዚህ አንዱም ያንቺ ጥፋት አይደለም። እነዚህ ብዙ ሰዎችን የሚያታልሉ ዘዴዎች ናቸው።

## በጅቡቲና በየመን የሚያልፈው አደገኛ መንገድ

አንዳንድ ደላሎች ሰዎችን በየብስና በባሕር በጅቡቲ ወይም በሶማሊያ በኩል ወደ የመን፣ ከዚያም ወደ ሳዑዲ አረቢያ ይልካሉ። ይህ አንዳንዴ "የምሥራቁ መስመር" ይባላል። የተባበሩት መንግሥታት የስደት ድርጅት (IOM) እንደሚለው፣ በዚህ መንገድ የሚጓዙ ሰዎች እገታ፣ ለቤዛ ገንዘብ ስቃይ፣ ብዝበዛና የሰዎች ንግድ ይደርስባቸዋል። ብዙዎች በትንሽ ምግብና ውኃ በረሃ ያቋርጣሉ። [3]

ለዚህ አደጋ የሚያበቃ ምንም ሥራ የለም። በአውሮፕላን፣ በእውነተኛ ሰነድ፣ በደህንነት መጓዝ ይገባሻል።

## ኤጀንሲን ወይም ደላላን እንዴት ሪፖርት ማድረግ ትችያለሽ

ገንዘብ ከፍለሽ ወይም ፈርመሽ ቢሆንም እንኳ አቤቱታ የማቅረብ መብት አለሽ።

- **የሥራና ክህሎት ሚኒስቴር፦** አንቺ፣ ጠበቃሽ ወይም የቤተሰብ አባል በቃል ወይም በጽሑፍ ስለ ኤጀንሲ አቤቱታ ማቅረብ ትችላላችሁ። በቃል ከሆነ ባለሙያው ጽፎ እንድትፈርሚ ሊጠይቅሽ ይገባል። ሚኒስቴሩ በ15 የሥራ ቀናት ውስጥ መወሰን አለበት። [5]
- **የክልል የሥራ ቢሮዎችም** አቤቱታ ይቀበላሉ። [5]
- አቤቱታሽን በ **ሦስት ዓመት** ውስጥ አቅርቢ። ከዚያ በኋላ ሊዘገይ ይችላል። [5]
- አንድ ሰው በሰዎች እየነገደ ወይም ሰዎችን በሕገ ወጥ መንገድ እያሻገረ ነው ብለሽ ካሰብሽ፣ ነፃው የብሔራዊ የፀረ ሰዎች ንግድ የስልክ መስመር **8797** መረጃና ነፃ የሕግ ድጋፍ ይሰጣል። **በእርዳታ ማውጫውም** ውስጥ አለ። [9]

ያለሽን ሁሉ ይዘሽ ሂጂ፦ ደረሰኞች፣ መልእክቶች፣ የኤጀንሲውን ስምና አድራሻ፣ እንዲሁም ያገኘሻቸውን ሰዎች ስም።

## ምን ማድረግ ትችያለሽ

1. የኤጀንሲውን ሙሉ ስምና ፈቃድ ጠይቂ። በሥራና ክህሎት ሚኒስቴር አረጋግጪ፣ ወይም በዚህ መተግበሪያ ያለውን የኤጀንሲ ማረጋገጫ ተጠቀሚ።
2. የኤጀንሲውን ቢሮ ራስሽ ሂደሽ ጎብኚ። የምታምኚውን ሰው ይዘሽ ሂጂ።
3. ለሥራው ለማንም ገንዘብ አትክፈዪ። የምትከፍዪው ነገር ካለ የሥራና ክህሎት ሚኒስቴርን ጠይቂ።
4. የቅድመ ጉዞ ሥልጠናውን ተከታተዪ። እዚያ ጥያቄ ጠይቂ።
5. የኤጀንሲውን ስምና አድራሻ ለምታምኚው ሰው ንገሪ።
6. አንድ ሰው እየገፋፋሽ፣ እያስፈራራሽ ወይም ሰነዶችሽን ይዞ ከሆነ፣ በኢትዮጵያ ውስጥ እርዳታ ለማግኘት **የእርዳታ ማውጫውን** ተመልከቺ። አደጋ ላይ ከሆንሽ **SOS** ተጠቀሚ።

Dubartoonni baay'een hojii biyya alaa nama beekan, kan akka ollaa, fira ykn "deelaalaa" magaalaa keessa jiruun argatu. Namoonni kun gaarii ta'uu danda'u. Garuu hojii manaatiif seeraan biyya alaa si erguu kan danda'u **ejansii hayyama qabu** qofa. Karaa nageenya qabu filachuun, yoo rakkoon booda uumame si eega. [5]

## Ejansii hayyama qabu moo deelaalaa?

Seerri hojii biyya alaa Labsii Hojii Biyya Alaa Itoophiyaa Lakk. 1389/2025 dha. Labsiin kun labsiiwwan duraanii Lakk. 923/2016 fi Lakk. 1246/2021 bakka bu'eera. [5]

Akka seera kanaatti, ejansiidhaaf hayyama hojjettoota biyya alaa erguu kan kennu **Ministeera Hojii fi Ogummaa (MoLS)** qofa. Hayyamni kun Sirna Odeeffannoo Gabaa Hojii (LMIS) mootummaa keessaan raawwatama. [5]

- Hayyamni **waggaa tokkoof** qofa hojjeta. Ejansichi waggaa waggaan haaromsuu qaba. [5]
- Ejansiiwwan seera duraaniitiin hayyama qaban, seerri haaraan erga ba'ee ji'a sadii keessatti hayyama haaraa baafachuu qabu turan. Yoo hin baafatin, hayyamni isaanii duraanii hin hojjetu. Kanaaf waraqaan hayyamaa durii ejansichi har'a seeraan kan hojjetu ta'uu isaa hin mirkaneessu. [5]
- Ministeerichi hayyama ejansii tokkoo yoo dhaabe ykn haqe, ummataaf beeksisuu qaba. [5]

Ejansiin hayyama qabu:

- hojii siif argachuu isaatiif **maallaqa ykn kennaa kamiyyuu si irraa fudhachuu hin qabu**. Ejansiin kana godhe hayyama isaa dhabuu danda'a. [5]
- hayyama Ministeerichaa waajjira isaa keessatti keenyan irratti maxxansee agarsiisuu qaba [5]
- nama umuriin isaa waggaa 18 gadi ta'e tokkollee biyya alaa erguu hin qabu [5]
- waliigaltee afaan ati hubattuun barreeffamee fi osoo hin imaliin dura Ministeerichaan mirkanaa'e siif kennuu qaba [5]
- paaspoortii kee qabachuu hin qabu. Yoo gaafatte, torban tokko keessatti siif deebisuu qaba. [5]
- waajjira ejansii imalaa ykn waajjira tikeetii keessaa hojjechuu hin qabu [5]

Ati kan kaffaltu paaspoortii, ragaa poolisii, ragaa dhalootaa, akkasumas leenjii fi ragaa ogummaa (COC) kee qofaaf. Viizaa, tikeetii, qorannoo fayyaa, hayyama hojii fi baasii biroo kan kaffalu hojjechiisaa dha. [5]

**Deelaalaan** seera kanaan alatti hojjeta. Qorannoon dubartoota Itoophiyaa waliin taasifame akka agarsiisutti, karaan seeraa yeroo dheeraa fudhata ykn qaalii dha jedhanii waan yaadaniif baay'een isaanii deelaalaa naannoo fayyadamu. Garuu deelaalonni yeroo baay'ee waadaa guddaa dhugaa hin taane kennu. Dubartoonni karaa kanaan deeman daldala namaatiif caalaatti saaxilamoo dha; yeroo rakkoon isaan mudatu immoo gargaarsa mootummaa irraa fagaatu. [4]

## Ejansiin tokko seeraan kan hojjetu ta'uu isaa akkamiin mirkaneessita

Osoo homaa hin kaffalin ykn hin mallatteessin dura:

1. **Hayyama isaa akka si agarsiisan gaafadhu.** Keenyan waajjiraa irra jiraachuu qaba. Maqaa ejansichaa, biyyoota hojjettoota itti erguuf hayyamameef fi guyyaa isaa ilaali. Hayyamni waggaa tokkoof qofa hojjeta. [5]
2. **Ministeerichaa gaafadhu.** Ministeera Hojii fi Ogummaatti bilbili (lakkoofsi isaa **galmee gargaarsaa** keessa jira), **info@mols.gov.et** irratti imeelii ergi, ykn waajjira hojii naannoo keetii deemi. "Ejansiin kun amma hayyama qabaa?" jedhii gaafadhu. [6] [5]
3. **LMIS keessatti galmaa'i.** Giddu-gala Tajaajila Iddoo Tokkootti (One Stop Service Center) jalqabuun Sirna Odeeffannoo Gabaa Hojii (LMIS) keessatti galmaa'uu kee mirkaneeffadhu. Qacarriin LMIS alaa hin hayyamamu. [5] [7]
4. **Waliigalteen kee mirkanaa'uu isaa mirkaneeffadhu.** Osoo hin imaliin dura Ministeerichi waliigaltee kee mirkaneessuu qaba. [5]
5. **Appii LeMengede (ለመንገዴ) fayyadami.** Appiin Ministeerichaa kun odeeffannoo godaansa nageenya qabuu, odeeffannoo komii fi tajaajila SOS qaba. [8]

Hanga ammaatti tarree ejansiiwwan hayyama qabanii interneetii irratti ifatti argamu hin arganne. Hanga tarreen sun ba'utti, Ministeerichaa ykn waajjira hojii naannoo kee gaafachuun karaa baay'ee amansiisaa dha. Mirkaneessaa ejansii appii kana keessa jirus fayyadamuu ni dandeessa.

## Mallattoolee akeekkachiisaa

Namni tokko kana yoo godhe dhaabbadhuu Ministeerichaa gaafadhu:

- hojii kanaaf maallaqa ykn kennaa yoo si gaafate [5]
- waajjira ykn hayyama yoo hin qabne, hayyama isaa siif agarsiisuu yoo dide, ykn kaafee keessatti ykn daandii irratti yoo si qunname [10]
- waajjira ejansii imalaa ykn waajjira tikeetii keessaa yoo hojjete [5]
- hojii hojjechuuf viizaa turistii ykn daawwannaa yoo siif dhiyeesse [10]
- leenjii, COC ykn qorannoo fayyaa irra darbuu akka dandeessu yoo sitti hime [10]
- umurii kee caalaa akka dubbattu yoo sitti hime, ykn nama umuriin isaa waggaa 18 gadi ta'e erguu yoo barbaade [5]
- xiyyaaraan osoo hin taane konkolaataan ykn bidiruun si erguu yoo barbaade
- waliigaltee barreeffame yoo hin qabne, ykn "amma mallatteessi, booda dubbisi" yoo jedhe
- paaspoortii ykn waraqaa eenyummaa kee qabachuu yoo barbaade [5]
- mindaa dhugaa hin fakkaanne siif waadaa yoo gale

Kanneen keessaa tokkollee dogoggora kee miti. Kunneen tooftaa namoota baay'ee gowwoomsanii dha.

## Karaa balaa Jibuutii fi Yaman keessa darbu

Deelaalonni tokko tokko namoota lafaa fi galaanaan Jibuutii ykn Somaaliyaa keessa gara Yaman, achii immoo gara Saawud Arabiyaatti ergu. Kun yeroo tokko tokko "karaa Bahaa" jedhama. Dhaabbanni Godaansaa Mootummoota Gamtoomanii (IOM) akka jedhutti, namoonni karaa kanaan deeman butamuu, maallaqa furiitiif dararamuu, saamamuu fi daldala namaa isaan mudata. Baay'een isaanii nyaata fi bishaan xiqqaa qabatanii gammoojjii qaxxaamuru. [3]

Hojiin balaa kanaaf ga'u tokkollee hin jiru. Xiyyaaraan, ragaa dhugaa qabattee, nageenyaan imaluun mirga keeti.

## Ejansii ykn deelaalaa akkamiin gabaasuu dandeessa

Yoo maallaqa kaffalte ykn mallatteessite illee, komii dhiyeessuuf mirga qabda.

- **Ministeera Hojii fi Ogummaa:** ati, abukaatoon kee ykn miseensi maatii kee afaaniin ykn barreeffamaan waa'ee ejansii tokkoo komii dhiyeessuu dandeessu. Yoo afaaniin ta'e, hojjetaan sun barreessee akka mallatteessitu si gaafachuu qaba. Ministeerichi guyyoota hojii 15 keessatti murteessuu qaba. [5]
- **Waajjiraaleen hojii naannoo** illee komii ni fudhatu. [5]
- Komii kee **waggaa sadii** keessatti dhiyeessi. Sana booda yeroon darbuu danda'a. [5]
- Namni tokko daldala namaa ykn namoota seeraan ala ceesisuu raawwachaa jira jettee yoo yaadde, sarari bilbilaa biyyaalessaa daldala namaa ittisuu kan kaffaltii hin qabne **8797** odeeffannoo fi gargaarsa seeraa bilisaa ni kenna. **Galmee gargaarsaa** keessas ni argama. [9]

Waan qabdu hunda qabadhu: nagahee, ergaalee, maqaa fi teessoo ejansichaa, akkasumas maqaa namoota wajjin walitti dhuftee.

## Maal gochuu dandeessa

1. Maqaa guutuu fi hayyama ejansichaa gaafadhu. Ministeera Hojii fi Ogummaatti mirkaneessi, ykn mirkaneessaa ejansii appii kana keessa jiru fayyadami.
2. Waajjira ejansichaa ofii keetii deemii ilaali. Nama amanattu tokko of faana fudhadhu.
3. Hojii kanaaf nama kamiifuu maallaqa hin kaffalin. Wanti ati kaffaltu yoo jiraate Ministeera Hojii fi Ogummaa gaafadhu.
4. Leenjii dura-imalaa hordofi. Achitti gaaffii gaafadhu.
5. Maqaa fi teessoo ejansichaa nama amanattuuf himi.
6. Namni tokko yoo si dhiibe, yoo si sodaachise ykn ragaalee kee yoo qabate, Itoophiyaa keessatti gargaarsa argachuuf **galmee gargaarsaa** ilaali. Balaa keessa yoo jirte **SOS** fayyadami.

summary.en: Know which costs you may have to pay and which you should not pay. Avoid debt to brokers, send money home safely, and keep a record of your wages.
summary.am: ልትከፍዪ የምትችዪባቸውንና መክፈል የሌለብሽን ወጪዎች እወቂ። ለደላሎች ከዕዳ ራቂ፣ ገንዘብ በደህንነት ወደ ቤት ላኪ፣ የደመወዝሽንም መዝገብ ያዢ።

body.en:
You are going abroad to earn money for yourself and your family. Protect that money from the very start.

## Costs you may need to pay

Under Ethiopia's overseas employment law, a worker usually pays for: [1]

- her passport
- having her contract authenticated, and a police clearance certificate
- her medical exam and vaccinations
- her birth certificate
- her certificate of occupational competence (skills certificate)

If you are not sure what to pay, ask the Ministry of Labour and Skills (MoLS).

## Costs you should not pay

- A licensed agency must **not** charge a domestic worker any fee, directly or indirectly, for finding her the job. [1]
- The **employer** should pay for your round-trip ticket, visa, work and residence permits, insurance, and contract approval. [1]
- Your employer must **not** take money from your salary to pay for your recruitment. [1]

International fair recruitment rules agree: workers should not pay recruitment fees or related costs. [2]

## Be careful with brokers and debt

Brokers often make promises that are not true. [3] Some ask for money, and people borrow to pay them. Debt can trap you. It can make it hard to leave a bad job, because you still owe money.

- Do not pay a broker.
- Do not sign papers that say you owe money for your job.
- If someone says you must "pay back" your ticket or visa from your salary, ask MoLS or look in the **help directory**.

## Send money home safely

You have the right to open a bank account at home and abroad and send your salary through a bank or other legal channel. [1]

- Open a bank account in Ethiopia **before** you leave, in your own name.
- Send money through a bank or a licensed money transfer service. Keep every receipt.
- Be careful about giving all your money to one person to manage. Agree together how it will be used.

## Make a saving plan

Before you leave, write down your goal. For example: "In two years, I will save enough to start a small business." Decide how much you will send, and how much you will save for yourself.

## Keep a record of your wages

Your contract should say how much you are paid and how often. Each month, write down the date, the amount you were paid, and anything missing. This app has a **private log** for this. If your wages are ever not paid, this record is strong proof.

## What you can do

1. Ask MoLS or your agency for a written list of what you must pay.
2. Do not borrow money to pay a broker.
3. Open your own bank account before you leave.
4. Use only banks or licensed transfer services. Keep receipts.
5. Log your wages in the app every month.
6. If you are not paid, read "Unpaid wages" in this app and look in the **help directory**.
body.am:
ወደ ውጭ አገር የምትሄጂው ለራስሽና ለቤተሰብሽ ገንዘብ ለማግኘት ነው። ያንን ገንዘብ ከመጀመሪያው ጀምሮ ጠብቂው።

## ልትከፍዪ የምትችዪባቸው ወጪዎች

በኢትዮጵያ የውጭ አገር ሥራ ስምሪት ሕግ መሠረት፣ ሠራተኛዋ ብዙውን ጊዜ የምትከፍለው ለሚከተሉት ነው፦ [1]

- ፓስፖርቷ
- ውሏን ማረጋገጥ፣ እና ከወንጀል ነፃ የምስክር ወረቀት
- የሕክምና ምርመራዋና ክትባቶቿ
- የልደት ሰርተፊኬቷ
- የሙያ ብቃት ማረጋገጫ ሰርተፊኬቷ

ምን መክፈል እንዳለብሽ እርግጠኛ ካልሆንሽ፣ የሥራና ክህሎት ሚኒስቴርን ጠይቂ።

## መክፈል የሌለብሽ ወጪዎች

- ፈቃድ ያለው ኤጀንሲ ሥራ ስላገኘላት የቤት ሠራተኛን በቀጥታም ሆነ በተዘዋዋሪ ምንም ክፍያ ማስከፈል **የለበትም**። [1]
- **አሠሪው** የደርሶ መልስ ትኬትሽን፣ ቪዛሽን፣ የሥራና የመኖሪያ ፈቃድሽን፣ ኢንሹራንስሽንና የውል ማጽደቂያውን መክፈል አለበት። [1]
- አሠሪሽ ለቅጥርሽ ወጪ ከደመወዝሽ ገንዘብ መቁረጥ **የለበትም**። [1]

ዓለም አቀፍ የፍትሐዊ ቅጥር ደንቦችም ይስማማሉ፦ ሠራተኞች የቅጥር ክፍያም ሆነ ተያያዥ ወጪ መክፈል የለባቸውም። [2]

## ከደላሎችና ከዕዳ ተጠንቀቂ

ደላሎች ብዙ ጊዜ እውነት ያልሆነ ቃል ይገባሉ። [3] አንዳንዶቹ ገንዘብ ይጠይቃሉ፤ ሰዎችም ለመክፈል ይበደራሉ። ዕዳ ሊያጠምድሽ ይችላል። አሁንም ገንዘብ ስላለብሽ መጥፎ ሥራን መልቀቅ ሊከብድሽ ይችላል።

- ለደላላ አትክፈዪ።
- ለሥራሽ ገንዘብ እንዳለብሽ የሚገልጽ ወረቀት አትፈርሚ።
- አንድ ሰው ትኬትሽን ወይም ቪዛሽን ከደመወዝሽ "መመለስ" አለብሽ ካለሽ፣ የሥራና ክህሎት ሚኒስቴርን ጠይቂ ወይም **የእርዳታ ማውጫውን** ተመልከቺ።

## ገንዘብ በደህንነት ወደ አገር ቤት ላኪ

በአገር ቤትም በውጭ አገርም የባንክ ሂሳብ የመክፈትና ደመወዝሽን በባንክ ወይም በሌላ ሕጋዊ መንገድ የመላክ መብት አለሽ። [1]

- ከመሄድሽ **በፊት** በራስሽ ስም በኢትዮጵያ የባንክ ሂሳብ ክፈቺ።
- ገንዘብ በባንክ ወይም ፈቃድ ባለው የገንዘብ ማስተላለፊያ አገልግሎት ላኪ። ደረሰኙን ሁሉ አስቀምጪ።
- ገንዘብሽን በሙሉ ለአንድ ሰው እንዲያስተዳድር ከመስጠት ተጠንቀቂ። እንዴት እንደሚውል አብራችሁ ተስማሙ።

## የቁጠባ እቅድ አውጪ

ከመሄድሽ በፊት ግብሽን ጻፊ። ለምሳሌ፦ "በሁለት ዓመት ውስጥ ትንሽ ንግድ ለመጀመር የሚበቃ እቆጥባለሁ።" ምን ያህል እንደምትልኪና ለራስሽ ምን ያህል እንደምትቆጥቢ ወስኚ።

## የደመወዝሽን መዝገብ ያዢ

ውልሽ ምን ያህልና በምን ያህል ጊዜ እንደሚከፈልሽ መግለጽ አለበት። በየወሩ ቀኑን፣ የተከፈለሽን መጠንና የጎደለውን ጻፊ። ይህ መተግበሪያ ለዚህ **የግል መዝገብ** አለው። ደመወዝሽ ካልተከፈለሽ፣ ይህ መዝገብ ጠንካራ ማስረጃ ነው።

## ምን ማድረግ ትችያለሽ

1. መክፈል ያለብሽን በጽሑፍ እንዲሰጡሽ የሥራና ክህሎት ሚኒስቴርን ወይም ኤጀንሲሽን ጠይቂ።
2. ለደላላ ለመክፈል ገንዘብ አትበደሪ።
3. ከመሄድሽ በፊት የራስሽን የባንክ ሂሳብ ክፈቺ።
4. ባንኮችንና ፈቃድ ያላቸውን የማስተላለፊያ አገልግሎቶች ብቻ ተጠቀሚ። ደረሰኞችን አስቀምጪ።
5. በየወሩ ደመወዝሽን በመተግበሪያው ውስጥ መዝግቢ።
6. ደመወዝ ካልተከፈለሽ፣ በዚህ መተግበሪያ "ያልተከፈለ ደመወዝ" የሚለውን አንብቢና **የእርዳታ ማውጫውን** ተመልከቺ።
body.om:
Biyya alaa kan deemtu ofii keetii fi maatii keetiif maallaqa argachuuf. Maallaqa sana jalqabuma irraa eegi.

## Baasii kaffaluu dandeessu

Akka seera hojii biyya alaa Itoophiyaatti, hojjettuun yeroo baay'ee kanneen armaan gadiitiif kaffalti: [1]

- paaspoortii ishee
- waliigaltee ishee mirkaneessisuu, fi ragaa yakka irraa bilisa ta'uu (poolisii)
- qorannoo fayyaa fi talaallii ishee
- ragaa dhaloota ishee
- ragaa dandeettii ogummaa ishee

Waan kaffaluu qabdu yoo hin beekne, Ministeera Hojii fi Ogummaa (MoLS) gaafadhu.

## Baasii kaffaluu hin qabne

- Ejansiin hayyama qabu hojii argachiisuu isaatiif hojjettuu manaa irraa kaffaltii tokkollee kallattiinis ta'e al-kallattiin fudhachuu **hin qabu**. [1]
- **Hojjechiisaan** tikeetii deemaa fi deebii, viizaa, hayyama hojii fi jireenyaa, inshuraansii fi raggaasisa waliigaltee kee kaffaluu qaba. [1]
- Hojjechiisaan kee baasii qacarrii keetiif mindaa kee irraa maallaqa muruu **hin qabu**. [1]

Seerri qacarrii haqa qabeessaa idil-addunyaas kanuma jedha: hojjettoonni kaffaltii qacarrii ykn baasii wal qabatu kaffaluu hin qaban. [2]

## Deelaalota fi liqii irraa of eeggadhu

Deelaalonni yeroo baay'ee waadaa dhugaa hin taane galu. [3] Tokko tokko maallaqa gaafatu, namoonnis kaffaluuf liqeeffatu. Liqiin si qabuu danda'a. Ammas maallaqa waan irraa qabduuf hojii hamaa dhiisuun sitti ulfaachuu danda'a.

- Deelaalaaf hin kaffalin.
- Waraqaa hojii keetiif maallaqa irraa akka qabdu ibsu hin mallatteessin.
- Namni tokko tikeetii ykn viizaa kee mindaa kee irraa "deebisuu" qabda yoo siin jedhe, Ministeera Hojii fi Ogummaa gaafadhu ykn **galmee gargaarsaa** ilaali.

## Maallaqa nageenyaan gara manaatti ergi

Biyya keessattis biyya alaattis herrega baankii banachuu fi mindaa kee baankii ykn karaa seera qabeessa biraatiin erguuf mirga qabda. [1]

- Osoo hin deemin **dura** maqaa keetiin Itoophiyaa keessatti herrega baankii bani.
- Maallaqa baankii ykn tajaajila dabarsa maallaqaa hayyama qabuun ergi. Nagahee hunda olkaa'i.
- Maallaqa kee hunda akka bulchuuf nama tokkoof kennuu irraa of eeggadhu. Akkamitti akka itti fayyadamtan waliin walii galaa.

## Karoora qusannaa baafadhu

Osoo hin deemin dura galma kee barreessi. Fakkeenyaaf: "Waggaa lama keessatti daldala xiqqaa jalqabuuf kan ga'u nan qusadha." Hammam akka ergituu fi hammam ofii keetiif akka qusattu murteessi.

## Galmee mindaa keetii qabadhu

Waliigalteen kee hammamii fi yeroo meeqa meeqatti akka siif kaffalamu ibsuu qaba. Ji'a ji'aan guyyaa, hamma siif kaffalame fi waan hir'ate barreessi. Appiin kun kanaaf **galmee dhuunfaa** qaba. Yoo mindaan kee siif hin kaffalamne, galmeen kun ragaa cimaa dha.

## Maal gochuu dandeessa

1. Waan kaffaluu qabdu barreeffamaan akka siif kennan Ministeera Hojii fi Ogummaa ykn ejansii kee gaafadhu.
2. Deelaalaaf kaffaluuf maallaqa hin liqeeffatin.
3. Osoo hin deemin dura herrega baankii mataa keetii bani.
4. Baankota fi tajaajila dabarsaa hayyama qaban qofa fayyadami. Nagahee olkaa'i.
5. Ji'a ji'aan mindaa kee appii keessatti galmeessi.
6. Yoo mindaan siif hin kaffalamne, appii kana keessaa "Mindaa hin kaffalamne" dubbisi, **galmee gargaarsaa** illee ilaali.

title.en: Your trusted person and safety plan
title.om: Nama amanattu fi karoora nageenya kee

summary.en: Choose one person at home who will always look out for you. Agree a plan together before you leave, so they know when and how to get help.
summary.am: በአገር ቤት ሁልጊዜ የሚጠብቅሽ አንድ ሰው ምረጪ። መቼና እንዴት እርዳታ እንደሚፈልግ እንዲያውቅ ከመሄድሽ በፊት አብራችሁ እቅድ ላይ ተስማሙ።
summary.om: Biyya keessatti nama yeroo hunda si eegu tokko filadhu. Yoom fi akkamitti gargaarsa akka barbaadu akka beekuuf, osoo hin deemin dura karoora tokko irratti waliin walii galaa.

body.en:
Being far from home is easier when someone is watching out for you. A **trusted person** is someone at home you can always reach, who will act if you need help. A **safety plan** is what you agree together before you leave.

## Choose your trusted person

Pick someone who:

- you trust completely
- is easy to reach by phone
- will stay calm and act if you need help
- will keep your secrets

It can be a sister, mother, friend, or anyone you choose. You can choose two people.

## Agree your plan

Talk together before you leave. Agree on:

- **A code word.** A normal-sounding word that means "I am not safe, get help". For example, the name of a food or a relative. Only you two know it.
- **Check-in times.** For example, a short message every Friday. You have the right to contact your family regularly, at least once a week. [1]
- **What to do if you miss a check-in.** For example: wait one day, then call the agency, then contact the embassy.
- **Who to call.** Give them your agency's name and number, and the Ethiopian embassy's number in your country (find it in the **help directory**).

## Share where you are

When you arrive, send your trusted person:

- your employer's full name
- the address, area or a map location of the house
- a phone number for the house, if there is one

Give them copies of your passport, visa and contract too. Read "Copy your important documents".

## Use this app safely

- Add your trusted person in the app. The **SOS** button can alert them quickly.
- Use **disguise mode** to hide the app if someone checks your phone.
- Save important numbers on paper too, in case your phone is taken.
- Keep your phone charged. A small power bank can help.

## Know your rights

You have the right to contact your embassy or agency if you are mistreated or abused. [1] You have the right to keep your passport and papers in a safe place of your choice. [1] Nobody should take or keep your identity documents. [2]

## What you can do

1. Choose your trusted person this week.
2. Agree on a code word and check-in times.
3. Give them your agency's details and copies of your papers.
4. Send them your employer's address when you arrive.
5. Practise using **SOS** and disguise mode before you leave.
6. If you are ever in danger, use **SOS** or say your code word. Look in the **help directory** for emergency numbers.
body.am:
ከአገር ርቀሽ ስትሆኚ፣ አንድ ሰው እየተከታተለሽ ከሆነ ነገሮች ይቀሉሻል። **የምታምኚው ሰው** ሁልጊዜ ልታገኚው የምትችዪው፣ እርዳታ ካስፈለገሽ እርምጃ የሚወስድ በአገር ቤት ያለ ሰው ነው። **የደህንነት እቅድ** ደግሞ ከመሄድሽ በፊት አብራችሁ የምትስማሙበት ነገር ነው።

## የምታምኚውን ሰው ምረጪ

እንዲህ ያለውን ሰው ምረጪ፦

- ሙሉ በሙሉ የምታምኚው
- በስልክ በቀላሉ የሚገኝ
- እርዳታ ካስፈለገሽ ተረጋግቶ እርምጃ የሚወስድ
- ምስጢርሽን የሚጠብቅ

እህት፣ እናት፣ ጓደኛ ወይም የመረጥሽው ማንኛውም ሰው ሊሆን ይችላል። ሁለት ሰዎችን መምረጥም ትችያለሽ።

## እቅዳችሁ ላይ ተስማሙ

ከመሄድሽ በፊት አብራችሁ ተነጋገሩ። በሚከተሉት ተስማሙ፦

- **የምስጢር ቃል።** "ደህና አይደለሁም፣ እርዳታ ፈልግልኝ" ማለት የሆነ፣ ተራ የሚመስል ቃል። ለምሳሌ የምግብ ወይም የዘመድ ስም። የምታውቁት እናንተ ሁለታችሁ ብቻ ናችሁ።
- **የመገናኛ ጊዜ።** ለምሳሌ በየዓርቡ አጭር መልእክት። ቤተሰብሽን በየጊዜው፣ ቢያንስ በሳምንት አንድ ጊዜ የማግኘት መብት አለሽ። [1]
- **መልእክት ካልላክሽ ምን እንደሚያደርግ።** ለምሳሌ፦ አንድ ቀን መጠበቅ፣ ከዚያ ኤጀንሲውን መደወል፣ ከዚያ ኤምባሲውን ማግኘት።
- **ማንን እንደሚደውል።** የኤጀንሲሽን ስምና ቁጥር፣ እና በምትሄጂበት አገር ያለውን የኢትዮጵያ ኤምባሲ ቁጥር ስጪው (**በእርዳታ ማውጫው** ውስጥ ፈልጊው)።

## ያለሽበትን አሳውቂ

ስትደርሺ ለምታምኚው ሰው እነዚህን ላኪ፦

- የአሠሪሽን ሙሉ ስም
- የቤቱን አድራሻ፣ አካባቢ ወይም የካርታ ቦታ
- ካለ፣ የቤቱን ስልክ ቁጥር

የፓስፖርትሽን፣ የቪዛሽንና የውልሽን ቅጂም ስጪው። "አስፈላጊ ሰነዶችሽን ቅጂ" የሚለውን አንብቢ።

## ይህን መተግበሪያ በደህንነት ተጠቀሚ

- የምታምኚውን ሰው በመተግበሪያው ውስጥ አስገቢ። የ**SOS** ቁልፉ በፍጥነት ሊያሳውቀው ይችላል።
- አንድ ሰው ስልክሽን ቢፈትሽ መተግበሪያውን ለመደበቅ **የመደበቂያ ሁነታን** ተጠቀሚ።
- ስልክሽ ቢወሰድ እንዲረዳሽ አስፈላጊ ቁጥሮችን በወረቀትም አስቀምጪ።
- ስልክሽን ሁልጊዜ ቻርጅ አድርጊ። ትንሽ ፓወር ባንክ ሊረዳሽ ይችላል።

## መብቶችሽን እወቂ

በደል ወይም ጥቃት ከደረሰብሽ ኤምባሲሽን ወይም ኤጀንሲሽን የማግኘት መብት አለሽ። [1] ፓስፖርትሽንና ሰነዶችሽን በመረጥሽው ደህና ቦታ የማስቀመጥ መብት አለሽ። [1] ማንም ሰው የማንነት ሰነዶችሽን መውሰድ ወይም መያዝ የለበትም። [2]

## ምን ማድረግ ትችያለሽ

1. በዚህ ሳምንት የምታምኚውን ሰው ምረጪ።
2. በምስጢር ቃልና በመገናኛ ጊዜ ተስማሙ።
3. የኤጀንሲሽን መረጃና የሰነዶችሽን ቅጂ ስጪው።
4. ስትደርሺ የአሠሪሽን አድራሻ ላኪለት።
5. ከመሄድሽ በፊት **SOS**ን እና የመደበቂያ ሁነታን ተለማመጂ።
6. መቼም አደጋ ላይ ከሆንሽ **SOS** ተጠቀሚ ወይም የምስጢር ቃልሽን ተናገሪ። የአደጋ ጊዜ ቁጥሮችን **በእርዳታ ማውጫው** ውስጥ ፈልጊ።
body.om:
Yeroo biyya irraa fagaattu, namni tokko yoo si hordofaa jiraate wantoonni siif salphatu. **Namni ati amantu** nama biyya keessa jiru, yeroo hunda argachuu dandeessu, yoo gargaarsi si barbaachise tarkaanfii fudhatu dha. **Karoorri nageenyaa** immoo waan osoo hin deemin dura waliin irratti walii galtanii dha.

## Nama amanattu filadhu

Nama akkasii filadhu:

- guutummaatti kan amantu
- bilbilaan salphaatti kan argamu
- yoo gargaarsi si barbaachise tasgabbaa'ee tarkaanfii kan fudhatu
- icciitii kee kan eegu

Obboleettii, haadha, hiriyyaa ykn nama ati filatte kamiyyuu ta'uu danda'a. Nama lama filachuus dandeessa.

## Karoora keessan irratti walii galaa

Osoo hin deemin dura waliin haasa'aa. Kanneen armaan gadii irratti walii galaa:

- **Jecha icciitii.** Jecha idilee fakkaatu kan "Nageenya hin qabu, gargaarsa naaf barbaadi" jechuu ta'e. Fakkeenyaaf maqaa nyaataa ykn firaa. Kan beektan isin lamaan qofa.
- **Yeroo walqunnamtii.** Fakkeenyaaf Jimaata hunda ergaa gabaabaa. Maatii kee yeroo yeroon, yoo xiqqaate torbanitti al tokko qunnamuuf mirga qabda. [1]
- **Yoo ergaa hin ergine maal akka godhu.** Fakkeenyaaf: guyyaa tokko eeguu, achiis ejansii bilbiluu, achiis embaasii qunnamuu.
- **Eenyuun akka bilbilu.** Maqaa fi lakkoofsa ejansii kee, fi lakkoofsa embaasii Itoophiyaa biyya itti deemtu keessa jiru kenniif (**galmee gargaarsaa** keessaa barbaadi).

## Bakka jirtu beeksisi

Yeroo geessu nama amanattuuf kanneen ergi:

- maqaa guutuu hojjechiisaa kee
- teessoo, naannoo ykn bakka kaartaa manichaa
- yoo jiraate, lakkoofsa bilbila manichaa

Garagalcha paaspoortii, viizaa fi waliigaltee kees kenniif. "Ragaalee kee barbaachisoo garagalchi" dubbisi.

## Appii kana nageenyaan fayyadami

- Nama amanattu appii keessatti galchi. Qabduun **SOS** dafee isa beeksisuu danda'a.
- Namni tokko bilbila kee yoo ilaale appii dhoksuuf **haala dhoksaa** fayyadami.
- Yoo bilbilli kee fudhatame akka si gargaaruuf lakkoofsota barbaachisoo waraqaa irrattis qabadhu.
- Bilbila kee yeroo hunda chaarjii godhi. Paawar baankiin xiqqaan si gargaaruu danda'a.

## Mirgoota kee beeki

Yoo miidhaa ykn hacuuccaan si mudate embaasii ykn ejansii kee qunnamuuf mirga qabda. [1] Paaspoortii fi ragaalee kee bakka nagaa ati filatte kaa'uuf mirga qabda. [1] Namni kamiyyuu ragaalee eenyummaa kee fudhachuu ykn qabachuu hin qabu. [2]

## Maal gochuu dandeessa

1. Torban kana nama amanattu filadhu.
2. Jecha icciitii fi yeroo walqunnamtii irratti walii galaa.
3. Odeeffannoo ejansii kee fi garagalcha ragaalee keetii kenniif.
4. Yeroo geessu teessoo hojjechiisaa kee ergiif.
5. Osoo hin deemin dura **SOS** fi haala dhoksaa shaakali.
6. Yoo yeroo kamiyyuu balaa keessa jirte, **SOS** fayyadami ykn jecha icciitii kee dubbadhu. Lakkoofsota hatattamaa **galmee gargaarsaa** keessaa barbaadi.

title.en: Your work contract
title.om: Waliigaltee hojii kee

summary.en: Before you leave, get a written contract in a language you understand. Check every detail, and keep a copy and a photo.
summary.am: ከመሄድሽ በፊት በምትረጂው ቋንቋ የተጻፈ ውል ውሰጂ። እያንዳንዱን ዝርዝር አረጋግጪ፣ ቅጂና ፎቶም ያዢ።
summary.om: Osoo hin deemin dura waliigaltee afaan ati hubattuun barreeffame fudhadhu. Bal'ina hunda mirkaneessi, garagalcha fi suuraas qabadhu.

body.en:
Your contract is your promise on paper. It says what job you will do, how much you will be paid, and how you will be treated. It is also your proof if something goes wrong. [1]

## What your contract should say

You have the right to know the terms of your job in a clear way you can understand. Check that your contract includes: [1]

- the **employer's name and address**, and where you will work
- the **type of work** (for example, cleaning, cooking, caring for children)
- your **salary**, and how often you are paid
- your **daily working hours**
- your **weekly rest day** and daily rest time
- your **yearly leave**
- how **long** the contract lasts
- how you **return home**, and how the contract can end

The employer should pay your **round-trip travel**, your visa and work permit, and your insurance. [1] Your contract should not make you pay for your own recruitment. [2]

## A language you understand

The agency must give you a contract written or translated into a language you understand. They must explain it and give you a copy. [1] Only sign when you understand and agree with everything. [1]

It is fine to say "I need time to read this." It is fine to ask someone you trust to read it with you.

## Ministry approval

Ethiopia's Ministry of Labour and Skills checks and approves overseas work contracts. The government should make sure you have a copy of your contract before you leave, and that you understand it. [1] Ask your agency to show you that your contract was approved.

## Watch out for a "new" contract

Sometimes a worker signs one contract at home. Then, before she flies or after she arrives, she is given a different contract with lower pay or harder work. This is called **contract substitution**. Fair recruitment rules say contracts must be protected against this. [2]

If someone gives you a new contract, you do not have to sign it straight away. Compare it with your first contract. Take a photo of both.

## What you can do

1. Ask for the contract early, not at the airport.
2. Read every line. Ask about anything you do not understand.
3. Check the salary, hours, rest day and length of contract.
4. Take a clear photo of every page. Keep a paper copy too.
5. Give a copy to your trusted person at home.
6. Save the employer's name and address in this app.
7. Read the "Your rights" page for the country you are going to.
8. If something in the contract worries you, ask the Ministry of Labour and Skills or look in the **help directory**.
body.am:
ውልሽ በወረቀት ላይ የተጻፈ ቃል ኪዳንሽ ነው። ምን ዓይነት ሥራ እንደምትሠሪ፣ ምን ያህል እንደሚከፈልሽና እንዴት እንደምትያዢ ይናገራል። ችግር ቢፈጠርም ማስረጃሽ ነው። [1]

## ውልሽ ምን ማለት አለበት

የሥራሽን ሁኔታ በግልጽና በምትረጂው መንገድ የማወቅ መብት አለሽ። ውልሽ የሚከተሉትን መያዙን አረጋግጪ፦ [1]

- የአሠሪው **ስምና አድራሻ**፣ እና የምትሠሪበት ቦታ
- የሥራው **ዓይነት** (ለምሳሌ ጽዳት፣ ምግብ ማብሰል፣ ልጆችን መንከባከብ)
- **ደመወዝሽ**፣ እና በምን ያህል ጊዜ እንደሚከፈልሽ
- የዕለት **የሥራ ሰዓትሽ**
- የሳምንት **የዕረፍት ቀንሽ** እና የዕለት ዕረፍት ጊዜሽ
- የዓመት **ፈቃድሽ**
- ውሉ ለምን ያህል **ጊዜ** እንደሚቆይ
- እንዴት **ወደ አገርሽ እንደምትመለሺ**፣ እና ውሉ እንዴት ሊቋረጥ እንደሚችል

አሠሪው **የደርሶ መልስ ጉዞሽን**፣ ቪዛሽን፣ የሥራ ፈቃድሽንና ኢንሹራንስሽን መክፈል አለበት። [1] ውልሽ ለራስሽ ቅጥር እንድትከፍዪ ሊያደርግሽ አይገባም። [2]

## በምትረጂው ቋንቋ

ኤጀንሲው በምትረጂው ቋንቋ የተጻፈ ወይም የተተረጎመ ውል ሊሰጥሽ ይገባል። ሊያስረዳሽና ቅጂውን ሊሰጥሽ ይገባል። [1] ፈርሚ የምትይው ሁሉንም ነገር ስትረጂና ስትስማሚ ብቻ ነው። [1]

"ይህን ለማንበብ ጊዜ ያስፈልገኛል" ማለት ችግር የለውም። የምታምኚውን ሰው አብሮሽ እንዲያነብ መጠየቅም ችግር የለውም።

## የሚኒስቴሩ ማጽደቅ

የኢትዮጵያ የሥራና ክህሎት ሚኒስቴር የውጭ አገር የሥራ ውሎችን ይመረምራል፣ ያጸድቃል። መንግሥት ከመሄድሽ በፊት የውልሽ ቅጂ እንዳለሽና እንደተረዳሽው ማረጋገጥ አለበት። [1] ውልሽ መጽደቁን እንዲያሳይሽ ኤጀንሲሽን ጠይቂ።

## "አዲስ" ውል ተጠንቀቂ

አንዳንዴ ሠራተኛዋ በአገሯ አንድ ውል ትፈርማለች። ከዚያ ከመብረሯ በፊት ወይም ከደረሰች በኋላ፣ ደመወዙ ያነሰ ወይም ሥራው የከበደ ሌላ ውል ይሰጣታል። ይህ **የውል መቀየር** ይባላል። የፍትሐዊ ቅጥር ደንቦች ውሎች ከዚህ መጠበቅ እንዳለባቸው ይገልጻሉ። [2]

አንድ ሰው አዲስ ውል ቢሰጥሽ፣ ወዲያውኑ መፈረም የለብሽም። ከመጀመሪያው ውልሽ ጋር አወዳድሪው። የሁለቱንም ፎቶ አንሺ።

## ምን ማድረግ ትችያለሽ

1. ውሉን አስቀድመሽ ጠይቂ፣ አውሮፕላን ጣቢያ ላይ አይደለም።
2. እያንዳንዱን መስመር አንብቢ። ያልገባሽን ሁሉ ጠይቂ።
3. ደመወዙን፣ ሰዓቱን፣ የዕረፍት ቀኑንና የውሉን ጊዜ አረጋግጪ።
4. የእያንዳንዱን ገጽ ግልጽ ፎቶ አንሺ። የወረቀት ቅጂም ያዢ።
5. ቅጂውን በአገር ቤት ላለው የምታምኚው ሰው ስጪ።
6. የአሠሪውን ስምና አድራሻ በዚህ መተግበሪያ ውስጥ አስቀምጪ።
7. ለምትሄጂበት አገር ያለውን "መብቶችሽ" የሚለውን ገጽ አንብቢ።
8. በውሉ ውስጥ ያሳሰበሽ ነገር ካለ፣ የሥራና ክህሎት ሚኒስቴርን ጠይቂ ወይም **የእርዳታ ማውጫውን** ተመልከቺ።
body.om:
Waliigalteen kee waadaa kee kan waraqaa irratti barreeffamee dha. Hojii akkamii akka hojjettu, hammam akka siif kaffalamu fi akkamitti akka siif yaadamu ibsa. Yoo rakkoon uumame immoo ragaa kee ti. [1]

## Waliigalteen kee maal jechuu qaba

Haala hojii keetii ifatti fi karaa ati hubattuun beekuuf mirga qabda. Waliigalteen kee kanneen armaan gadii qabaachuu isaa mirkaneessi: [1]

- **maqaa fi teessoo** hojjechiisaa, fi bakka ati itti hojjettu
- **gosa hojii** (fakkeenyaaf, qulqulleessuu, nyaata bilcheessuu, daa'imman kunuunsuu)
- **mindaa kee**, fi yeroo meeqa meeqatti akka siif kaffalamu
- **sa'aatii hojii** guyyaa
- **guyyaa boqonnaa** torbanii fi yeroo boqonnaa guyyaa
- **boqonnaa waggaa**
- waliigalteen yeroo **hammamiif** akka turu
- akkamitti **gara biyyaatti akka deebitu**, fi waliigalteen akkamitti xumuramuu akka danda'u

Hojjechiisaan **tikeetii deemaa fi deebii**, viizaa, hayyama hojii fi inshuraansii kee kaffaluu qaba. [1] Waliigalteen kee qacaramuu keetiif akka kaffaltu si gochuu hin qabu. [2]

## Afaan ati hubattu

Ejansichi waliigaltee afaan ati hubattuun barreeffame ykn hiikame siif kennuu qaba. Siif ibsuu fi garagalcha isaa siif kennuu qaba. [1] Kan mallatteessitu yoo waan hunda hubattee irratti walii galte qofa. [1]

"Kana dubbisuuf yeroon na barbaachisa" jechuun rakkoo hin qabu. Nama amanattu akka si waliin dubbisu gaafachuunis rakkoo hin qabu.

## Raggaasisa ministeeraa

Ministeerri Hojii fi Ogummaa Itoophiyaa waliigaltee hojii biyya alaa ni qorata, ni raggaasisa. Mootummaan osoo hin deemin dura garagalcha waliigaltee kee akka qabduu fi akka hubatte mirkaneessuu qaba. [1] Waliigalteen kee raggaafamuu isaa akka siif agarsiisu ejansii kee gaafadhu.

## Waliigaltee "haaraa" irraa of eeggadhu

Yeroo tokko tokko hojjettuun biyya ishee keessatti waliigaltee tokko mallatteessiti. Achiis osoo hin balali'in dura ykn erga geessee booda, waliigaltee biraa kan mindaan isaa gadi aanaa ykn hojiin isaa ulfaataa ta'e kennamaaf. Kun **waliigaltee jijjiiruu** jedhama. Seerri qacarrii haqa qabeessaa waliigalteewwan kana irraa eegamuu akka qaban ibsa. [2]

Namni tokko waliigaltee haaraa yoo siif kenne, battalumatti mallatteessuu hin qabdu. Waliigaltee kee isa jalqabaa waliin wal bira qabii ilaali. Lachuu suuraa kaasi.

## Maal gochuu dandeessa

1. Waliigaltee dursii gaafadhu, buufata xiyyaaraatti miti.
2. Sarara hunda dubbisi. Waan hin hubanne hunda gaafadhu.
3. Mindaa, sa'aatii, guyyaa boqonnaa fi yeroo waliigaltee mirkaneessi.
4. Fuula hundaa suuraa ifa ta'e kaasi. Garagalcha waraqaas qabadhu.
5. Garagalcha isaa nama amanattu kan biyya keessa jiruuf kenni.
6. Maqaa fi teessoo hojjechiisaa appii kana keessatti olkaa'i.
7. Fuula "Mirgoota kee" kan biyya itti deemtuu dubbisi.
8. Wanti waliigaltee keessa jiru yoo si yaaddesse, Ministeera Hojii fi Ogummaa gaafadhu ykn **galmee gargaarsaa** ilaali.

title.en: Abuse: what to do
