summary.en: If someone touched you or forced you into a sexual act, it is not your fault. Get safe, get medical care quickly, and choose what happens next.
summary.am: አንድ ሰው ያለፍላጎትሽ ቢነካሽ ወይም ወሲባዊ ድርጊት እንድትፈጽሚ ቢያስገድድሽ፣ ያንቺ ጥፋት አይደለም። ደህንነትሽን አረጋግጪ፣ ቶሎ ሕክምና አግኚ፣ ቀጥሎ የሚሆነውን አንቺው ምረጪ።
summary.om: Namni tokko fedhii kee malee yoo si tuqe ykn gocha saalqunnamtii akka raawwattu si dirqisiise, dogoggora kee miti. Nageenya kee mirkaneeffadhu, dafii yaala fayyaa argadhu, waan itti aanu ofii kee filadhu.

body.en:
This page talks about sexual violence. Read it when you feel ready. You can stop at any time.

If someone touched you in a sexual way you did not want, or forced you into any sexual act, **it is not your fault**. It does not matter what you wore, where you were, or who the person is. You did nothing wrong. You deserve care and respect.

## First: get safe

- If you are in danger now, press **SOS** in DadaLink or call the emergency number in the Help directory.
- If you can, go to a room you can lock, or to a safe person.

## Get medical care quickly

Time matters for some medicines. A doctor or nurse can help even if you do not want to report to the police.

- **To prevent pregnancy:** emergency contraception can be used up to 5 days after. It works better the sooner you take it. It does not end a pregnancy that has already started. [1]
- **To prevent HIV:** medicine called PEP works best within 24 hours and must be started no later than 72 hours (3 days) after. [2]
- A health worker can also check for injuries and other infections.

WHO says many women who survive violence trust health workers most when they tell someone what happened. [3]

If you come later than these times, care can still help you. Please still go.

## Evidence, only if you want

You do not have to decide now. If it feels safe, you can:

- Write what happened, when and where, in the private log in DadaLink.
- Keep the clothes you wore in a bag, without washing them.
- Take photos of any injuries.

## Reporting is your choice

You can choose to report, or not. Both choices are okay.

There are risks you should know about. In some countries, sex outside marriage is a crime. Human Rights Watch found that in Qatar, women who report rape can risk being accused themselves, and some employers have made false accusations against workers who reported abuse. [4] Many laws ban sexual harassment, for example in the UAE. [5] But before you report to the police, it can be safer to **talk to your embassy or a trusted organisation first**. They can explain your choices.

Ethiopian embassies and consulates can help with short-term shelter, medical care and legal advice, where they have the resources. [6]

## Your feelings

After sexual violence, many people feel shock, shame, fear or numbness. Some cannot sleep. These are normal reactions. They do not mean you are weak. Talking to someone you trust can help. See "Loneliness and mental health".

## Where to get help

- **SOS** in DadaLink and the emergency numbers in Help
- A hospital or clinic, for medical care
- Your embassy or consulate (in Help)
- Shelters and support groups (in Help)
- If you might be pregnant, see "Pregnancy abroad"
body.am:
ይህ ገጽ ስለ ወሲባዊ ጥቃት ይናገራል። ዝግጁ ሲሰማሽ አንብቢው። በማንኛውም ጊዜ ማቆም ትችያለሽ።

አንድ ሰው ባልፈለግሽው ወሲባዊ መንገድ ከነካሽ፣ ወይም ማንኛውንም ወሲባዊ ድርጊት እንድትፈጽሚ ካስገደደሽ፣ **ያንቺ ጥፋት አይደለም**። የለበስሽው ልብስ፣ የነበርሽበት ቦታ፣ ወይም ሰውየው ማን እንደሆነ ምንም ለውጥ የለውም። ምንም ስሕተት አልሠራሽም። እንክብካቤና አክብሮት ይገባሻል።

## መጀመሪያ፦ ደህንነትሽን አረጋግጪ

- አሁን አደጋ ላይ ከሆንሽ፣ በDadaLink ውስጥ **SOS** ተጫኚ ወይም በ"እርዳታ" ማውጫ ውስጥ ያለውን የአደጋ ጊዜ ቁጥር ደውዪ።
- ከቻልሽ ወደምትቆልፊው ክፍል፣ ወይም ወደ አስተማማኝ ሰው ሂጂ።

## ቶሎ ሕክምና አግኚ

ለአንዳንድ መድኃኒቶች ጊዜ ወሳኝ ነው። ለፖሊስ ሪፖርት ማድረግ ባትፈልጊም እንኳ ሐኪም ወይም ነርስ ሊረዳሽ ይችላል።

- **እርግዝናን ለመከላከል:** የአደጋ ጊዜ የወሊድ መከላከያ (emergency contraception) ከሆነው በኋላ እስከ 5 ቀን ድረስ መጠቀም ይቻላል። ቶሎ በወሰድሽው መጠን የበለጠ ይሠራል። አስቀድሞ የጀመረን እርግዝና አያቋርጥም። [1]
- **ኤች አይ ቪን ለመከላከል:** PEP የሚባለው መድኃኒት በ24 ሰዓት ውስጥ ሲጀመር በጣም ይሠራል፤ ከሆነው በኋላ ከ72 ሰዓት (3 ቀን) ሳይዘገይ መጀመር አለበት። [2]
- የጤና ባለሙያ ጉዳቶችን እና ሌሎች ኢንፌክሽኖችንም ሊመረምር ይችላል።

የዓለም ጤና ድርጅት (WHO) እንደሚለው ከጥቃት የተረፉ ብዙ ሴቶች የደረሰባቸውን ለመናገር ከሁሉም በላይ የጤና ባለሙያዎችን ያምናሉ። [3]

ከእነዚህ ጊዜያት በኋላ ብትመጪም ሕክምና ሊረዳሽ ይችላል። እባክሽ ሂጂ።

## ማስረጃ፣ ከፈለግሽ ብቻ

አሁን መወሰን የለብሽም። ደህንነት ከተሰማሽ፦

- የሆነውን፣ መቼ እና የት እንደሆነ በDadaLink የግል ማስታወሻ ውስጥ ጻፊ።
- የለበስሽውን ልብስ ሳታጥቢ በከረጢት አስቀምጪ።
- የጉዳቶችን ፎቶ አንሺ።

## ሪፖርት ማድረግ ያንቺ ምርጫ ነው

ሪፖርት ለማድረግም ላለማድረግም መምረጥ ትችያለሽ። ሁለቱም ምርጫዎች ትክክል ናቸው።

ማወቅ ያለብሽ አደጋዎች አሉ። በአንዳንድ አገሮች ከጋብቻ ውጭ የሚደረግ ወሲብ ወንጀል ነው። ሂዩማን ራይትስ ዎች በኳታር አስገድዶ መድፈርን ሪፖርት የሚያደርጉ ሴቶች ራሳቸው ሊከሰሱ እንደሚችሉ፣ እንዲሁም አንዳንድ አሠሪዎች ጥቃትን ሪፖርት ባደረጉ ሠራተኞች ላይ የሐሰት ክስ እንደመሠረቱ አግኝቷል። [4] ብዙ ሕጎች ወሲባዊ ትንኮሳን ይከለክላሉ፤ ለምሳሌ በUAE። [5] ነገር ግን ለፖሊስ ሪፖርት ከማድረግሽ በፊት **መጀመሪያ ኤምባሲሽን ወይም የምታምኚውን ድርጅት ማነጋገር** ይበልጥ አስተማማኝ ሊሆን ይችላል። ምርጫዎችሽን ሊያስረዱሽ ይችላሉ።

የኢትዮጵያ ኤምባሲዎችና ቆንስላዎች አቅም ባላቸው ቦታ በጊዜያዊ መጠለያ፣ በሕክምና እና በሕግ ምክር ሊረዱ ይችላሉ። [6]

## ስሜትሽ

ከወሲባዊ ጥቃት በኋላ ብዙ ሰዎች ድንጋጤ፣ ኀፍረት፣ ፍርሃት ወይም ምንም አለመሰማት ይሰማቸዋል። አንዳንዶች መተኛት አይችሉም። እነዚህ የተለመዱ ምላሾች ናቸው። ደካማ ነሽ ማለት አይደለም። ከምታምኚው ሰው ጋር መነጋገር ሊረዳ ይችላል። "ብቸኝነት እና የአእምሮ ጤና" የሚለውን ተመልከቺ።

## እርዳታ የት ይገኛል

- በDadaLink ውስጥ **SOS** እና በ"እርዳታ" ውስጥ ያሉት የአደጋ ጊዜ ቁጥሮች
- ለሕክምና ሆስፒታል ወይም ክሊኒክ
- ኤምባሲሽ ወይም ቆንስላሽ (በ"እርዳታ" ውስጥ)
- መጠለያዎች እና የድጋፍ ቡድኖች (በ"እርዳታ" ውስጥ)
- አርግዘሽ ሊሆን ይችላል ብለሽ ካሰብሽ "በውጭ አገር እርግዝና" የሚለውን ተመልከቺ
body.om:
Fuulli kun waa'ee miidhaa saalaa dubbata. Yeroo qophii taate dubbisi. Yeroo barbaadde dhaabuu dandeessa.

Namni tokko karaa saalaa ati hin barbaanneen yoo si tuqe, ykn gocha saalqunnamtii kamiyyuu akka raawwattu yoo si dirqisiise, **dogoggora kee miti**. Uffanni ati uffatte, bakki ati turte ykn namichi eenyu akka ta'e homaa hin jijjiiru. Ati homaa hin balleessine. Kunuunsii fi kabajni siif mala.

## Jalqaba: nageenya kee mirkaneeffadhu

- Yoo amma balaa keessa jirte, DadaLink keessatti **SOS** tuqi ykn lakkoofsa balaa tarree "Gargaarsa" keessa jiru bilbili.
- Yoo dandeesse, gara kutaa ati cufachuu dandeessuu, ykn gara nama amanamaa deemi.

## Dafii yaala fayyaa argadhu

Qorichoota tokko tokkoof yeroon murteessaadha. Poolisiitti gabaasuu baattus, ogeessi fayyaa ykn narsiin si gargaaruu danda'a.

- **Ulfa ittisuuf:** qorichi ulfa ittisu kan yeroo ariifachiisaa (emergency contraception) erga wanti sun ta'ee booda hanga guyyaa 5tti fayyadamuun ni danda'ama. Dafte fudhachuun caalaatti hojjeta. Ulfa duraan jalqabe hin balleessu. [1]
- **HIV ittisuuf:** qorichi PEP jedhamu sa'aatii 24 keessatti yoo jalqabame caalaatti hojjeta; erga wanti sun ta'ee sa'aatii 72 (guyyaa 3) osoo hin darbin jalqabamuu qaba. [2]
- Ogeessi fayyaa madaa fi infekshinii biroos siif qorachuu danda'a.

Dhaabbanni Fayyaa Addunyaa (WHO) akka jedhutti, dubartoonni miidhaa jalaa hafan baay'een waan isaan mudate himuuf ogeessota fayyaa caalaatti amanu. [3]

Yoo yeroowwan kanneen booda dhufte illee, yaalli si gargaaruu danda'a. Maaloo ammallee deemi.

## Ragaa, yoo barbaadde qofa

Amma murteessuu hin qabdu. Yoo nageenyi sitti dhaga'ame:

- Waan ta'e, yoom fi eessatti akka ta'e DadaLink keessatti galmee dhuunfaa keessa barreessi.
- Uffata ati uffatte osoo hin miiccin korojoo keessa kaa'i.
- Suuraa madaa kaasi.

## Gabaasuun filannoo keeti

Gabaasuu ykn gabaasuu dhiisuu filachuu dandeessa. Filannoon lamaanuu sirriidha.

Balaawwan beekuu qabdu ni jiru. Biyyoota tokko tokko keessatti saalqunnamtiin gaa'ela alaa yakka. Human Rights Watch akka argetti, Qatar keessatti dubartoonni gudeeddii gabaasan ofii isaaniitii himatamuu akka danda'an, akkasumas hojjechiisoonni tokko tokko hojjettoota miidhaa gabaasan irratti himannaa sobaa akka dhiyeessan argateera. [4] Seerota baay'eetu dararaa saalaa dhorka, fakkeenyaaf UAE keessatti. [5] Garuu poolisiitti gabaasuu kee dura, **jalqaba embaasii kee ykn dhaabbata amantu haasofsiisuun** caalaatti nageenya qabaachuu danda'a. Filannoowwan kee siif ibsuu danda'u.

Embaasiiwwanii fi qonsilaawwan Itoophiyaa, bakka dandeettii qabanitti, iddoo jireenyaa yeroo gabaabaa, yaala fayyaa fi gorsa seeraatiin gargaaruu danda'u. [6]

## Miira kee

Miidhaa saalaa booda namoonni baay'een rifaatuu, qaanii, sodaa ykn homaa itti dhaga'amuu dhabuu qabaatu. Tokko tokko rafuu hin danda'an. Kunneen deebii baramoo dha. Dadhabduu taatee jechuu miti. Nama amantu waliin haasa'uun gargaaruu danda'a. "Kophummaa fi fayyaa sammuu" ilaali.

## Gargaarsa eessatti argatta

- DadaLink keessatti **SOS** fi lakkoofsota balaa "Gargaarsa" keessa jiran
- Yaala fayyaaf hospitaala ykn kilinikii
- Embaasii ykn qonsilaa kee ("Gargaarsa" keessa)
- Iddoowwan baqannaa fi gareewwan deeggarsaa ("Gargaarsa" keessa)
- Yoo ulfa taate jettee yaadde, "Ulfa biyya alaatti" ilaali

title.en: I am sick or injured
title.om: Dhukkubsadheera ykn miidhameera

summary.en: Your health comes first. In many countries your employer must give you medical care. Here is what to do and how to keep records.
summary.am: ጤናሽ ይቀድማል። በብዙ አገሮች አሠሪሽ ሕክምና ሊሰጥሽ ይገባል። ምን ማድረግ እንዳለብሽ እና መዝገብ እንዴት እንደምትይዢ እነሆ።
summary.om: Fayyaan kee dursa. Biyyoota baay'ee keessatti hojjechiisaan kee yaala fayyaa siif kennuu qaba. Maal gochuu akka qabdu fi akkamitti galmee akka qabattu kunooti.

body.en:
When you are sick or hurt, it is hard to be far from home. You deserve care. Being sick is not your fault, and asking for a doctor is not asking for too much.

## In an emergency

Go to hospital or call for help **now** if you:

- Cannot breathe well
- Have very bad pain in your chest or belly
- Are bleeding a lot
- Fainted, or hit your head badly
- Have a high fever that does not go down
- Were hurt by someone

Press **SOS** in DadaLink, or call the ambulance number in the Help directory.

## What the law says

Rules are different in each country. Some examples:

- **Qatar:** Your employer must give you health care and medicines if you are sick or injured at work, without making you pay. Your employer must not make you work during your sick leave. [1]
- **UAE:** Your employer must give you medical care or health insurance, and pay compensation for work injuries. You can have up to 30 days of sick leave a year. [2]
- **Saudi Arabia:** News reports on the 2013 regulation say workers get up to 30 days of paid sick leave, based on medical reports. [3]
- **Kuwait:** The domestic worker law says the employer must provide medical treatment. [4]

For more, see your country's rights page in DadaLink.

## What you can do

1. **Tell your employer** you are sick or hurt, and ask to see a doctor. Say it clearly: "I need to see a doctor, please."
2. **Keep your papers.** Ask for a copy of any medical report, prescription or sick note. Take photos and save them in the private log in DadaLink.
3. **Write it down.** In the private log, write when you got sick or hurt, how it happened, and what your employer said.
4. **Rest when the doctor says.** Your health matters more than the housework.
5. **If your employer refuses care,** contact your embassy. Ethiopian embassies and consulates can help vulnerable workers get medical treatment, where they have the resources. [5]
6. **If you were hurt by someone,** you can also read "Abuse: what to do".

## Where to get help

- Ambulance and emergency numbers (in Help in DadaLink)
- Your embassy or consulate (in Help)
- Your country's rights page in DadaLink
body.am:
ስትታመሚ ወይም ስትጎጂ ከቤት ርቆ መሆን ከባድ ነው። ሕክምና ይገባሻል። መታመም ያንቺ ጥፋት አይደለም፤ ሐኪም ማየት መጠየቅም ብዙ መጠየቅ አይደለም።

## በአደጋ ጊዜ

እነዚህ ካጋጠሙሽ **አሁኑኑ** ወደ ሆስፒታል ሂጂ ወይም እርዳታ ጥሪ፦

- በደንብ መተንፈስ ካቃተሽ
- በደረትሽ ወይም በሆድሽ ላይ በጣም ከባድ ሕመም ካለ
- ብዙ ደም እየፈሰሰሽ ከሆነ
- ራስሽን ከሳትሽ ወይም ጭንቅላትሽን በኃይል ከተመታሽ
- የማይቀንስ ከፍተኛ ትኩሳት ካለሽ
- አንድ ሰው ከጎዳሽ

በDadaLink ውስጥ **SOS** ተጫኚ፣ ወይም በ"እርዳታ" ማውጫ ውስጥ ያለውን የአምቡላንስ ቁጥር ደውዪ።

## ሕጉ ምን ይላል

ሕጎቹ በእያንዳንዱ አገር የተለያዩ ናቸው። አንዳንድ ምሳሌዎች፦

- **ኳታር:** በሥራ ላይ ወይም በሥራ ምክንያት ከታመምሽ ወይም ከተጎዳሽ፣ አሠሪሽ ያለ ክፍያ ሕክምና እና መድኃኒት ሊሰጥሽ ይገባል። አሠሪሽ በሕመም ፈቃድሽ ጊዜ ሊያሠራሽ አይገባም። [1]
- **UAE:** አሠሪሽ ሕክምና ወይም የጤና መድን ሊሰጥሽ፣ እና በሥራ ላይ ለደረሰ ጉዳት ካሳ ሊከፍል ይገባል። በዓመት እስከ 30 ቀን የሕመም ፈቃድ ሊኖርሽ ይችላል። [2]
- **ሳዑዲ አረቢያ:** ስለ 2013 ደንብ የወጡ ዜናዎች እንደሚሉት ሠራተኞች በሕክምና ሪፖርት መሠረት እስከ 30 ቀን የሚከፈልበት የሕመም ፈቃድ ያገኛሉ። [3]
- **ኩዌት:** የቤት ሠራተኞች ሕግ አሠሪው ሕክምና መስጠት እንዳለበት ይናገራል። [4]

ለተጨማሪ መረጃ በDadaLink ውስጥ ያለውን የአገርሽን የመብቶች ገጽ ተመልከቺ።

## ምን ማድረግ ትችያለሽ

1. እንደታመምሽ ወይም እንደተጎዳሽ **ለአሠሪሽ ንገሪ**፤ ሐኪም ለማየትም ጠይቂ። በግልጽ እንዲህ በዪ፦ "እባክዎ ሐኪም ማየት አለብኝ።"
2. **ወረቀቶችሽን አስቀምጪ።** የማንኛውንም የሕክምና ሪፖርት፣ የመድኃኒት ማዘዣ ወይም የሕመም ፈቃድ ወረቀት ቅጂ ጠይቂ። ፎቶ አንሺና በDadaLink የግል ማስታወሻ ውስጥ አስቀምጪ።
3. **ጻፊው።** በግል ማስታወሻሽ ውስጥ መቼ እንደታመምሽ ወይም እንደተጎዳሽ፣ እንዴት እንደደረሰ እና አሠሪሽ ምን እንዳለ ጻፊ።
4. **ሐኪሙ ባለው መሠረት እረፊ።** ጤናሽ ከቤት ሥራው ይበልጣል።
5. **አሠሪሽ ሕክምና ከከለከለሽ** ኤምባሲሽን አግኚ። የኢትዮጵያ ኤምባሲዎችና ቆንስላዎች አቅም ባላቸው ቦታ ችግር ላይ ያሉ ሠራተኞች ሕክምና እንዲያገኙ ሊረዱ ይችላሉ። [5]
6. **አንድ ሰው ጎድቶሽ ከሆነ**፣ "ጥቃት፦ ምን ማድረግ አለብኝ" የሚለውንም ማንበብ ትችያለሽ።

## እርዳታ የት ይገኛል

- የአምቡላንስና የአደጋ ጊዜ ቁጥሮች (በDadaLink "እርዳታ" ውስጥ)
- ኤምባሲሽ ወይም ቆንስላሽ (በ"እርዳታ" ውስጥ)
- በDadaLink ውስጥ ያለው የአገርሽ የመብቶች ገጽ
body.om:
Yeroo dhukkubsattu ykn miidhamtu, mana irraa fagaachuun ulfaataadha. Yaalli siif mala. Dhukkubsachuun dogoggora kee miti; ogeessa fayyaa arguu gaafachuunis waan baay'ee gaafachuu miti.

## Yeroo balaa

Wantoonni kunneen yoo si mudatan, **amma** hospitaala deemi ykn gargaarsa waami:

- Yoo sirriitti hafuura baafachuu dadhabde
- Yoo laphee ykn garaa kee irratti dhukkubbii cimaa qabaatte
- Yoo dhiigni baay'een sirraa dhangala'e
- Yoo of wallaalte ykn mataa kee cimsitee rukutamte
- Yoo ho'i qaamaa olaanaan (fiivarii) kan hin gadi buune si qabate
- Yoo namni tokko si miidhe

DadaLink keessatti **SOS** tuqi, ykn lakkoofsa ambulaansii tarree "Gargaarsa" keessa jiru bilbili.

## Seerri maal jedha

Seerri biyya tokkoon tokkoon keessatti garaagara. Fakkeenya muraasa:

- **Qatar:** Yoo hojii irratti ykn sababa hojiitiin dhukkubsatte ykn miidhamte, hojjechiisaan kee kaffaltii tokko malee yaala fayyaa fi qoricha siif kennuu qaba. Hojjechiisaan kee yeroo hayyama dhukkubaa keetti si hojjechiisuu hin qabu. [1]
- **UAE:** Hojjechiisaan kee yaala fayyaa ykn inshuraansii fayyaa siif kennuu, akkasumas miidhaa hojii irratti si qaqqabeef beenyaa kaffaluu qaba. Waggaatti hanga guyyoota 30 hayyama dhukkubaa qabaachuu dandeessa. [2]
- **Saawudii Arabiyaa:** Oduuwwan waa'ee qajeelfama bara 2013 bahan akka jedhanitti, hojjettoonni gabaasa yaala fayyaa irratti hundaa'uun hanga guyyoota 30 hayyama dhukkubaa kaffaltii qabu ni argatu. [3]
- **Kuweet:** Seerri hojjettoota manaa hojjechiisaan yaala fayyaa kennuu akka qabu ni jedha. [4]

Odeeffannoo dabalataaf, fuula mirgaa biyya keetii DadaLink keessa jiru ilaali.

## Maal gochuu dandeessa

1. Akka dhukkubsatte ykn miidhamte **hojjechiisaa keetti himi**, ogeessa fayyaa arguus gaafadhu. Ifatti akkana jedhi: "Maaloo, ogeessa fayyaa arguu qaba."
2. **Waraqaalee kee qabadhu.** Garagalcha gabaasa yaalaa, ajaja qorichaa ykn waraqaa hayyama dhukkubaa kamiyyuu gaafadhu. Suuraa kaasiitii DadaLink keessatti galmee dhuunfaa keessa kaa'i.
3. **Barreessi.** Galmee dhuunfaa kee keessatti yoom akka dhukkubsatte ykn miidhamte, akkamitti akka ta'e fi hojjechiisaan kee maal akka jedhe barreessi.
4. **Akkuma ogeessi fayyaa jedhetti boqodhu.** Fayyaan kee hojii manaa caala.
5. **Yoo hojjechiisaan kee yaala sitti dide,** embaasii kee quunnami. Embaasiiwwanii fi qonsilaawwan Itoophiyaa, bakka dandeettii qabanitti, hojjettoonni rakkoo keessa jiran yaala fayyaa akka argatan gargaaruu danda'u. [5]
6. **Yoo namni tokko si miidhe,** "Miidhaa: maal gochuu qaba" jedhu dubbisuu dandeessa.

## Gargaarsa eessatti argatta

- Lakkoofsota ambulaansii fi balaa (DadaLink "Gargaarsa" keessa)
- Embaasii ykn qonsilaa kee ("Gargaarsa" keessa)
- Fuula mirgaa biyya keetii DadaLink keessa jiru

title.en: My employer is not paying my salary
title.om: Hojjechiisaan koo mindaa koo hin kaffalu

summary.en: You have the right to be paid for your work. Keep a record of every payment and know where to complain.
summary.am: ለሥራሽ ክፍያ የማግኘት መብት አለሽ። የእያንዳንዱን ክፍያ መዝገብ ያዢ፤ ቅሬታ የት እንደምታቀርቢም እወቂ።
summary.om: Hojii keetiif kaffaltii argachuuf mirga qabda. Kaffaltii hunda galmeessi, akkasumas eessatti komii dhiyeessitu beeki.

body.en:
You work hard. You have the right to be paid the salary in your contract, on time and in full. If your salary is late, cut, or not paid at all, this is not your fault. There are steps you can take.

## What the law says

Each country has its own rules. Some examples:

- **UAE:** Domestic workers must be paid as the contract says, within 10 days of the date it is due. [1]
- **Qatar:** The employer must pay your monthly salary by the third day of the next month. The employer must be able to prove you were paid, by a bank transfer or by a paper you signed. The employer must not take money from your salary for the cost of bringing you to Qatar. [2]
- **Saudi Arabia:** The government started a "Wage Protection Service" for domestic workers. Salaries are paid through approved digital wallets and banks linked to the Musaned platform. It was planned to cover all domestic workers by January 2026. [3]

These systems leave a record of each payment. That record can help you if there is a dispute.

For your country, see your country's rights page in DadaLink.

## Keep a record

A clear record makes your complaint much stronger. In the private log in DadaLink, write down:

- The salary in your contract
- Each date you were paid, and how much
- How you were paid (cash, bank, wallet app)
- Any month you were not paid, or paid less
- What your employer said when you asked

If you are paid into a bank or wallet app, take screenshots. Never sign a paper saying you were paid if you were not. Keep a photo of your contract.

## What you can do

1. **Ask politely** for your salary, if it is safe. Note the date and the answer in your log.
2. **Contact your embassy.** Ethiopian embassies and consulates can help settle disputes with employers about unpaid wages and broken contracts. [4]
3. **Complain to the labour ministry** in your country. Find how to reach them under Help in DadaLink.
4. **Do not give up your rights** when you leave or go home. Ask the embassy how to claim money you are still owed.

## When it is more serious

If your employer keeps your salary on purpose so that you cannot leave, this can be a sign of forced labour. [5] If you are also locked in, threatened or hurt, press **SOS** in DadaLink or call the emergency numbers in Help.

## Where to get help

- Your embassy or consulate (numbers in Help in DadaLink)
- The labour ministry in your country (in Help)
- Your country's rights page in DadaLink
body.am:
ጠንክረሽ ትሠሪያለሽ። በውልሽ ውስጥ ያለውን ደመወዝ በሰዓቱ እና ሙሉ በሙሉ የማግኘት መብት አለሽ። ደመወዝሽ ከዘገየ፣ ከተቀነሰ ወይም ጭራሽ ካልተከፈለ፣ ይህ ያንቺ ጥፋት አይደለም። ልትወስጃቸው የምትችዪ እርምጃዎች አሉ።

## ሕጉ ምን ይላል

እያንዳንዱ አገር የራሱ ሕግ አለው። አንዳንድ ምሳሌዎች፦

- **UAE:** የቤት ሠራተኞች ውሉ በሚለው መሠረት፣ ደመወዙ ከሚደርስበት ቀን በ10 ቀን ውስጥ መከፈል አለባቸው። [1]
- **ኳታር:** አሠሪው ወርሃዊ ደመወዝሽን እስከሚቀጥለው ወር 3ኛ ቀን ድረስ መክፈል አለበት። አሠሪው እንደተከፈለሽ በባንክ ዝውውር ወይም አንቺ በፈረምሽው ወረቀት ማረጋገጥ መቻል አለበት። አሠሪው አንቺን ወደ ኳታር ያመጣበትን ወጪ ከደመወዝሽ መቀነስ የለበትም። [2]
- **ሳዑዲ አረቢያ:** መንግሥት ለቤት ሠራተኞች "የደመወዝ ጥበቃ አገልግሎት" ጀምሯል። ደመወዝ ከሙሳነድ (Musaned) መድረክ ጋር በተገናኙ በተፈቀዱ ዲጂታል ዋሌቶች እና ባንኮች ይከፈላል። እስከ ጃንዋሪ 2026 ድረስ ሁሉንም የቤት ሠራተኞች እንዲያካትት ታቅዶ ነበር። [3]

እነዚህ ሥርዓቶች የእያንዳንዱን ክፍያ መዝገብ ይተዋሉ። አለመግባባት ቢፈጠር ያ መዝገብ ሊረዳሽ ይችላል።

ለአገርሽ፣ በDadaLink ውስጥ ያለውን የአገርሽን የመብቶች ገጽ ተመልከቺ።

## መዝገብ ያዢ

ግልጽ መዝገብ ቅሬታሽን በጣም ያጠነክረዋል። በDadaLink የግል ማስታወሻ ውስጥ እነዚህን ጻፊ፦

- በውልሽ ውስጥ ያለው ደመወዝ
- የተከፈለሽ እያንዳንዱ ቀን እና መጠኑ
- እንዴት እንደተከፈለሽ (በጥሬ ገንዘብ፣ በባንክ፣ በዋሌት መተግበሪያ)
- ያልተከፈለሽ ወይም ያነሰ የተከፈለሽ ወር
- ስትጠይቂ አሠሪሽ ምን እንዳለ

በባንክ ወይም በዋሌት መተግበሪያ ከተከፈለሽ፣ የስክሪን ፎቶ አንሺ። ያልተከፈለሽ ከሆነ "ተከፍሎኛል" የሚል ወረቀት በፍጹም አትፈርሚ። የውልሽን ፎቶ አስቀምጪ።

## ምን ማድረግ ትችያለሽ

1. ደህንነትሽ የተጠበቀ ከሆነ **በትሕትና ደመወዝሽን ጠይቂ**። ቀኑን እና መልሱን በማስታወሻሽ ጻፊ።
2. **ኤምባሲሽን አግኚ።** የኢትዮጵያ ኤምባሲዎችና ቆንስላዎች ስላልተከፈለ ደመወዝ እና ስለተጣሱ ውሎች ከአሠሪዎች ጋር ያሉ አለመግባባቶችን ለመፍታት ሊረዱ ይችላሉ። [4]
3. በአገሩ ላለው **የሠራተኛ ሚኒስቴር ቅሬታ አቅርቢ**። እንዴት እንደምታገኛቸው በDadaLink "እርዳታ" ውስጥ ተመልከቺ።
4. ሥራ ስትለቂ ወይም ወደ አገር ቤት ስትመለሺ **መብትሽን አትተዪ**። ገና ያልተከፈለሽን ገንዘብ እንዴት እንደምትጠይቂ ኤምባሲውን ጠይቂ።

## ጉዳዩ ይበልጥ ከባድ ሲሆን

አሠሪሽ እንዳትለቂ ብሎ ሆን ብሎ ደመወዝሽን ከያዘ፣ ይህ የግዳጅ ሥራ ምልክት ሊሆን ይችላል። [5] በተጨማሪ ቤት ውስጥ ከተቆለፈብሽ፣ ከተዛተብሽ ወይም ከተጎዳሽ፣ በDadaLink ውስጥ **SOS** ተጫኚ ወይም በ"እርዳታ" ውስጥ ያሉትን የአደጋ ጊዜ ቁጥሮች ደውዪ።

## እርዳታ የት ይገኛል

- ኤምባሲሽ ወይም ቆንስላሽ (ቁጥሮቹ በDadaLink "እርዳታ" ውስጥ)
- በአገሩ ያለው የሠራተኛ ሚኒስቴር (በ"እርዳታ" ውስጥ)
- በDadaLink ውስጥ ያለው የአገርሽ የመብቶች ገጽ
body.om:
Cimtee hojjetta. Mindaa waliigaltee kee keessatti barreeffame yeroodhaan fi guutummaatti argachuuf mirga qabda. Mindaan kee yoo turee, yoo hir'ifame ykn gonkumaa yoo hin kaffalamne, kun dogoggora kee miti. Tarkaanfiiwwan fudhachuu dandeessu ni jiru.

## Seerri maal jedha

Biyyi tokkoon tokkoon seera mataa isaa qaba. Fakkeenya muraasa:

- **UAE:** Hojjettoonni manaa akkuma waliigalteen jedhutti, guyyaa kaffaltiin ga'u irraa eegalee guyyoota 10 keessatti kaffalamuu qabu. [1]
- **Qatar:** Hojjechiisaan mindaa ji'aa kee hanga guyyaa 3ffaa ji'a itti aanuutti kaffaluu qaba. Hojjechiisaan akka siif kaffalame, karaa baankii ykn waraqaa ati mallatteessiteen mirkaneessuu danda'uu qaba. Hojjechiisaan baasii si gara Qatar fiduuf baase mindaa kee irraa hir'isuu hin qabu. [2]
- **Saawudii Arabiyaa:** Mootummaan hojjettoota manaatiif "Tajaajila Eegumsa Mindaa" jalqabeera. Mindaan karaa waalletii dijitaalaa fi baankiiwwan hayyamaman kanneen waltajjii Musaned waliin walqabatan kaffalama. Hanga Jaanuwaarii 2026tti hojjettoota manaa hunda akka hammatu karoorfamee ture. [3]

Sirnoonni kunneen kaffaltii hundaaf galmee ni hambisu. Yoo walmormiin uumame, galmeen sun si gargaaruu danda'a.

Biyya keetiif, fuula mirgaa biyya keetii DadaLink keessa jiru ilaali.

## Galmee qabadhu

Galmeen ifa ta'e komii kee baay'ee cimsa. DadaLink keessatti galmee dhuunfaa keessa kanneen kana barreessi:

- Mindaa waliigaltee kee keessa jiru
- Guyyaa siif kaffalame hunda fi hamma isaa
- Akkamitti akka siif kaffalame (maallaqa harkaa, baankii, appii waalletii)
- Ji'a siif hin kaffalamne ykn xiqqaa siif kaffalame
- Yeroo gaafatte hojjechiisaan kee maal akka jedhe

Yoo karaa baankii ykn appii waalletiitiin siif kaffalame, suuraa iskiriinii kaasi. Yoo siif hin kaffalamne, waraqaa "naaf kaffalameera" jedhu gonkumaa hin mallatteessin. Suuraa waliigaltee keetii qabadhu.

## Maal gochuu dandeessa

1. Yoo nageenyi jiraate, **kabajaan mindaa kee gaafadhu**. Guyyaa fi deebii isaa galmee kee keessatti barreessi.
2. **Embaasii kee quunnami.** Embaasiiwwanii fi qonsilaawwan Itoophiyaa walmormii hojjechiisota waliin mindaa hin kaffalamnee fi waliigaltee cabe irratti jiru furuuf gargaaruu danda'u. [4]
3. **Ministeera Hojii biyya sanaatti komii dhiyeessi.** Akkamitti akka isaan quunnamtu DadaLink "Gargaarsa" keessatti ilaali.
4. Yeroo hojii gadhiiftu ykn gara biyyaatti deebitu **mirga kee hin dhiisin**. Maallaqa ammallee siif hin kaffalamne akkamitti akka gaafattu embaasii gaafadhu.

## Yeroo dhimmichi caalaatti cimu

Hojjechiisaan kee akka ati hin deemneef jedhee beekaa mindaa kee yoo qabate, kun mallattoo hojii dirqiisaa ta'uu danda'a. [5] Dabalataan yoo mana keessatti siif cufame, yoo sitti doorsifame ykn yoo miidhamte, DadaLink keessatti **SOS** tuqi ykn lakkoofsota balaa "Gargaarsa" keessa jiran bilbili.

## Gargaarsa eessatti argatta

- Embaasii ykn qonsilaa kee (lakkoofsonni DadaLink "Gargaarsa" keessa jiru)
- Ministeera Hojii biyya sanaa ("Gargaarsa" keessa)
- Fuula mirgaa biyya keetii DadaLink keessa jiru

summary.en: What usually happens when returnees land in Addis Ababa, and what help you can ask for with food, shelter, health, counselling and getting home.
summary.am: ተመላሾች አዲስ አበባ ሲደርሱ በአብዛኛው የሚሆነው ነገር፣ እና በምግብ፣ በመጠለያ፣ በጤና፣ በምክር አገልግሎትና ወደ ቤት በመሄድ ልትጠይቂው የምትችዪው እርዳታ።

body.en:
Coming home can bring many feelings at once. You may feel relief, worry, joy and tiredness all together. Here is what usually happens when Ethiopians come back, especially on large return flights from Saudi Arabia.

## At Bole airport

- IOM, the UN migration agency, registers returnees from Saudi Arabia at Bole International Airport. The most vulnerable people get help with travel [2].
- During the big returns from Saudi Arabia in 2022, IOM said returnees were offered food, a temporary place to stay, medical help and counselling [1].
- In January 2026, the Ministry of Women and Social Affairs said support starts at the airport and continues at transit centres, with work to reunite people with their families [3].

Help can change from month to month, and it depends on money and space. Sometimes reception centres are very full [2]. Ask the staff at the airport what help is available for you today.

## Transit centres and shelters

Some returnees stay for a short time in a transit centre in Addis Ababa. IOM gives counselling at its transit centre before people travel on to their home areas [4].

If you have nowhere safe to go, ask about a shelter. Groups such as Good Samaritan Association and Agar Ethiopia have run shelters for women returnees, with medical care and counselling [5].

## Getting home to your region

Ask if you can get help with transport to your home area. IOM gives travel help to the most vulnerable returnees [2]. Some people from areas with conflict could not go home straight away and had to stay longer in shelters [2]. If this happens to you, keep asking for information and support.

## Your health and your feelings

You can ask to see a doctor or nurse if you are sick, hurt or pregnant. You can also ask to talk to a counsellor. After you reach home, local health workers may give more counselling [4].

See "Health check after return" and "Mental health after return".

## What you can do

1. Keep your papers and phone with you.
2. Tell the staff if you are sick, hurt, pregnant, or under 18.
3. Ask about food, a place to sleep, transport home and counselling.
4. Call a family member or friend you trust.
5. Save the Help numbers in DadaLink for Ethiopia.
6. If you feel unsafe at any time, use SOS.

You have come through a hard journey. You deserve care and support now.
body.am:
ወደ ቤት መመለስ ብዙ ስሜቶችን በአንድ ጊዜ ሊያመጣ ይችላል። እፎይታ፣ ጭንቀት፣ ደስታና ድካም በአንድ ላይ ሊሰማሽ ይችላል። ኢትዮጵያውያን ሲመለሱ፣ በተለይም ከሳዑዲ ዓረቢያ በትልልቅ የመመለሻ በረራዎች ሲመጡ፣ በአብዛኛው የሚሆነው ይህ ነው።

## በቦሌ አየር ማረፊያ

- የተባበሩት መንግሥታት የፍልሰት ድርጅት (IOM) ከሳዑዲ ዓረቢያ የሚመለሱትን በቦሌ ዓለም አቀፍ አየር ማረፊያ ይመዘግባል። በጣም ተጋላጭ የሆኑ ሰዎች የጉዞ እርዳታ ያገኛሉ [2]።
- በ2022 ከሳዑዲ ዓረቢያ ብዙ ሰዎች ሲመለሱ፣ ተመላሾች ምግብ፣ ጊዜያዊ ማረፊያ፣ የሕክምና እርዳታና የምክር አገልግሎት እንደቀረበላቸው IOM ተናግሯል [1]።
- በጥር 2026 የሴቶችና ማኅበራዊ ጉዳይ ሚኒስቴር፣ ድጋፉ ከአየር ማረፊያ ጀምሮ በመሸጋገሪያ ማዕከላት እንደሚቀጥልና ሰዎችን ከቤተሰቦቻቸው ጋር የማገናኘት ሥራ እንዳለ ተናግሯል [3]።

እርዳታው ከወር ወር ሊለወጥ ይችላል፤ በገንዘብና በቦታ ላይም ይወሰናል። አንዳንድ ጊዜ የመቀበያ ማዕከላት በጣም ይሞላሉ [2]። ዛሬ ምን እርዳታ እንዳለ በአየር ማረፊያው ያሉትን ሠራተኞች ጠይቂ።

## የመሸጋገሪያ ማዕከላትና መጠለያዎች

አንዳንድ ተመላሾች በአዲስ አበባ ባለ የመሸጋገሪያ ማዕከል ለአጭር ጊዜ ይቆያሉ። IOM ሰዎች ወደ አካባቢያቸው ከመሄዳቸው በፊት በመሸጋገሪያ ማዕከሉ የምክር አገልግሎት ይሰጣል [4]።

ደህና የምትሄጂበት ቦታ ከሌለሽ ስለ መጠለያ ጠይቂ። እንደ ጉድ ሳምራሪታን ማኅበርና አጋር ኢትዮጵያ ያሉ ድርጅቶች ለተመላሽ ሴቶች የሕክምናና የምክር አገልግሎት ያላቸው መጠለያዎችን አካሂደዋል [5]።

## ወደ አካባቢሽ መሄድ

ወደ ቤትሽ አካባቢ ለመሄድ የትራንስፖርት እርዳታ ማግኘት እንደምትችዪ ጠይቂ። IOM በጣም ተጋላጭ ለሆኑ ተመላሾች የጉዞ እርዳታ ይሰጣል [2]። ግጭት ካለባቸው አካባቢዎች የመጡ አንዳንድ ሰዎች ወዲያውኑ ወደ ቤት መሄድ ስላልቻሉ በመጠለያ ውስጥ ረዘም ላለ ጊዜ ቆይተዋል [2]። ይህ ካጋጠመሽ መረጃና ድጋፍ መጠየቅሽን ቀጥዪ።

## ጤናሽና ስሜትሽ

ከታመምሽ፣ ከተጎዳሽ ወይም ካረገዝሽ ሐኪም ወይም ነርስ ለማየት መጠየቅ ትችያለሽ። ከአማካሪ ጋር ለመነጋገርም መጠየቅ ትችያለሽ። ቤት ከደረስሽ በኋላ የአካባቢ የጤና ባለሙያዎች ተጨማሪ የምክር አገልግሎት ሊሰጡ ይችላሉ [4]።

"ከተመለስሽ በኋላ የጤና ምርመራ" እና "ከተመለስሽ በኋላ የአእምሮ ጤና" የሚሉትን ገጾች ተመልከቺ።

## ምን ማድረግ ትችያለሽ

1. ሰነዶችሽንና ስልክሽን ከአንቺ ጋር ያዢ።
2. ከታመምሽ፣ ከተጎዳሽ፣ ካረገዝሽ ወይም ዕድሜሽ ከ18 በታች ከሆነ ለሠራተኞቹ ንገሪ።
3. ስለ ምግብ፣ ስለ ማደሪያ፣ ወደ ቤት ስለመሄጃና ስለ ምክር አገልግሎት ጠይቂ።
4. የምታምኚውን የቤተሰብ አባል ወይም ጓደኛ ደውዪ።
5. በDadaLink ውስጥ ያሉትን የኢትዮጵያ የእርዳታ ቁጥሮች አስቀምጪ።
6. በማንኛውም ጊዜ ደህንነት ካልተሰማሽ SOSን ተጠቀሚ።

ከባድ ጉዞን አልፈሻል። አሁን እንክብካቤና ድጋፍ ይገባሻል።
body.om:
Gara manaatti deebi'uun miira baay'ee yeroo tokkotti fiduu danda'a. Boqonnaa, yaaddoo, gammachuu fi dadhabbiin walfaana sitti dhaga'amuu danda'a. Yeroo Itoophiyaanonni deebi'an, keessumaa balali'iinsa deebii gurguddoo Saa'uudii Arabiyaa irraa, waan baay'inaan ta'u kana.

## Buufata xiyyaaraa Boolee irratti

- IOM, dhaabbanni godaansaa Mootummoota Gamtooman, deebi'oota Saa'uudii Arabiyaa irraa dhufan Buufata Xiyyaaraa Idil-addunyaa Boolee irratti galmeessa. Namoonni baay'ee miidhamoo ta'an gargaarsa imalaa argatu [2].
- Bara 2022 yeroo namoonni baay'een Saa'uudii Arabiyaa irraa deebi'an, deebi'oonni nyaata, iddoo boqonnaa yeroof, gargaarsa yaalaa fi gorsa akka argatan IOM himeera [1].
- Amajjii 2026, Ministeerri Dhimma Dubartootaa fi Hawaasummaa, deeggarsi buufata xiyyaaraa irraa jalqabee giddugala ce'umsaa keessatti akka itti fufu, akkasumas namoota maatii isaanii waliin walitti fiduuf hojiin akka jiru himeera [3].

Gargaarsi ji'a ji'aan jijjiiramuu danda'a, akkasumas qarshii fi iddoo irratti hundaa'a. Yeroo tokko tokko giddugalli simannaa baay'ee guuta [2]. Har'a gargaarsa maaltu akka jiru hojjettoota buufata xiyyaaraa gaafadhu.

## Giddugala ce'umsaa fi iddoo baqannaa

Deebi'oonni tokko tokko giddugala ce'umsaa Finfinnee keessatti yeroo gabaabaaf turu. IOM osoo namoonni gara naannoo isaanii hin deemin dura giddugala ce'umsaa isaa keessatti gorsa kenna [4].

Iddoo nagaan itti deemtu yoo hin qabaatte, waa'ee iddoo baqannaa gaafadhu. Dhaabbileen akka Gud Samaariitaan fi Agar Itoophiyaa dubartoota deebi'aniif iddoo baqannaa yaalaa fi gorsa qaban hojjechiisaniiru [5].

## Gara naannoo keetii deemuu

Gara naannoo manaa keetii deemuuf gargaarsa geejjibaa argachuu dandeessu akka ta'e gaafadhu. IOM deebi'oota baay'ee miidhamoo ta'aniif gargaarsa imalaa kenna [2]. Namoonni naannoo walitti bu'iinsi jiru irraa dhufan tokko tokko battalumatti mana deemuu waan hin dandeenyeef iddoo baqannaa keessa yeroo dheeraaf turaniiru [2]. Kun yoo si mudate, odeeffannoo fi deeggarsa gaafachuu itti fufi.

## Fayyaa fi miira kee

Yoo dhukkubsatte, miidhamte ykn ulfa yoo taate, doktara ykn narsii arguuf gaafachuu dandeessa. Gorsaa waliin dubbachuuf illee gaafachuu dandeessa. Erga mana geessee booda, ogeeyyiin fayyaa naannoo gorsa dabalataa kennuu danda'u [4].

Fuula "Erga deebitee booda qorannoo fayyaa" fi "Erga deebitee booda fayyaa sammuu" ilaali.

## Maal gochuu dandeessa

1. Sanadoota kee fi bilbila kee of harkatti qabadhu.
2. Yoo dhukkubsatte, miidhamte, ulfa taate ykn umuriin kee 18 gadi ta'e hojjettootatti himi.
3. Waa'ee nyaataa, iddoo bulmaataa, geejjiba gara manaa fi gorsaa gaafadhu.
4. Miseensa maatii ykn hiriyaa amantu bilbilaaf.
5. Lakkoofsota gargaarsaa Itoophiyaa DadaLink keessa jiran kuusi.
6. Yeroo kamiyyuu nageenyi yoo sitti hin dhaga'amne, SOS fayyadami.

Imala ulfaataa keessa dabarteetta. Amma kunuunsaa fi deeggarsi siif mala.

title.en: Claiming unpaid wages after you are home
title.am: ቤት ከተመለስሽ በኋላ ያልተከፈለ ደሞዝ መጠየቅ
title.om: Erga mana deebitee booda mindaa hin kaffalamne gaafachuu

summary.en: Getting your unpaid pay from home is hard, but you can still try. Keep your evidence and ask the embassy, your agency and legal helpers.
summary.am: ካልተከፈለሽ ደሞዝ ከቤት ሆነሽ ማግኘት ከባድ ነው፣ ግን አሁንም መሞከር ትችያለሽ። ማስረጃሽን ያዢ፤ ኤምባሲውን፣ ኤጀንሲሽንና የሕግ ረዳቶችን ጠይቂ።
summary.om: Mindaa siif hin kaffalamne mana taa'anii argachuun ulfaataa dha, garuu ammas yaaluu dandeessa. Ragaa kee qabadhu; embaasii, ejensii kee fi gargaartota seeraa gaafadhu.

body.en:
Many domestic workers go home without all of their pay. This is called wage theft. It happens in every region of the world [1]. It is not your fault.

## Can I still get my money?

It is hard, but you can still try. Experts say it is often "difficult or impossible" for workers to claim once they are home [1]. Migrant Forum in Asia also says justice is hard to get once workers are back home [3]. This is why, if you are still abroad, it is best to complain before you leave. See "Getting ready to go home".

Not being paid can also hurt your mind. A study of Ethiopian returnees found that people who were paid only sometimes, or never, were more likely to have signs of mental distress [4]. If you feel this way, see "Mental health after return".

## Ways to try from home

- **The embassy.** Workers' groups advise reporting wage problems to your country's embassy or consulate in the country where you worked [3].
- **Power of attorney.** This is a legal paper that lets a trusted person or a lawyer act for you. Migrant groups, together with Human Rights Watch and Migrant-Rights.org, asked governments to make power of attorney easier for workers who have already gone home [2]. Ask a lawyer or the embassy if this is possible for you.
- **Online complaints.** Some countries have online labour complaint systems. Check the rights page for the country where you worked.
- **Your recruitment agency.** Ethiopia has an overseas employment law for private employment agencies, and the Ministry of Labour and Skills works with these agencies [5]. Tell the agency that sent you about the unpaid pay, in writing, and keep a copy. You can also ask the ministry or your local labour office for advice.
- **Legal help.** Look for legal help in the DadaLink help directory.

## Keep your evidence

Keep your contract, pay slips, money transfer receipts, messages and your employer's details. Migrant groups ask that workers be allowed to take copies of their work records [2]. Without papers, a claim is harder [3].

## What you can do

1. Write down which months you were not paid, and how much.
2. Put all your papers and screenshots together in one safe place.
3. Contact the Ethiopian embassy in the country where you worked. Find it in the Help numbers in DadaLink.
4. Ask about power of attorney.
5. Write to your agency and keep a copy.
6. Look for legal help in the help directory.

You worked for this money. Asking for it is your right.
body.am:
ብዙ የቤት ሠራተኞች ሙሉ ደሞዛቸውን ሳያገኙ ወደ ቤት ይመለሳሉ። ይህ የደሞዝ ስርቆት ይባላል። በዓለም በሁሉም አካባቢ ይከሰታል [1]። ያንቺ ጥፋት አይደለም።

## አሁንም ገንዘቤን ማግኘት እችላለሁ?

ከባድ ነው፣ ግን አሁንም መሞከር ትችያለሽ። ባለሙያዎች እንደሚሉት፣ ሠራተኞች ቤት ከደረሱ በኋላ መጠየቅ ብዙ ጊዜ "ከባድ ወይም የማይቻል" ነው [1]። Migrant Forum in Asia የተባለው ድርጅትም ሠራተኞች ቤት ከተመለሱ በኋላ ፍትሕ ማግኘት ከባድ እንደሆነ ይናገራል [3]። ስለዚህ አሁንም ውጭ አገር ካለሽ፣ ከመሄድሽ በፊት አቤቱታ ማቅረብ ይሻላል። "ወደ ቤት ለመመለስ መዘጋጀት" የሚለውን ገጽ ተመልከቺ።

ደሞዝ አለመከፈል አእምሮሽንም ሊጎዳ ይችላል። በኢትዮጵያውያን ተመላሾች ላይ የተደረገ ጥናት፣ አንዳንድ ጊዜ ብቻ የተከፈላቸው ወይም ፈጽሞ ያልተከፈላቸው ሰዎች የአእምሮ ጭንቀት ምልክቶች የመታየት ዕድላቸው ከፍተኛ እንደሆነ አግኝቷል [4]። እንዲህ ከተሰማሽ "ከተመለስሽ በኋላ የአእምሮ ጤና" የሚለውን ገጽ ተመልከቺ።

## ከቤት ሆነሽ የምትሞክሪባቸው መንገዶች

- **ኤምባሲው።** የሠራተኞች ድርጅቶች፣ የደሞዝ ችግሮችን በሠራሽበት አገር ላለው የአገርሽ ኤምባሲ ወይም ቆንስላ እንድታሳውቂ ይመክራሉ [3]።
- **የውክልና ሥልጣን።** ይህ የምታምኚው ሰው ወይም ጠበቃ በአንቺ ስም እንዲሠራ የሚፈቅድ ሕጋዊ ወረቀት ነው። የፍልሰተኛ ድርጅቶች ከHuman Rights Watch እና ከMigrant-Rights.org ጋር በመሆን፣ ቀድመው ወደ ቤት ለተመለሱ ሠራተኞች ውክልና መስጠትን እንዲያቀሉ መንግሥታትን ጠይቀዋል [2]። ይህ ለአንቺ የሚቻል መሆኑን ጠበቃን ወይም ኤምባሲውን ጠይቂ።
- **የኦንላይን አቤቱታ።** አንዳንድ አገሮች የኦንላይን የሥራ አቤቱታ ሥርዓት አላቸው። የሠራሽበትን አገር የመብቶች ገጽ ተመልከቺ።
- **የቀጠረሽ ኤጀንሲ።** ኢትዮጵያ ለግል ሥራና ሠራተኛ አገናኝ ኤጀንሲዎች የውጭ አገር ሥራ ስምሪት ሕግ አላት፤ የሥራና ክህሎት ሚኒስቴርም ከእነዚህ ኤጀንሲዎች ጋር ይሠራል [5]። ስለ ያልተከፈለው ደሞዝ የላከሽን ኤጀንሲ በጽሑፍ አሳውቂ፤ ቅጂውንም ያዢ። ሚኒስቴሩን ወይም የአካባቢሽን የሥራ ጽሕፈት ቤት ምክርም መጠየቅ ትችያለሽ።
- **የሕግ እርዳታ።** በDadaLink የእርዳታ ማውጫ ውስጥ የሕግ እርዳታ ፈልጊ።

## ማስረጃሽን ያዢ

ውልሽን፣ የደሞዝ ወረቀቶችሽን፣ የገንዘብ መላኪያ ደረሰኞችሽን፣ መልእክቶችሽንና የአሠሪሽን መረጃ ያዢ። የፍልሰተኛ ድርጅቶች ሠራተኞች የሥራ መዝገቦቻቸውን ቅጂ እንዲወስዱ እንዲፈቀድ ይጠይቃሉ [2]። ያለ ወረቀት መጠየቅ የበለጠ ከባድ ነው [3]።

## ምን ማድረግ ትችያለሽ

1. የትኞቹ ወራት እንዳልተከፈሉሽና ምን ያህል እንደሆነ ጻፊ።
2. ሁሉንም ወረቀቶችሽንና ስክሪንሾቶችሽን በአንድ ደህና ቦታ አስቀምጪ።
3. በሠራሽበት አገር ያለውን የኢትዮጵያ ኤምባሲ አግኚ። በDadaLink የእርዳታ ቁጥሮች ውስጥ ታገኚዋለሽ።
4. ስለ ውክልና ሥልጣን ጠይቂ።
5. ለኤጀንሲሽ ጻፊ፤ ቅጂውን ያዢ።
6. በእርዳታ ማውጫው ውስጥ የሕግ እርዳታ ፈልጊ።

ለዚህ ገንዘብ ሠርተሻል። መጠየቅ መብትሽ ነው።
body.om:
Hojjettoonni manaa baay'een osoo mindaa isaanii guutuu hin argatin gara manaatti deebi'u. Kun hanna mindaa jedhama. Naannoo addunyaa hunda keessatti ni mudata [1]. Dogoggora kee miti.

## Ammas qarshii koo argachuu nan danda'aa?

Ulfaataa dha, garuu ammas yaaluu dandeessa. Akka ogeeyyiin jedhanitti, erga hojjettoonni mana ga'anii booda gaafachuun yeroo baay'ee "ulfaataa ykn kan hin danda'amne" dha [1]. Dhaabbanni Migrant Forum in Asia jedhamus, erga hojjettoonni mana deebi'anii booda haqa argachuun ulfaataa ta'uu ibseera [3]. Kanaafuu, ammayyuu biyya alaa yoo jirte, osoo hin deemin dura komii dhiyeessuu wayya. Fuula "Gara manaatti deebi'uuf qophaa'uu" ilaali.

Mindaan kaffalamuu dhabuun sammuu kee illee miidhuu danda'a. Qorannoon deebi'oota Itoophiyaa irratti godhame, namoonni yeroo tokko tokko qofa ykn gonkumaa hin kaffalamne mallattoo dhiphina sammuu qabaachuuf carraa olaanaa akka qaban argateera [4]. Akkas yoo sitti dhaga'ame, fuula "Erga deebitee booda fayyaa sammuu" ilaali.

## Karaalee mana irraa yaaltu

- **Embaasii.** Dhaabbileen hojjettootaa rakkoo mindaa embaasii ykn qonsilaa biyya keetii biyya itti hojjette keessa jiruuf akka beeksistu gorsu [3].
- **Aangoo bakka bu'iinsaa.** Kun waraqaa seeraa nama amantu ykn abukaatoon siif bakka bu'ee akka hojjetu hayyamu dha. Dhaabbileen godaantotaa, Human Rights Watch fi Migrant-Rights.org waliin ta'uun, hojjettoota duraan mana deebi'aniif bakka bu'iinsa kennuu akka salphisan mootummoota gaafataniiru [2]. Kun siif kan danda'amu ta'uu isaa abukaatoo ykn embaasii gaafadhu.
- **Komii toora interneetaa.** Biyyoonni tokko tokko sirna komii hojii toora interneetaa qabu. Fuula mirgaa biyya itti hojjettee ilaali.
- **Ejensii si qacare.** Itoophiyaan ejensiiwwan qacarrii dhuunfaatiif seera hojii biyya alaa qabdi; Ministeerri Hojii fi Ogummaas ejensiiwwan kana waliin hojjeta [5]. Waa'ee mindaa hin kaffalamne ejensii si erge barreeffamaan beeksisi; garagalchas qabadhu. Ministeera ykn waajjira hojii naannoo keetii gorsa gaafachuus dandeessa.
- **Gargaarsa seeraa.** Kallattii gargaarsaa DadaLink keessatti gargaarsa seeraa barbaadi.

## Ragaa kee qabadhu

Waliigaltee, waraqaa mindaa, nagahee qarshii ergaa, ergaawwanii fi odeeffannoo qacaraa keetii qabadhu. Dhaabbileen godaantotaa hojjettoonni garagalcha galmee hojii isaanii akka fudhatan akka hayyamamu gaafatu [2]. Waraqaa malee gaafachuun caalaatti ulfaataa dha [3].

## Maal gochuu dandeessa

1. Ji'oota kamtu akka siif hin kaffalamne fi hammam akka ta'e barreessi.
2. Waraqaa fi suuraa (screenshot) kee hunda bakka nagaa tokko keessa kaa'i.
3. Embaasii Itoophiyaa biyya itti hojjette keessa jiru qunnami. Lakkoofsota gargaarsaa DadaLink keessatti argatta.
4. Waa'ee aangoo bakka bu'iinsaa gaafadhu.
5. Ejensii keetiif barreessi; garagalcha qabadhu.
6. Kallattii gargaarsaa keessatti gargaarsa seeraa barbaadi.

Qarshii kanaaf hojjetteetta. Gaafachuun mirga kee ti.

title.en: If you are detained or deported
title.om: Yoo hidhamte ykn biyyaa ari'amte

summary.en: Being held in a deportation centre is frightening, but you still have rights. You can ask for your embassy, for medical care and for help to travel home.
summary.am: በማባረሪያ ማዕከል መያዝ ያስፈራል፣ ግን አሁንም መብቶች አሉሽ። ኤምባሲሽን፣ ሕክምናንና ወደ ቤት ለመጓዝ እርዳታን መጠየቅ ትችያለሽ።
summary.om: Giddugala ari'atanii keessatti qabamuun nama sodaachisa, garuu ammas mirga qabda. Embaasii kee, yaala fi gara manaatti imaluuf gargaarsa gaafachuu dandeessa.

body.en:
Many migrant workers are held in immigration detention or deportation centres before being sent home. This can happen if your papers are not valid, for example after you leave an employer. Sometimes even people with valid papers are held [1]. Being detained does not make you a bad person. It is not your fault.

## What we know

- Very many Ethiopians have been sent home from Saudi Arabia. IOM says about 519,000 migrants were returned to Ethiopia between 2017 and 2022 [5].
- Human Rights Watch reported serious problems in Saudi detention: crowded rooms, too little food, dirty toilets, poor medical care and beatings [1][2].
- In Lebanon, the General Security office announced a return process for Ethiopian workers in 2020. Amnesty asked whether it would include workers in detention [4].

## Your rights

Under an international agreement called the Vienna Convention on Consular Relations [3]:

- If you ask, the authorities must tell your embassy or consulate, without delay, that you are detained.
- They must send your messages to the consulate without delay.
- They must tell you about this right.
- Consular staff have the right to visit you, talk with you and help you find a lawyer.
- Consulates can give passports and travel documents to their citizens. You can still go home even if your passport was taken [3].

## What to ask for

- Say clearly: "I want to contact the Ethiopian embassy."
- Ask to see a doctor if you are sick, hurt, pregnant or need medicine.
- Ask to call your family.
- Tell the embassy if you have unpaid wages or belongings left with your employer.
- Try to remember or write down the embassy number from the Help numbers in DadaLink before anything happens.

## Your health in detention

Crowded places spread illness. In Saudi detention, Human Rights Watch reported that people with signs of tuberculosis were not kept apart from others [2]. Tell the guards or a doctor if you have a cough, fever, pain or bleeding, or if you are pregnant. Keep asking if no one helps.

## After you come home

Detention can leave deep feelings of fear and sadness. A study found that being detained abroad was linked with more anxiety and trauma later [6]. This is a normal reaction. See "Arriving home" and "Mental health after return".

## What you can do

1. Save the embassy number in DadaLink now.
2. If detained, ask for your embassy at once.
3. Ask for medical care when you need it.
4. Ask for a travel document if you have no passport.
5. When you land, ask the airport staff for help.
6. If you are in danger, use SOS.
body.am:
ብዙ ፍልሰተኛ ሠራተኞች ወደ ቤት ከመላካቸው በፊት በኢሚግሬሽን እስር ቤት ወይም በማባረሪያ ማዕከል ይያዛሉ። ይህ ሰነድሽ ሕጋዊ ካልሆነ ሊከሰት ይችላል፤ ለምሳሌ አሠሪሽን ከለቀቅሽ በኋላ። አንዳንድ ጊዜ ሕጋዊ ሰነድ ያላቸው ሰዎችም ይያዛሉ [1]። መታሰርሽ መጥፎ ሰው ነሽ ማለት አይደለም። ያንቺ ጥፋት አይደለም።

## የምናውቀው

- በጣም ብዙ ኢትዮጵያውያን ከሳዑዲ ዓረቢያ ወደ ቤት ተልከዋል። IOM እንደሚለው ከ2017 እስከ 2022 ድረስ ወደ 519,000 የሚጠጉ ፍልሰተኞች ወደ ኢትዮጵያ ተመልሰዋል [5]።
- Human Rights Watch በሳዑዲ እስር ቤቶች ውስጥ ከባድ ችግሮችን ዘግቧል፦ የተጨናነቁ ክፍሎች፣ በቂ ያልሆነ ምግብ፣ የቆሸሹ መጸዳጃ ቤቶች፣ ደካማ ሕክምናና ድብደባ [1][2]።
- በሊባኖስ የጄኔራል ሴኩሪቲ መሥሪያ ቤት በ2020 ለኢትዮጵያውያን ሠራተኞች የመመለሻ ሂደት አስታውቋል። Amnesty ሂደቱ የታሰሩ ሠራተኞችን ያካትት እንደሆነ ጠይቋል [4]።

## መብቶችሽ

የቆንስላ ግንኙነቶች የቪየና ስምምነት በሚባል ዓለም አቀፍ ስምምነት መሠረት [3]፦

- ከጠየቅሽ፣ ባለሥልጣናቱ መታሰርሽን ሳይዘገዩ ለኤምባሲሽ ወይም ለቆንስላሽ ማሳወቅ አለባቸው።
- መልእክቶችሽን ሳይዘገዩ ለቆንስላው ማድረስ አለባቸው።
- ስለዚህ መብትሽ ሊነግሩሽ ይገባል።
- የቆንስላ ሠራተኞች ሊጎበኙሽ፣ ሊያነጋግሩሽና ጠበቃ እንድታገኚ ሊረዱሽ መብት አላቸው።
- ቆንስላዎች ለዜጎቻቸው ፓስፖርትና የጉዞ ሰነድ መስጠት ይችላሉ። ፓስፖርትሽ ቢወሰድብሽም ወደ ቤት መሄድ ትችያለሽ [3]።

## ምን መጠየቅ እንዳለብሽ

- በግልጽ እንዲህ በዪ፦ "የኢትዮጵያ ኤምባሲን ማግኘት እፈልጋለሁ።"
- ከታመምሽ፣ ከተጎዳሽ፣ ካረገዝሽ ወይም መድኃኒት ካስፈለገሽ ሐኪም ለማየት ጠይቂ።
- ቤተሰብሽን ለመደወል ጠይቂ።
- ያልተከፈለ ደሞዝ ወይም ከአሠሪሽ ጋር የቀሩ ንብረቶች ካሉሽ ለኤምባሲው ንገሪ።
- ምንም ነገር ከመከሰቱ በፊት የኤምባሲውን ቁጥር ከDadaLink የእርዳታ ቁጥሮች ለማስታወስ ወይም ለመጻፍ ሞክሪ።

## በእስር ላይ ሳለሽ ጤናሽ

የተጨናነቁ ቦታዎች በሽታን ያስፋፋሉ። Human Rights Watch በሳዑዲ እስር ቤቶች የሳንባ ነቀርሳ ምልክት ያለባቸው ሰዎች ከሌሎች እንዳልተለዩ ዘግቧል [2]። ሳል፣ ትኩሳት፣ ሕመም ወይም ደም መፍሰስ ካለብሽ፣ ወይም ካረገዝሽ ለጠባቂዎቹ ወይም ለሐኪም ንገሪ። ማንም ካልረዳሽ መጠየቅሽን ቀጥዪ።

## ቤት ከደረስሽ በኋላ

መታሰር ጥልቅ የፍርሃትና የሐዘን ስሜት ሊተው ይችላል። አንድ ጥናት ውጭ አገር መታሰር ከጊዜ በኋላ ከበለጠ ጭንቀትና የአሰቃቂ ገጠመኝ ጉዳት ጋር የተያያዘ መሆኑን አግኝቷል [6]። ይህ የተለመደ ምላሽ ነው። "ቦሌ አየር ማረፊያ ቤት ስትደርሺ" እና "ከተመለስሽ በኋላ የአእምሮ ጤና" የሚሉትን ገጾች ተመልከቺ።

## ምን ማድረግ ትችያለሽ

1. የኤምባሲውን ቁጥር አሁኑኑ በDadaLink ውስጥ አስቀምጪ።
2. ከታሰርሽ ወዲያውኑ ኤምባሲሽን ጠይቂ።
3. ሲያስፈልግሽ ሕክምና ጠይቂ።
4. ፓስፖርት ከሌለሽ የጉዞ ሰነድ ጠይቂ።
5. ስታርፊ የአየር ማረፊያ ሠራተኞችን እርዳታ ጠይቂ።
6. አደጋ ላይ ከሆንሽ SOSን ተጠቀሚ።
body.om:
Hojjettoonni godaantotaa baay'een osoo gara manaatti hin ergamin dura mana hidhaa imigreeshinii ykn giddugala ari'atanii keessatti qabamu. Kun sanadni kee seera qabeessa yoo hin taane ta'uu danda'a; fakkeenyaaf, erga qacaraa kee dhiiftee booda. Yeroo tokko tokko namoonni sanada seera qabeessa qabanis ni qabamu [1]. Hidhamuun kee nama hamaa taatee jirta jechuu miti. Dogoggora kee miti.

## Waan beeknu

- Itoophiyaanonni baay'een Saa'uudii Arabiyaa irraa gara manaatti ergamaniiru. Akka IOM jedhutti, bara 2017 hanga 2022tti godaantonni gara 519,000 ta'an gara Itoophiyaatti deebi'aniiru [5].
- Human Rights Watch mana hidhaa Saa'uudii keessatti rakkoowwan cimoo gabaaseera: kutaawwan namaan guutaman, nyaata gahaa hin taane, mana fincaanii xuraa'aa, yaala laafaa fi reebicha [1][2].
- Libaanos keessatti, waajjirri General Security bara 2020 hojjettoota Itoophiyaatiif adeemsa deebii labseera. Amnesty adeemsi kun hojjettoota hidhaman ni hammataa jedhee gaafateera [4].

## Mirgoota kee

Waliigaltee idil-addunyaa Waliigaltee Vienna Hariiroo Qonsilaa jedhamuun [3]:

- Yoo gaafatte, aangawoonni akka hidhamte embaasii ykn qonsilaa keetiif osoo hin turin beeksisuu qabu.
- Ergaawwan kee osoo hin turin qonsilaaf dabarsuu qabu.
- Waa'ee mirga kanaa sitti himuu qabu.
- Hojjettoonni qonsilaa si daawwachuu, si haasofsiisuu fi abukaatoo akka argattu si gargaaruuf mirga qabu.
- Qonsilaan lammiilee isaatiif paaspoortii fi sanada imalaa kennuu danda'a. Paaspoortiin kee yoo sirraa fudhatame illee gara manaatti deemuu dandeessa [3].

## Maal gaafachuu qabda

- Ifatti akkana jedhi: "Embaasii Itoophiyaa qunnamuun barbaada."
- Yoo dhukkubsatte, miidhamte, ulfa taate ykn qorichi si barbaachise doktara arguuf gaafadhu.
- Maatii kee bilbiluuf gaafadhu.
- Mindaa hin kaffalamne ykn qabeenya qacaraa kee bira hafe yoo qabaatte embaasiitti himi.
- Osoo wanti tokkollee hin ta'in dura, lakkoofsa embaasii lakkoofsota gargaarsaa DadaLink irraa yaadachuu ykn barreessuuf yaali.

## Fayyaa kee yeroo hidhaa

Iddoowwan namaan guutaman dhukkuba babal'isu. Human Rights Watch mana hidhaa Saa'uudii keessatti namoonni mallattoo dhukkuba sombaa (TB) qaban warra biroo irraa akka hin addaanfamne gabaaseera [2]. Qufaa, ho'a qaamaa, dhukkubbii ykn dhiigni yoo si dhangala'e, ykn ulfa yoo taate eegdotatti ykn doktaratti himi. Namni si gargaaru yoo dhabame gaafachuu itti fufi.

## Erga mana geessee booda

Hidhamuun miira sodaa fi gaddaa gadi fagoo dhiisuu danda'a. Qorannoon tokko biyya alaatti hidhamuun booda irratti yaaddoo fi miidhaa sammuu dabalataa waliin walqabata jedhee argateera [6]. Kun deebii baramoo dha. Fuula "Buufata xiyyaaraa Boolee irratti mana ga'uu" fi "Erga deebitee booda fayyaa sammuu" ilaali.

## Maal gochuu dandeessa

1. Lakkoofsa embaasii amma DadaLink keessatti kuusi.
2. Yoo hidhamte, battalumatti embaasii kee gaafadhu.
3. Yeroo si barbaachisu yaala gaafadhu.
4. Paaspoortii yoo hin qabaatte sanada imalaa gaafadhu.
5. Yeroo qubattu hojjettoota buufata xiyyaaraa gargaarsa gaafadhu.
6. Balaa keessa yoo jirte SOS fayyadami.

title.en: Family and community after you return
title.om: Erga deebitee booda maatii fi hawaasa

summary.en: Coming home can bring money pressure, gossip and shame. What happened is not your fault, and you can choose what to share.
summary.am: ወደ ቤት መመለስ የገንዘብ ጫና፣ ሐሜትና ኀፍረት ሊያመጣ ይችላል። የደረሰብሽ ያንቺ ጥፋት አይደለም፤ ምን እንደምታካፍዪም መምረጥ ትችያለሽ።
summary.om: Gara manaatti deebi'uun dhiibbaa qarshii, hamii fi qaanii fiduu danda'a. Wanti si mudate dogoggora kee miti; maal akka qooddus filachuu dandeessa.

body.en:
Going home can be happy and hard at the same time. Your family may have changed while you were away. You may have changed too.

## Common worries

- **Money.** Your family may expect money or gifts. Research on Ethiopian women who came back from Gulf countries found that the money from working abroad often helps the family more than the woman herself [1].
- **Gossip and stigma.** Some returnees face unkind talk. Many find it hard to rebuild good relationships with family and to feel they belong again [1].
- **Marriage.** Some returnees say people judge them, and that it is hard to marry. Some keep their story secret to protect themselves [2].
- **Rejection and guilt.** One survivor told UN Women, "your own family can turn their back on you." Another woman felt heavy guilt because her mother died while she was away [3].

If you feel any of this, you are not alone.

## It is not your fault

You went abroad to build a better life for yourself and your family. That took courage. If you were hurt, cheated or sent home with nothing, the shame belongs to the people who hurt you, not to you.

## Talking with your family

- Choose a calm time and start with a person you trust.
- You decide what to share. You do not have to tell everything.
- Be clear about money. Say what you have, and what you need to keep for yourself.
- Ask for simple help: time to rest, food, a safe and quiet place.

WHO advises sharing your worries and feelings with people you trust [4].

## Finding support

Shelters and support groups in Ethiopia have given returnee women counselling, skills training and help to reunite with their families [3]. Look in the help directory in DadaLink for returnee support near you. See also "Mental health after return".

## If you are not safe at home

If someone at home hurts you, threatens you or takes your money by force, you deserve to be safe. Use SOS or the Help numbers in DadaLink.

## What you can do

1. Give yourself time. Settling in can take weeks or months.
2. Talk first with the person you trust most.
3. Keep part of your money for your own needs.
4. Look for counselling or support in the help directory.
5. Use SOS if you are in danger.
body.am:
ወደ ቤት መመለስ ደስታም ችግርም በአንድ ጊዜ ሊሆን ይችላል። አንቺ ውጭ በነበርሽበት ጊዜ ቤተሰብሽ ተለውጦ ሊሆን ይችላል። አንቺም ተለውጠሽ ሊሆን ይችላል።

## የተለመዱ ስጋቶች

- **ገንዘብ።** ቤተሰብሽ ገንዘብ ወይም ስጦታ ሊጠብቅ ይችላል። ከባሕረ ሰላጤው አገሮች በተመለሱ ኢትዮጵያውያን ሴቶች ላይ የተደረገ ጥናት፣ ውጭ አገር ተሠርቶ የሚገኘው ገንዘብ ብዙ ጊዜ ሴቲቱን ራሷን ሳይሆን ቤተሰቡን እንደሚጠቅም አግኝቷል [1]።
- **ሐሜትና መገለል።** አንዳንድ ተመላሾች ክፉ ንግግር ይገጥማቸዋል። ብዙዎች ከቤተሰብ ጋር ጥሩ ግንኙነት መልሰው መገንባትና የቦታው አካል እንደሆኑ መሰማት ይከብዳቸዋል [1]።
- **ትዳር።** አንዳንድ ተመላሾች ሰዎች እንደሚፈርዱባቸውና ማግባት እንደሚከብድ ይናገራሉ። አንዳንዶቹ ራሳቸውን ለመጠበቅ ታሪካቸውን በምስጢር ይይዛሉ [2]።
- **መገፋትና የጥፋተኝነት ስሜት።** አንዲት ከጥቃት የተረፈች ሴት ለUN Women "የገዛ ቤተሰብሽ ፊቱን ሊያዞርብሽ ይችላል" ብላለች። ሌላዋ ሴት ደግሞ ውጭ እያለች እናቷ በመሞታቸው ከባድ የጥፋተኝነት ስሜት ተሰምቷታል [3]።

ከእነዚህ አንዱ ከተሰማሽ ብቻሽን አይደለሽም።

## ያንቺ ጥፋት አይደለም

ለራስሽና ለቤተሰብሽ የተሻለ ሕይወት ለመገንባት ወደ ውጭ ሄደሻል። ይህ ድፍረት ይጠይቃል። ከተጎዳሽ፣ ከተታለልሽ ወይም ባዶ እጅሽን ወደ ቤት ከተላክሽ፣ ኀፍረቱ የጎዱሽ ሰዎች ነው እንጂ ያንቺ አይደለም።

## ከቤተሰብሽ ጋር መነጋገር

- የተረጋጋ ጊዜ ምረጪ፤ በምታምኚው ሰው ጀምሪ።
- ምን እንደምታካፍዪ የምትወስኚው አንቺ ነሽ። ሁሉንም መናገር የለብሽም።
- ስለ ገንዘብ ግልጽ ሁኚ። ምን እንዳለሽና ለራስሽ ምን ማስቀመጥ እንዳለብሽ ተናገሪ።
- ቀላል እርዳታ ጠይቂ፦ የማረፊያ ጊዜ፣ ምግብ፣ ደህና እና ጸጥ ያለ ቦታ።

WHO ጭንቀትሽንና ስሜትሽን ለምታምኛቸው ሰዎች እንድታካፍዪ ይመክራል [4]።

## ድጋፍ ማግኘት

በኢትዮጵያ ያሉ መጠለያዎችና የድጋፍ ቡድኖች ለተመላሽ ሴቶች የምክር አገልግሎት፣ የክህሎት ሥልጠናና ከቤተሰብ ጋር የመገናኘት እርዳታ ሰጥተዋል [3]። በአቅራቢያሽ ያለ የተመላሾች ድጋፍ በDadaLink የእርዳታ ማውጫ ውስጥ ፈልጊ። "ከተመለስሽ በኋላ የአእምሮ ጤና" የሚለውንም ገጽ ተመልከቺ።

## ቤት ውስጥ ደህንነት ካልተሰማሽ

ቤት ውስጥ ያለ ሰው ቢጎዳሽ፣ ቢያስፈራራሽ ወይም ገንዘብሽን በኃይል ቢወስድብሽ፣ ደህንነትሽ ሊጠበቅ ይገባል። SOSን ወይም በDadaLink ያሉትን የእርዳታ ቁጥሮች ተጠቀሚ።

## ምን ማድረግ ትችያለሽ

1. ለራስሽ ጊዜ ስጪ። መረጋጋት ሳምንታት ወይም ወራት ሊወስድ ይችላል።
2. መጀመሪያ በጣም ከምታምኚው ሰው ጋር ተነጋገሪ።
3. ከገንዘብሽ የተወሰነውን ለራስሽ ፍላጎት አስቀምጪ።
4. በእርዳታ ማውጫው ውስጥ የምክር አገልግሎት ወይም ድጋፍ ፈልጊ።
5. አደጋ ላይ ከሆንሽ SOSን ተጠቀሚ።
body.om:
Gara manaatti deebi'uun yeroo tokkotti gammachuu fi rakkoo ta'uu danda'a. Yeroo ati alaa turtetti maatiin kee jijjiiramee ta'uu danda'a. Atis jijjiiramtee ta'uu dandeessa.

## Yaaddoowwan baramoo

- **Qarshii.** Maatiin kee qarshii ykn kennaa eeguu danda'u. Qorannoon dubartoota Itoophiyaa biyyoota Galaana Arabaa irraa deebi'an irratti godhame, qarshiin biyya alaatti hojjetamee argamu yeroo baay'ee dubartittii ofii caalaa maatii akka fayyadu argateera [1].
- **Hamii fi tuffii.** Deebi'oonni tokko tokko dubbii hamaa isaan mudata. Baay'een isaanii hariiroo gaarii maatii waliin deebisanii ijaaruu fi akka iddoo sanaa ta'an itti dhaga'amuun itti ulfaata [1].
- **Gaa'ela.** Deebi'oonni tokko tokko namoonni akka isaanitti murteessanii fi heerumuun akka ulfaatu dubbatu. Tokko tokko of eeguuf seenaa isaanii iccitiin qabatu [2].
- **Didamuu fi miira yakkamummaa.** Dubartiin tokko kan miidhaa jalaa baate UN Women'tti "maatiin kee ofii isaa duuba sitti garagaluu danda'a" jetteetti. Dubartiin biraa ammoo yeroo isheen alaa turtetti haati ishee waan du'aniif miira yakkamummaa cimaa qabaatte [3].

Kanneen keessaa tokko yoo sitti dhaga'ame, kophaa kee miti.

## Dogoggora kee miti

Ofii keetii fi maatii keetiif jireenya fooyya'aa ijaaruuf gara alaa deemteetta. Kun ija jabina gaafata. Yoo miidhamte, gowwoomfamte ykn harka duwwaa gara manaatti ergamte, qaaniin kan namoota si miidhanii ti malee kan kee miti.

## Maatii kee waliin dubbachuu

- Yeroo tasgabbaa'aa filadhu; nama amantuun jalqabi.
- Maal akka qooddu kan murteessitu ati. Hunda himuu hin qabdu.
- Waa'ee qarshii ifa ta'i. Maal akka qabduu fi ofii keetiif maal kaa'uu akka qabdu himi.
- Gargaarsa salphaa gaafadhu: yeroo boqonnaa, nyaata, iddoo nagaa fi callisaa.

WHO yaaddoo fi miira kee namoota amantuuf akka qooddu gorsa [4].

## Deeggarsa argachuu

Iddoowwan baqannaa fi gareewwan deeggarsaa Itoophiyaa keessa jiran dubartoota deebi'aniif gorsa, leenjii ogummaa fi maatii waliin walitti dhufuuf gargaarsa kennaniiru [3]. Deeggarsa deebi'oota naannoo keetti jiru kallattii gargaarsaa DadaLink keessatti barbaadi. Fuula "Erga deebitee booda fayyaa sammuu" illee ilaali.

## Mana keessatti nageenyi yoo sitti hin dhaga'amne

Namni mana keessa jiru yoo si miidhe, si doorsise ykn qarshii kee humnaan yoo sirraa fudhate, nageenyi kee eegamuu qaba. SOS ykn lakkoofsota gargaarsaa DadaLink fayyadami.

## Maal gochuu dandeessa

1. Ofii keetiif yeroo kenni. Tasgabbaa'uun torbanoota ykn ji'oota fudhachuu danda'a.
2. Jalqaba nama baay'ee amantu waliin dubbadhu.
3. Qarshii kee keessaa kutaa tokko fedhii mataa keetiif kaa'i.
4. Kallattii gargaarsaa keessatti gorsa ykn deeggarsa barbaadi.
5. Balaa keessa yoo jirte SOS fayyadami.

title.en: A health check after you come home
title.om: Erga mana geessee booda qorannoo fayyaa

summary.en: A check-up after you return helps you find and treat problems early, including infections that have no signs. You deserve care with respect.
summary.am: ከተመለስሽ በኋላ የሚደረግ ምርመራ ችግሮችን፣ ምልክት የሌላቸውን ኢንፌክሽኖችም ጭምር፣ ቀድመሽ እንድታገኚና እንድትታከሚ ይረዳሻል። በአክብሮት መታከም ይገባሻል።
summary.om: Erga deebitee booda qorannoon fayyaa rakkoowwan, infekshinii mallattoo hin qabne dabalatee, dafee argachuu fi yaaluuf si gargaara. Kabajaan yaalamuun siif mala.

body.en:
Your body has worked very hard. A health check after you come home is a good way to take care of yourself. You have the right to be treated with respect.

## Why a check-up helps

- Some health problems have no signs at first. Most sexually transmitted infections (STIs) have no symptoms, so you may not know you have one [1].
- Many STIs can be cured with medicine. Others, like HIV, can be treated [1]. With treatment, people with HIV can live long and healthy lives [2].
- Headaches, tiredness, poor appetite and sleep problems are common among returnees [4]. A health worker can help you with these.

## What you can ask for

- **A general check-up.** Tell the health worker about any pain, illness or medicine you take.
- **Old injuries.** Ask them to check any injury or pain from your time abroad.
- **Long-term illness.** If you have a condition like diabetes or high blood pressure, ask how to continue your care.
- **HIV and STI tests.** You can ask for these tests. You can ask the health worker to keep your results private.
- **A pregnancy test.** If you think you may be pregnant, get checked early. Some STIs can harm a pregnancy if they are not treated [1]. A pregnant woman with HIV should start treatment as soon as possible to protect her baby [2].
- **Your feelings.** You can also talk about stress, sadness or sleep. See "Mental health after return".

## Where to go

- A health centre or hospital near you.
- If you came on a large return flight, IOM has offered medical help on arrival [3]. Ask the staff.
- Look in the help directory in DadaLink for clinics and organisations that help returnees.

Ask about the cost before you start. If you cannot pay, tell the staff and ask if there is free or cheaper help.

## No shame, no blame

Whatever happened to you is not your fault. If someone hurt you or forced you into sex, you deserve care. You choose how much of your story to tell. See "Sexual violence: what to do".

## What you can do

1. Make a list of your health worries before your visit.
2. Go to a health centre for a check-up.
3. Ask for HIV and STI tests, and a pregnancy test if you need one.
4. Ask for privacy if you want it.
5. Take a trusted friend with you if it helps.
6. If you are very sick or in danger, use SOS or the Help numbers in DadaLink.
body.am:
ሰውነትሽ በጣም ብዙ ሠርቷል። ቤት ከደረስሽ በኋላ የጤና ምርመራ ማድረግ ራስሽን የምትንከባከቢበት ጥሩ መንገድ ነው። በአክብሮት የመታከም መብት አለሽ።

## ምርመራ ለምን ይጠቅማል

- አንዳንድ የጤና ችግሮች መጀመሪያ ላይ ምልክት የላቸውም። አብዛኞቹ በግብረ ሥጋ ግንኙነት የሚተላለፉ በሽታዎች (STIs) ምልክት ስለሌላቸው እንዳለብሽ ላታውቂ ትችያለሽ [1]።
- ብዙዎቹ በግብረ ሥጋ ግንኙነት የሚተላለፉ በሽታዎች በመድኃኒት ይድናሉ። እንደ ኤች አይ ቪ ያሉት ደግሞ ሕክምና አላቸው [1]። በሕክምና፣ ኤች አይ ቪ ያለባቸው ሰዎች ረጅምና ጤናማ ሕይወት መኖር ይችላሉ [2]።
- ራስ ምታት፣ ድካም፣ የምግብ ፍላጎት ማጣትና የእንቅልፍ ችግር በተመላሾች ዘንድ የተለመዱ ናቸው [4]። የጤና ባለሙያ በእነዚህ ሊረዳሽ ይችላል።

## ምን መጠየቅ ትችያለሽ

- **አጠቃላይ ምርመራ።** ስላለብሽ ሕመም፣ በሽታ ወይም ስለምትወስጂው መድኃኒት ለጤና ባለሙያው ንገሪ።
- **የቆዩ ጉዳቶች።** ውጭ አገር በነበርሽበት ጊዜ የደረሰብሽን ጉዳት ወይም ሕመም እንዲመረምሩልሽ ጠይቂ።
- **የረጅም ጊዜ ሕመም።** እንደ ስኳር ወይም ደም ግፊት ያለ ሕመም ካለብሽ ሕክምናሽን እንዴት እንደምትቀጥዪ ጠይቂ።
- **የኤች አይ ቪና የአባላዘር በሽታዎች ምርመራ።** እነዚህን ምርመራዎች መጠየቅ ትችያለሽ። ውጤትሽን በምስጢር እንዲይዙ የጤና ባለሙያውን መጠየቅ ትችያለሽ።
- **የእርግዝና ምርመራ።** ያረገዝሽ መስሎ ከተሰማሽ ቶሎ ተመርመሪ። አንዳንድ በግብረ ሥጋ ግንኙነት የሚተላለፉ በሽታዎች ካልታከሙ እርግዝናን ሊጎዱ ይችላሉ [1]። ኤች አይ ቪ ያለባት ነፍሰ ጡር ሴት ልጇን ለመጠበቅ በተቻለ ፍጥነት ሕክምና መጀመር አለባት [2]።
- **ስሜትሽ።** ስለ ጭንቀት፣ ሐዘን ወይም እንቅልፍም መነጋገር ትችያለሽ። "ከተመለስሽ በኋላ የአእምሮ ጤና" የሚለውን ገጽ ተመልከቺ።

## ወዴት መሄድ

- በአቅራቢያሽ ወዳለ ጤና ጣቢያ ወይም ሆስፒታል።
- በትልቅ የመመለሻ በረራ ከመጣሽ፣ IOM ሲደርሱ የሕክምና እርዳታ አቅርቧል [3]። ሠራተኞቹን ጠይቂ።
- ተመላሾችን የሚረዱ ክሊኒኮችንና ድርጅቶችን በDadaLink የእርዳታ ማውጫ ውስጥ ፈልጊ።

ከመጀመርሽ በፊት ዋጋውን ጠይቂ። መክፈል ካልቻልሽ ለሠራተኞቹ ንገሪና ነፃ ወይም ርካሽ እርዳታ እንዳለ ጠይቂ።

## ኀፍረትም ወቀሳም የለም

የደረሰብሽ ማንኛውም ነገር ያንቺ ጥፋት አይደለም። አንድ ሰው ከጎዳሽ ወይም ወሲብ እንድትፈጽሚ ካስገደደሽ እንክብካቤ ይገባሻል። ከታሪክሽ ምን ያህሉን እንደምትናገሪ የምትወስኚው አንቺ ነሽ። "ጾታዊ ጥቃት፦ ምን ማድረግ" የሚለውን ገጽ ተመልከቺ።

## ምን ማድረግ ትችያለሽ

1. ከመሄድሽ በፊት የጤና ስጋቶችሽን ዝርዝር ጻፊ።
2. ለምርመራ ወደ ጤና ጣቢያ ሂጂ።
3. የኤች አይ ቪና የአባላዘር በሽታዎች ምርመራ፣ ካስፈለገሽም የእርግዝና ምርመራ ጠይቂ።
4. ከፈለግሽ ምስጢር እንዲጠበቅልሽ ጠይቂ።
5. ከረዳሽ የምታምኚውን ጓደኛ ይዘሽ ሂጂ።
6. በጣም ከታመምሽ ወይም አደጋ ላይ ከሆንሽ SOSን ወይም በDadaLink ያሉትን የእርዳታ ቁጥሮች ተጠቀሚ።
body.om:
Qaamni kee baay'ee hojjeteera. Erga mana geessee booda qorannoo fayyaa gochuun karaa gaarii ittiin of kunuunsitu dha. Kabajaan yaalamuuf mirga qabda.

## Qorannoon maaliif gargaara

- Rakkoowwan fayyaa tokko tokko jalqaba irratti mallattoo hin qaban. Dhukkuboota quunnamtii saalaatiin daddarban (STIs) baay'een mallattoo waan hin qabneef, akka qabdu beekuu dhiisuu dandeessa [1].
- Dhukkubni quunnamtii saalaatiin daddarbu baay'een qorichaan ni fayya. Kanneen akka HIV ammoo yaala qabu [1]. Yaala argachuun, namoonni HIV qaban jireenya dheeraa fi fayya-qabeessa jiraachuu danda'u [2].
- Mataa bowwuu, dadhabbii, fedhii nyaataa dhabuu fi rakkoon hirribaa deebi'oota biratti baramoo dha [4]. Ogeessi fayyaa kanneen kanaan si gargaaruu danda'a.

## Maal gaafachuu dandeessa

- **Qorannoo waliigalaa.** Waa'ee dhukkubbii, dhukkuba ykn qoricha fudhattu ogeessa fayyaatti himi.
- **Miidhaa durii.** Miidhaa ykn dhukkubbii yeroo biyya alaa turte si mudate akka siif qoran gaafadhu.
- **Dhukkuba yeroo dheeraa.** Dhukkuba akka sukkaaraa ykn dhiibbaa dhiigaa yoo qabaatte, yaala kee akkamitti itti fuftu gaafadhu.
- **Qorannoo HIV fi dhukkuboota quunnamtii saalaa.** Qorannoowwan kana gaafachuu dandeessa. Bu'aa kee iccitiidhaan akka qabu ogeessa fayyaa gaafachuu dandeessa.
- **Qorannoo ulfaa.** Ulfa kan taatee sitti fakkaate, dafii qoratamuu. Dhukkubni quunnamtii saalaa tokko tokko yoo hin yaalamne ulfa miidhuu danda'a [1]. Dubartiin ulfaa HIV qabdu daa'ima ishee eeguuf hamma danda'ametti dafee yaala jalqabuu qabdi [2].
- **Miira kee.** Waa'ee dhiphinaa, gaddaa ykn hirribaa illee dubbachuu dandeessa. Fuula "Erga deebitee booda fayyaa sammuu" ilaali.

## Eessa deemta

- Buufata fayyaa ykn hospitaala sitti dhiyoo.
- Balali'iinsa deebii guddaadhaan yoo dhufte, IOM yeroo ga'an gargaarsa yaalaa dhiyeesseera [3]. Hojjettoota gaafadhu.
- Kilinika fi dhaabbilee deebi'oota gargaaran kallattii gargaarsaa DadaLink keessatti barbaadi.

Osoo hin jalqabin dura gatii isaa gaafadhu. Kaffaluu yoo hin dandeenye, hojjettootatti himiitii gargaarsi bilisaa ykn gatii xiqqaa jiraachuu isaa gaafadhu.

## Qaanii hin qabu, komiin hin jiru

Wanti si mudate kamiyyuu dogoggora kee miti. Namni tokko yoo si miidhe ykn saal-qunnamtiif yoo si dirqisiise, kunuunsi siif mala. Seenaa kee keessaa hammam akka himtu kan murteessitu ati. Fuula "Jeequmsa saalaa: maal gochuu" ilaali.

## Maal gochuu dandeessa

1. Osoo hin deemin dura yaaddoo fayyaa keetii tarreessi.
2. Qorannoof buufata fayyaa dhaqi.
3. Qorannoo HIV fi dhukkuboota quunnamtii saalaa, yoo si barbaachise immoo qorannoo ulfaa gaafadhu.
4. Yoo barbaadde iccitiin akka siif eegamu gaafadhu.
5. Yoo si gargaare hiriyaa amantu fudhadhuu deemi.
6. Baay'ee yoo dhukkubsatte ykn balaa keessa yoo jirte, SOS ykn lakkoofsota gargaarsaa DadaLink fayyadami.

title.en: Taking care of your mind after you return
title.om: Erga deebitee booda fayyaa sammuu kee kunuunsuu

summary.en: Stress, sadness, anger, bad dreams and shame are common after hard experiences. You are not alone, and help is available.
summary.am: ከከባድ ገጠመኞች በኋላ ጭንቀት፣ ሐዘን፣ ቁጣ፣ ቅዠትና ኀፍረት የተለመዱ ናቸው። ብቻሽን አይደለሽም፤ እርዳታም አለ።
summary.om: Muuxannoo ulfaataa booda dhiphinni, gaddi, aariin, abjuun sodaachisaa fi qaanii waan baramoo dha. Kophaa kee miti; gargaarsis ni jira.

body.en:
After coming home, many women feel stressed, sad, angry, numb or afraid. Some have bad dreams or cannot sleep. Some feel shame. These are common reactions to very hard experiences. They do not mean you are weak or "mad".

## You are not alone

The World Health Organization (WHO) says that after very hard events, most people feel worry, sadness, hopelessness or have sleep problems. For most people, this gets better with time [1].

A large study of Ethiopian returnees found that many had signs of depression, anxiety or trauma. People who faced violence, detention or were not free to move were more likely to struggle. Support from other people helped [4].

## Things that can help

- Keep a simple daily routine. Try to sleep and wake up at the same times [2].
- Share your worries and feelings with people you trust [2].
- Avoid alcohol, coffee and big meals just before bed [2].
- Do small things that calm you, like walking, praying or sitting with a friend.
- Be kind to yourself. What happened to you is not your fault.

## When to get more help

Please get help if the feelings stay for a long time, or make it hard to work, eat, sleep or look after yourself [2]. Get help too if painful memories keep coming back and frighten you.

## Where to get help

- Go to your local health centre and say you want to talk about your feelings.
- IOM has given counselling to returnees and sent some people to special mental health care [5].
- Amanuel Mental Specialized Hospital in Addis Ababa is a public mental health hospital [6].
- Find more places in the help directory in DadaLink.

## If you think about ending your life

You matter, and you deserve help. Suicide can be prevented [3]. Many people do not ask for help because of shame, but asking is a brave and good thing to do [3].

- Tell someone you trust today.
- Go to the nearest health centre or hospital.
- Do not stay alone.
- If you are in danger now, use SOS or the emergency numbers in the Help numbers in DadaLink.

## What you can do

1. Remember: your feelings are a normal reaction to hard things.
2. Pick one person you trust and talk to them.
3. Keep a simple routine for sleep and meals.
4. Visit a health centre if the feelings do not get better.
5. Use SOS if you are in danger.
body.am:
ወደ ቤት ከተመለሱ በኋላ ብዙ ሴቶች ጭንቀት፣ ሐዘን፣ ቁጣ፣ የመደንዘዝ ስሜት ወይም ፍርሃት ይሰማቸዋል። አንዳንዶቹ ቅዠት ያያሉ ወይም መተኛት አይችሉም። አንዳንዶቹ ኀፍረት ይሰማቸዋል። እነዚህ ለከባድ ገጠመኞች የተለመዱ ምላሾች ናቸው። ደካማ ነሽ ወይም "አብደሻል" ማለት አይደለም።

## ብቻሽን አይደለሽም

የዓለም ጤና ድርጅት (WHO) እንደሚለው፣ ከከባድ ክስተቶች በኋላ አብዛኛው ሰው ጭንቀት፣ ሐዘን፣ ተስፋ መቁረጥ ወይም የእንቅልፍ ችግር ይሰማዋል። ለአብዛኛው ሰው ይህ ከጊዜ ጋር ይሻሻላል [1]።

በኢትዮጵያውያን ተመላሾች ላይ የተደረገ ትልቅ ጥናት፣ ብዙዎቹ የድብርት፣ የጭንቀት ወይም የአሰቃቂ ገጠመኝ ጉዳት ምልክቶች እንደነበሯቸው አግኝቷል። ጥቃት የደረሰባቸው፣ የታሰሩ ወይም በነፃነት መንቀሳቀስ ያልቻሉ ሰዎች የበለጠ ተቸግረዋል። የሌሎች ሰዎች ድጋፍ ረድቷቸዋል [4]።

## ሊረዱ የሚችሉ ነገሮች

- ቀላል የዕለት ተዕለት ልማድ ይኑርሽ። በተመሳሳይ ሰዓት ለመተኛትና ለመነሳት ሞክሪ [2]።
- ጭንቀትሽንና ስሜትሽን ለምታምኛቸው ሰዎች አካፍዪ [2]።
- ከመተኛትሽ በፊት አልኮል፣ ቡናና ብዙ ምግብ አስወግጂ [2]።
- እንደ መራመድ፣ መጸለይ ወይም ከጓደኛ ጋር መቀመጥ ያሉ የሚያረጋጉሽን ትንንሽ ነገሮች አድርጊ።
- ለራስሽ ደግ ሁኚ። የደረሰብሽ ነገር ያንቺ ጥፋት አይደለም።

## ተጨማሪ እርዳታ መቼ ያስፈልጋል

ስሜቶቹ ለረጅም ጊዜ ከቆዩ፣ ወይም መሥራትን፣ መብላትን፣ መተኛትን ወይም ራስሽን መንከባከብን ካከበዱብሽ እባክሽ እርዳታ ፈልጊ [2]። የሚያሳምሙ ትዝታዎች ደጋግመው እየመጡ ካስፈሩሽም እርዳታ ፈልጊ።

## እርዳታ የት ይገኛል

- በአቅራቢያሽ ወዳለ ጤና ጣቢያ ሂጂና ስለ ስሜትሽ መነጋገር እንደምትፈልጊ ንገሪ።
- IOM ለተመላሾች የምክር አገልግሎት ሰጥቷል፤ አንዳንዶቹንም ወደ ልዩ የአእምሮ ጤና ሕክምና ልኳል [5]።
- በአዲስ አበባ ያለው አማኑኤል የአእምሮ ስፔሻላይዝድ ሆስፒታል የመንግሥት የአእምሮ ጤና ሆስፒታል ነው [6]።
- በDadaLink የእርዳታ ማውጫ ውስጥ ተጨማሪ ቦታዎችን ፈልጊ።

## ሕይወትሽን ስለማጥፋት ካሰብሽ

አንቺ ዋጋ አለሽ፤ እርዳታም ይገባሻል። ራስን ማጥፋትን መከላከል ይቻላል [3]። ብዙ ሰዎች በኀፍረት ምክንያት እርዳታ አይጠይቁም፤ ነገር ግን መጠየቅ ጀግንነትና ጥሩ ነገር ነው [3]።

- ዛሬውኑ ለምታምኚው ሰው ንገሪ።
- በአቅራቢያሽ ወዳለ ጤና ጣቢያ ወይም ሆስፒታል ሂጂ።
- ብቻሽን አትሁኚ።
- አሁን አደጋ ላይ ከሆንሽ SOSን ወይም በDadaLink የእርዳታ ቁጥሮች ውስጥ ያሉትን የአደጋ ጊዜ ቁጥሮች ተጠቀሚ።

## ምን ማድረግ ትችያለሽ

1. አስታውሺ፦ ስሜቶችሽ ለከባድ ነገሮች የተለመዱ ምላሾች ናቸው።
2. የምታምኚውን አንድ ሰው ምረጪና አነጋግሪ።
3. ለእንቅልፍና ለምግብ ቀላል ልማድ ይኑርሽ።
4. ስሜቶቹ ካልተሻሻሉ ጤና ጣቢያ ሂጂ።
5. አደጋ ላይ ከሆንሽ SOSን ተጠቀሚ።
body.om:
Erga gara manaatti deebi'anii booda, dubartoonni baay'een dhiphina, gadda, aarii, miira dhabuu ykn sodaa qabaatu. Tokko tokko abjuu sodaachisaa argu ykn rafuu hin danda'an. Tokko tokko qaanii itti dhaga'ama. Kunneen deebii baramoo muuxannoo baay'ee ulfaataa ti. Laafaa taatee jirta ykn "maraatteetta" jechuu miti.

## Kophaa kee miti

Dhaabbanni Fayyaa Addunyaa (WHO) akka jedhutti, taatee baay'ee ulfaataa booda namoonni baay'een yaaddoo, gadda, abdii kutachuu ykn rakkoo hirribaa qabaatu. Namoota baay'eef kun yeroo waliin ni fooya'a [1].

Qorannoon guddaan deebi'oota Itoophiyaa irratti godhame, baay'een isaanii mallattoo gadda cimaa (depression), yaaddoo ykn miidhaa sammuu qabaachuu isaanii argateera. Namoonni jeequmsi irra ga'e, hidhaman ykn bilisaan sochoo'uu hin dandeenye caalaatti rakkataniiru. Deeggarsi namoota biroo isaan gargaareera [4].

## Wantoota gargaaruu danda'an

- Idilee guyyaa salphaa qabaadhu. Sa'aatii walfakkaatutti rafuu fi ka'uuf yaali [2].
- Yaaddoo fi miira kee namoota amantuuf qoodi [2].
- Osoo hin rafin dura dhugaatii alkoolii, buna fi nyaata baay'ee irraa fagaadhu [2].
- Wantoota xixiqqoo si tasgabbeessan godhi, kan akka deemsa miilaa, kadhannaa ykn hiriyaa waliin taa'uu.
- Ofii keetiif gaarii ta'i. Wanti si mudate dogoggora kee miti.

## Yoom gargaarsa dabalataa barbaaddu

Miirri sun yeroo dheeraaf yoo itti fufe, ykn hojjechuu, nyaachuu, rafuu ykn of kunuunsuu yoo sitti ulfeesse, maaloo gargaarsa barbaadi [2]. Yaadannoon nama dhukkubsu irra deddeebiin dhufee yoo si sodaachise illee gargaarsa barbaadi.

## Gargaarsa eessaa argatta

- Buufata fayyaa naannoo keetii dhaqiitii waa'ee miira keetii dubbachuu akka barbaaddu himi.
- IOM deebi'ootaaf gorsa kenneera; tokko tokko isaanii yaala fayyaa sammuu addaatiif ergeera [5].
- Hospitaalli Addaa Fayyaa Sammuu Amaanu'eel Finfinnee keessa jiru hospitaala fayyaa sammuu mootummaa ti [6].
- Kallattii gargaarsaa DadaLink keessatti bakkeewwan dabalataa barbaadi.

## Lubbuu kee balleessuu yoo yaadde

Ati gatii qabda; gargaarsis siif mala. Of ajjeesuu ittisuun ni danda'ama [3]. Namoonni baay'een qaaniitiin gargaarsa hin gaafatan; garuu gaafachuun ija jabina fi waan gaarii dha [3].

- Har'uma nama amantutti himi.
- Buufata fayyaa ykn hospitaala sitti dhiyoo dhaqi.
- Kophaa kee hin turin.
- Amma balaa keessa yoo jirte, SOS ykn lakkoofsota balaa tasaa lakkoofsota gargaarsaa DadaLink keessa jiran fayyadami.

## Maal gochuu dandeessa

1. Yaadadhu: miirri kee deebii baramoo waan ulfaataa ti.
2. Nama amantu tokko filadhuu dubbisi.
3. Hirribaa fi nyaataaf idilee salphaa qabaadhu.
4. Miirri sun yoo hin fooyyofne buufata fayyaa dhaqi.
5. Balaa keessa yoo jirte SOS fayyadami.

title.en: Money and work after you return
title.om: Erga deebitee booda qarshii fi hojii

summary.en: Protect your savings, look for skills and business support, and if you want to go abroad again, use only a licensed agency.
summary.am: ቁጠባሽን ጠብቂ፣ የክህሎትና የንግድ ድጋፍ ፈልጊ፤ እንደገና ወደ ውጭ መሄድ ከፈለግሽ ፈቃድ ያለው ኤጀንሲ ብቻ ተጠቀሚ።
summary.om: Qusannaa kee eegi, deeggarsa ogummaa fi daldalaa barbaadi; ammas gara alaa deemuu yoo barbaadde, ejensii hayyama qabu qofa fayyadami.

body.en:
Starting again at home takes time. Many returnees come back with little money, or with money that is quickly asked for. You can make a plan that protects you.

## Protect your savings

- Before you spend, make a simple plan. Write down what you have and what you need.
- Keep part of your money only for you: for health, food, and starting work.
- It is okay to say no to some requests. Research found that money from working abroad often helps the family more than the woman herself [6]. You need to look after yourself too.
- Keep your money in a safe place, such as a bank account in your own name.

## Help to start work or a small business

- IOM's reintegration help for vulnerable returnees has three parts: money and work support, social support, and mental health support [1]. In one project, IOM and a local partner gave returnees community support and farming work [1].
- Ethiopia's labour ministry and the ILO ran a project for returnees from Saudi Arabia. It worked with TVET colleges, micro and small enterprise agencies and micro-finance institutions [2].
- An ILO study of returnees from Saudi Arabia looked at their needs, with a focus on skills training for real jobs [3].

Programmes change over time. Ask your local labour office, a TVET college or a micro-finance institution what help is open now. Look in the help directory in DadaLink for returnee support.

## Thinking of going abroad again?

That is your choice. But please stay safe.

- Illegal brokers and dangerous routes can cost lives. Human Rights Watch reported mass killings of Ethiopian migrants by Saudi border guards at the Yemen border [4].
- Use only an agency licensed in Ethiopia. Ethiopia has an overseas employment law (Proclamation 923/2016, amended in 2021) for licensed private employment agencies, and the Ministry of Labour and Skills works with them [5]. See "Licensed agencies vs brokers".
- Never pay a broker who promises a fast trip without a contract.

## What you can do

1. Write a simple money plan before you spend.
2. Keep some savings in your own name.
3. Ask about skills training, business training and small loans near you.
4. If you want to migrate again, check that the agency is licensed.
5. If someone pressures you to travel with a broker, say no and get advice.
6. If you are in danger, use SOS in DadaLink.
body.am:
በቤት እንደገና መጀመር ጊዜ ይወስዳል። ብዙ ተመላሾች ትንሽ ገንዘብ ይዘው ይመለሳሉ፣ ወይም ያላቸው ገንዘብ ቶሎ ይጠየቃል። አንቺን የሚጠብቅ እቅድ ማውጣት ትችያለሽ።

## ቁጠባሽን ጠብቂ

- ከማውጣትሽ በፊት ቀላል እቅድ አውጪ። ያለሽንና የሚያስፈልግሽን ጻፊ።
- ከገንዘብሽ የተወሰነውን ለራስሽ ብቻ አስቀምጪ፦ ለጤና፣ ለምግብና ሥራ ለመጀመር።
- ለአንዳንድ ጥያቄዎች "አይሆንም" ማለት ችግር የለውም። ጥናት እንዳገኘው፣ ውጭ አገር ተሠርቶ የሚገኘው ገንዘብ ብዙ ጊዜ ሴቲቱን ራሷን ሳይሆን ቤተሰቡን ይጠቅማል [6]። አንቺም ራስሽን መንከባከብ አለብሽ።
- ገንዘብሽን በስምሽ በተከፈተ የባንክ ሂሳብ በመሳሰሉ ደህና ቦታዎች አስቀምጪ።

## ሥራ ወይም ትንሽ ንግድ ለመጀመር የሚረዱ ድጋፎች

- IOM ለተጋላጭ ተመላሾች የሚሰጠው መልሶ የማቋቋም እርዳታ ሦስት ክፍሎች አሉት፦ የገንዘብና የሥራ ድጋፍ፣ ማኅበራዊ ድጋፍ እና የአእምሮ ጤና ድጋፍ [1]። በአንድ ፕሮጀክት IOM ከአንድ የአገር ውስጥ አጋር ጋር ለተመላሾች የማኅበረሰብ ድጋፍና የእርሻ ሥራ ሰጥቷል [1]።
- የኢትዮጵያ የሠራተኛ ሚኒስቴርና ILO ከሳዑዲ ዓረቢያ ለተመለሱ ሰዎች ፕሮጀክት አካሂደዋል። ፕሮጀክቱ ከቴክኒክና ሙያ ኮሌጆች፣ ከጥቃቅንና አነስተኛ ኢንተርፕራይዝ ኤጀንሲዎችና ከማይክሮ ፋይናንስ ተቋማት ጋር ሠርቷል [2]።
- የILO ጥናት ከሳዑዲ ዓረቢያ የተመለሱ ሰዎችን ፍላጎት በተለይም ለእውነተኛ ሥራ የሚሆን የክህሎት ሥልጠናን በማተኮር አጥንቷል [3]።

ፕሮግራሞች ከጊዜ ወደ ጊዜ ይለወጣሉ። የአካባቢሽን የሥራ ጽሕፈት ቤት፣ የቴክኒክና ሙያ ኮሌጅ ወይም የማይክሮ ፋይናንስ ተቋም አሁን ምን እርዳታ እንዳለ ጠይቂ። በDadaLink የእርዳታ ማውጫ ውስጥ የተመላሾች ድጋፍ ፈልጊ።

## እንደገና ወደ ውጭ ለመሄድ እያሰብሽ ነው?

ምርጫው ያንቺ ነው። ግን እባክሽ ደህንነትሽን ጠብቂ።

- ሕገ ወጥ ደላሎችና አደገኛ መንገዶች ሕይወት ሊያስከፍሉ ይችላሉ። Human Rights Watch በየመን ድንበር ላይ የሳዑዲ ድንበር ጠባቂዎች ኢትዮጵያውያን ፍልሰተኞችን በጅምላ እንደገደሉ ዘግቧል [4]።
- በኢትዮጵያ ፈቃድ ያለው ኤጀንሲ ብቻ ተጠቀሚ። ኢትዮጵያ ፈቃድ ላላቸው የግል ሥራና ሠራተኛ አገናኝ ኤጀንሲዎች የውጭ አገር ሥራ ስምሪት ሕግ (አዋጅ 923/2016፣ በ2021 የተሻሻለ) አላት፤ የሥራና ክህሎት ሚኒስቴርም ከእነሱ ጋር ይሠራል [5]። "ፈቃድ ያላቸው ኤጀንሲዎችና ደላሎች" የሚለውን ገጽ ተመልከቺ።
- ያለ ውል ፈጣን ጉዞ ቃል ለሚገባ ደላላ በፍጹም ገንዘብ አትክፈዪ።

## ምን ማድረግ ትችያለሽ

1. ከማውጣትሽ በፊት ቀላል የገንዘብ እቅድ ጻፊ።
2. የተወሰነ ቁጠባ በራስሽ ስም አስቀምጪ።
3. በአቅራቢያሽ ስላለ የክህሎት ሥልጠና፣ የንግድ ሥልጠናና ትንሽ ብድር ጠይቂ።
4. እንደገና መሰደድ ከፈለግሽ ኤጀንሲው ፈቃድ ያለው መሆኑን አረጋግጪ።
5. አንድ ሰው በደላላ በኩል እንድትጓዢ ጫና ቢያደርግብሽ "አይሆንም" በዪና ምክር ጠይቂ።
6. አደጋ ላይ ከሆንሽ በDadaLink ውስጥ SOSን ተጠቀሚ።
body.om:
Mana keessatti haaraatti jalqabuun yeroo fudhata. Deebi'oonni baay'een qarshii xiqqaa qabatanii deebi'u, ykn qarshiin isaan qaban dafee gaafatama. Karoora si eegu baafachuu dandeessa.

## Qusannaa kee eegi

- Osoo hin baasin dura karoora salphaa baafadhu. Waan qabduu fi waan si barbaachisu barreessi.
- Qarshii kee keessaa kutaa tokko ofii keetiif qofa kaa'i: fayyaaf, nyaataaf fi hojii jalqabuuf.
- Gaaffiiwwan tokko tokkoof "lakki" jechuun rakkoo hin qabu. Qorannoon akka argetti, qarshiin biyya alaatti hojjetamee argamu yeroo baay'ee dubartittii ofii caalaa maatii fayyada [6]. Atis of kunuunsuu qabda.
- Qarshii kee iddoo nagaa, kan akka herrega baankii maqaa keetiin banameetti kaa'i.

## Deeggarsa hojii ykn daldala xiqqaa jalqabuuf

- Gargaarsi deebisanii dhaabuu IOM deebi'oota miidhamoo ta'aniif kennu kutaa sadii qaba: deeggarsa qarshii fi hojii, deeggarsa hawaasummaa fi deeggarsa fayyaa sammuu [1]. Pirojektii tokko keessatti, IOM michuu biyya keessaa tokko waliin deebi'ootaaf deeggarsa hawaasaa fi hojii qonnaa kenneera [1].
- Ministeerri hojii Itoophiyaa fi ILO deebi'oota Saa'uudii Arabiyaa irraa dhufaniif pirojektii hojjechiisaniiru. Pirojektiin kun kolleejjiiwwan teeknikaa fi ogummaa (TVET), ejensiiwwan intarpiraayizii xiqqaa fi giddugaleessaa fi dhaabbilee maayikroo faayinaansii waliin hojjeteera [2].
- Qorannoon ILO fedhii deebi'oota Saa'uudii Arabiyaa irraa dhufanii, keessumaa leenjii ogummaa hojii dhugaatiif ta'u irratti xiyyeeffachuun qoreera [3].

Sagantaaleen yeroo irraa gara yerootti jijjiiramu. Waajjira hojii naannoo keetii, kolleejjii TVET ykn dhaabbata maayikroo faayinaansii amma gargaarsi maaltu akka jiru gaafadhu. Deeggarsa deebi'ootaa kallattii gargaarsaa DadaLink keessatti barbaadi.

## Ammas gara alaa deemuu yaaddaa?

Filannoon kan kee ti. Garuu maaloo nageenya kee eeggadhu.

- Bitattoonni (delaaloonni) seeraan alaa fi karaaleen balaa qaban lubbuu baasisuu danda'u. Human Rights Watch daangaa Yemen irratti eegdonni daangaa Saa'uudii godaantota Itoophiyaa jumlaan akka ajjeesan gabaaseera [4].
- Ejensii Itoophiyaa keessatti hayyama qabu qofa fayyadami. Itoophiyaan ejensiiwwan qacarrii dhuunfaa hayyama qabaniif seera hojii biyya alaa (Labsii 923/2016, bara 2021 fooyya'e) qabdi; Ministeerri Hojii fi Ogummaas isaan waliin hojjeta [5]. Fuula "Ejensiiwwan hayyama qaban fi delaaloota" ilaali.
- Delaalaa waliigaltee malee imala saffisaa siif waadaa galuuf gonkumaa qarshii hin kaffalin.

## Maal gochuu dandeessa

1. Osoo hin baasin dura karoora qarshii salphaa barreessi.
2. Qusannaa tokko maqaa keetiin kaa'i.
3. Waa'ee leenjii ogummaa, leenjii daldalaa fi liqii xiqqaa naannoo keetti jiru gaafadhu.
4. Ammas godaanuu yoo barbaadde, ejensiin sun hayyama qabaachuu isaa mirkaneeffadhu.
5. Namni tokko karaa delaalaatiin akka imaltu yoo si dhiibe, "lakki" jedhiitii gorsa gaafadhu.
6. Balaa keessa yoo jirte, DadaLink keessatti SOS fayyadami.

title.en: Getting ready to go home
title.om: Gara manaatti deebi'uuf qophaa'uu

summary.en: Before you leave, try to collect your pay, keep copies of your papers and know who pays for your ticket. Your embassy can help with travel documents.
summary.am: ከመሄድሽ በፊት ደሞዝሽን ለመሰብሰብ ሞክሪ፣ የሰነዶችሽን ቅጂ ያዢ፣ ቲኬቱን ማን እንደሚከፍል እወቂ። ኤምባሲሽ በጉዞ ሰነድ ሊረዳሽ ይችላል።
summary.om: Osoo hin deemin dura, mindaa kee walitti qabachuuf yaali, garagalcha sanadoota keetii qabadhu, tikeetii eenyutu kaffala akka ta'e beeki. Embaasiin kee sanada imalaatiin si gargaaruu danda'a.

body.en:
Going home is a big step. A little planning can protect your money and your rights. You do not have to do it alone.

## Collect what you are owed

- Ask for all your unpaid salary before you travel. Many workers go home without their wages. It is much harder to claim them once you are home [3][4].
- Ask about your end-of-service money. In Saudi Arabia, the 2013 domestic worker rules say that a worker who works four years in a row for the same employer gets one month's salary as an end-of-service benefit [1].
- Rules are different in each country. Read the rights page for your country in DadaLink.
- If your employer refuses to pay, try to complain before you leave, if it is safe. See "Unpaid wages".

## Who pays for the ticket?

In Saudi Arabia, the 2013 rules say the employer must pay for your ticket home when the contract ends. The employer must also pay if they end the contract without a legal reason, or if you leave for a legitimate reason [1].

Other countries have different rules. Check the rights page for the country where you work.

Do not sign any paper that says you were paid if you were not paid.

## Keep copies of your papers

Workers' groups say employers should let workers take copies of their work records, like pay records, when they leave [3]. Before you go, try to keep:

- your passport, visa and residence card (photos are fine)
- your contract
- pay slips and money transfer receipts
- screenshots of messages about your pay
- your employer's full name, phone number and address
- any complaint papers or reference numbers

Keep the photos on your phone and in an email account. Send copies to someone you trust.

## If you have no passport

Your embassy or consulate can give you a passport or a travel document. Helping citizens with passports and travel documents is one of the jobs of a consulate under international law [2]. Contact the Ethiopian embassy or consulate. You can find them in the Help numbers in DadaLink.

## What you can do

1. Write down how many months you were not paid, and how much.
2. Ask your employer for your final pay and any end-of-service money.
3. If they refuse, complain before you travel if it is safe. Ask the embassy for help.
4. Take photos of all your papers and keep them safe.
5. Tell a trusted person your flight date and time.
6. If you are in danger, use SOS in DadaLink.

Not being paid is not your fault. You did the work, and the money is yours.
body.am:
ወደ ቤት መመለስ ትልቅ እርምጃ ነው። ትንሽ እቅድ ገንዘብሽንና መብትሽን ሊጠብቅ ይችላል። ይህን ብቻሽን ማድረግ የለብሽም።

## የሚገባሽን ሰብስቢ

- ከመጓዝሽ በፊት ያልተከፈለሽን ደሞዝ በሙሉ ጠይቂ። ብዙ ሠራተኞች ደሞዛቸውን ሳይቀበሉ ወደ ቤት ይመለሳሉ። ቤት ከደረስሽ በኋላ መጠየቅ በጣም ከባድ ነው [3][4]።
- ስለ አገልግሎት ማብቂያ ክፍያ ጠይቂ። በሳዑዲ ዓረቢያ የ2013 የቤት ሠራተኞች ደንብ እንደሚለው፣ ለአንድ አሠሪ አራት ዓመት ያለማቋረጥ የሠራች ሠራተኛ የአንድ ወር ደሞዝ የአገልግሎት ማብቂያ ክፍያ ታገኛለች [1]።
- ደንቦቹ በየአገሩ ይለያያሉ። በDadaLink ውስጥ የአገርሽን የመብቶች ገጽ አንብቢ።
- አሠሪሽ ለመክፈል ፈቃደኛ ካልሆነ፣ ደህንነትሽ የተጠበቀ ከሆነ ከመሄድሽ በፊት አቤቱታ ለማቅረብ ሞክሪ። "ያልተከፈለ ደሞዝ" የሚለውን ገጽ ተመልከቺ።

## ቲኬቱን ማን ይከፍላል?

በሳዑዲ ዓረቢያ የ2013 ደንቦች እንደሚሉት፣ ውሉ ሲያበቃ አሠሪው የመመለሻ ቲኬትሽን መክፈል አለበት። አሠሪው ውሉን ያለ ሕጋዊ ምክንያት ካቋረጠ፣ ወይም አንቺ በሕጋዊ ምክንያት ከለቀቅሽም አሠሪው መክፈል አለበት [1]።

ሌሎች አገሮች የተለያዩ ደንቦች አሏቸው። የምትሠሪበትን አገር የመብቶች ገጽ ተመልከቺ።

ያልተከፈለሽ ከሆነ "ተከፍሎኛል" የሚል ምንም ወረቀት አትፈርሚ።

## የሰነዶችሽን ቅጂ ያዢ

የሠራተኞች ድርጅቶች፣ ሠራተኞች ሲለቁ እንደ የክፍያ መዝገብ ያሉ የሥራ መዝገቦቻቸውን ቅጂ እንዲወስዱ አሠሪዎች መፍቀድ አለባቸው ይላሉ [3]። ከመሄድሽ በፊት እነዚህን ለመያዝ ሞክሪ፦

- ፓስፖርትሽ፣ ቪዛሽና የመኖሪያ ፈቃድ ካርድሽ (ፎቶ ይበቃል)
- ውልሽ
- የደሞዝ ወረቀቶችና የገንዘብ መላኪያ ደረሰኞች
- ስለ ደሞዝሽ የተላኩ መልእክቶች ስክሪንሾት
- የአሠሪሽ ሙሉ ስም፣ ስልክ ቁጥርና አድራሻ
- ማንኛውም የአቤቱታ ወረቀት ወይም የማጣቀሻ ቁጥር

ፎቶዎቹን በስልክሽና በኢሜይል አካውንትሽ አስቀምጪ። ቅጂዎቹን ለምታምኚው ሰው ላኪ።

## ፓስፖርት ከሌለሽ

ኤምባሲሽ ወይም ቆንስላሽ ፓስፖርት ወይም የጉዞ ሰነድ ሊሰጥሽ ይችላል። በዓለም አቀፍ ሕግ መሠረት ዜጎችን በፓስፖርትና በጉዞ ሰነድ መርዳት የቆንስላ ሥራ አንዱ ነው [2]። የኢትዮጵያ ኤምባሲን ወይም ቆንስላን አግኚ። በDadaLink ውስጥ ባሉት የእርዳታ ቁጥሮች ልታገኚያቸው ትችያለሽ።

## ምን ማድረግ ትችያለሽ

1. ስንት ወር እንዳልተከፈለሽና ምን ያህል እንደሆነ ጻፊ።
2. የመጨረሻ ደሞዝሽንና የአገልግሎት ማብቂያ ክፍያሽን አሠሪሽን ጠይቂ።
3. እምቢ ካሉ፣ ደህንነትሽ ከተጠበቀ ከመጓዝሽ በፊት አቤቱታ አቅርቢ። ኤምባሲውን እርዳታ ጠይቂ።
4. የሰነዶችሽን ሁሉ ፎቶ አንሺና በጥንቃቄ አስቀምጪ።
5. የበረራሽን ቀንና ሰዓት ለምታምኚው ሰው ንገሪ።
6. አደጋ ላይ ከሆንሽ በDadaLink ውስጥ SOSን ተጠቀሚ።

ደሞዝ አለመከፈልሽ ያንቺ ጥፋት አይደለም። ሥራውን ሠርተሻል፤ ገንዘቡ ያንቺ ነው።
body.om:
Gara manaatti deebi'uun tarkaanfii guddaa dha. Karoorri xiqqaan qarshii keetii fi mirga kee eeguu danda'a. Kana kophaa kee gochuu hin qabdu.

## Waan siif malu walitti qabadhu

- Osoo hin imaliin dura, mindaa siif hin kaffalamne hunda gaafadhu. Hojjettoonni baay'een osoo mindaa isaanii hin argatin gara manaatti deebi'u. Erga mana geessee booda gaafachuun baay'ee ulfaataa dha [3][4].
- Waa'ee kaffaltii xumura tajaajilaa gaafadhu. Saa'uudii Arabiyaatti, seerri hojjettoota manaa bara 2013 akka jedhutti, hojjettuun waggaa afur walitti fufiinsaan qacaraa tokkoof hojjette mindaa ji'a tokkoo akka kaffaltii xumura tajaajilaatti argatti [1].
- Seerri biyya biyyaan garaagara. DadaLink keessatti fuula mirgaa biyya keetii dubbisi.
