- Qacarri kee kaffaluu yoo dide, nageenyi kee yoo eegame, osoo hin deemin dura komii dhiyeessuuf yaali. Fuula "Mindaa hin kaffalamne" ilaali.

## Tikeetii eenyutu kaffala?

Saa'uudii Arabiyaatti, seerri bara 2013 akka jedhutti, yeroo waliigalteen xumuramu qacarri tikeetii deebii kee kaffaluu qaba. Qacarri waliigaltee sababa seeraa malee yoo addaan kute, ykn ati sababa seeraa qabuun yoo hojii dhiifte, qacarri kaffaluu qaba [1].

Biyyoonni biroo seera garaagaraa qabu. Fuula mirgaa biyya itti hojjettuu ilaali.

Yoo siif hin kaffalamne, waraqaa "naaf kaffalameera" jedhu kamiyyuu hin mallattoofne.

## Garagalcha sanadoota keetii qabadhu

Dhaabbileen hojjettootaa, qacartoonni yeroo hojjettoonni ba'an galmee hojii, kan akka galmee kaffaltii, garagalchaa akka fudhatan hayyamuu qabu jedhu [3]. Osoo hin deemin dura, kanneen armaan gadii qabachuuf yaali:

- paaspoortii, viizaa fi kaardii jireenyaa kee (suuraan ni ga'a)
- waliigaltee kee
- waraqaa mindaa fi nagahee qarshii ergaa
- suuraa ergaawwan waa'ee mindaa kee (screenshot)
- maqaa guutuu, lakkoofsa bilbilaa fi teessoo qacaraa keetii
- waraqaa komii ykn lakkoofsa wabii kamiyyuu

Suuraawwan bilbila keetii fi akkaawuntii imeelii keessa kaa'i. Garagalcha nama amantuuf ergi.

## Paaspoortii yoo hin qabaatte

Embaasiin ykn qonsilaan kee paaspoortii ykn sanada imalaa siif kennuu danda'a. Seera idil-addunyaa jalatti, lammiilee paaspoortii fi sanada imalaatiin gargaaruun hojii qonsilaa keessaa tokko [2]. Embaasii ykn qonsilaa Itoophiyaa qunnami. Lakkoofsota gargaarsaa DadaLink keessatti isaan argachuu dandeessa.

## Maal gochuu dandeessa

1. Ji'a meeqa akka siif hin kaffalamne fi hammam akka ta'e barreessi.
2. Mindaa kee isa dhumaa fi kaffaltii xumura tajaajilaa qacaraa kee gaafadhu.
3. Yoo didan, nageenyi kee yoo eegame, osoo hin imaliin dura komii dhiyeessi. Embaasii gargaarsa gaafadhu.
4. Sanadoota kee hunda suuraa kaasii nageenyaan kaa'i.
5. Guyyaa fi sa'aatii balali'iinsa keetii nama amantuuf himi.
6. Balaa keessa yoo jirte, DadaLink keessatti SOS fayyadami.

Mindaan siif kaffalamuu dhabuun dogoggora kee miti. Hojii hojjetteetta; qarshiin sun kan kee ti.

title.en: My employer took my passport. What can I do?
title.am: አሰሪዬ ፓስፖርቴን ወሰደብኝ። ምን ማድረግ እችላለሁ?
title.om: Hojjechiisaan koo paaspoortii koo fudhate. Maal gochuu danda'a?

summary.en: This happens to many women.
summary.am: ይህ በብዙ ሴቶች ላይ ይደርሳል።
summary.om: Kun dubartoota baay'ee irra ga'a.

body.en: This happens to many women. It is not your fault. Keep a photo of your passport and visa on your phone and with someone you trust at home. Write down the date it was taken in your private log. Ask calmly for it back, or ask where it is kept. In several of these countries the law does not let employers keep your passport; see your country's rights page. You can complain to the labour ministry or ask your embassy for help. Their numbers are in Help numbers.
body.am: ይህ በብዙ ሴቶች ላይ ይደርሳል። የእርስዎ ጥፋት አይደለም። የፓስፖርትዎንና የቪዛዎን ፎቶ በስልክዎ እና በቤት ካለ የሚያምኑት ሰው ጋር ያስቀምጡ። የተወሰደበትን ቀን በግል ማስታወሻዎ ይጻፉ። በእርጋታ እንዲመለስልዎ ወይም የት እንደተቀመጠ ይጠይቁ። በብዙዎቹ በእነዚህ አገሮች ሕጉ አሰሪ ፓስፖርትዎን እንዲይዝ አይፈቅድም፤ የአገርዎን የመብት ገጽ ይመልከቱ። ለሠራተኛ ሚኒስቴር ማመልከት ወይም ኤምባሲዎን እርዳታ መጠየቅ ይችላሉ። ቁጥሮቻቸው በ«የእርዳታ ቁጥሮች» ውስጥ አሉ።
body.om: Kun dubartoota baay'ee irra ga'a. Dogoggora kee miti. Suuraa paaspoortii fi viizaa keetii bilbila kee irratti, akkasumas nama amanattu mana jiru biratti kaa'i. Guyyaa itti fudhatame galmee dhuunfaa kee keessatti barreessi. Akka siif deebisan ykn eessa akka kaa'ame gaafadhu. Biyyoota kanneen keessaa hedduu keessatti seerri hojjechiisaan paaspoortii kee akka qabatu hin hayyamu; fuula mirgaa biyya keetii ilaali. Ministeera hojjettootaatti komii dhiyeessuu ykn embaasii kee gargaarsa gaafachuu dandeessa. Lakkoofsi isaanii 'Lakkoofsota Gargaarsaa' keessa jira.

title.en: My employer has not paid my salary. What should I do?
title.am: አሰሪዬ ደሞዜን አልከፈለኝም። ምን ማድረግ አለብኝ?
title.om: Hojjechiisaan koo mindaa koo hin kaffalle. Maal gochuu qaba?

summary.en: You have a right to be paid what your contract says.
summary.am: በውልዎ የተጻፈውን ደሞዝ የማግኘት መብት አለዎት።
summary.om: Waan waliigalteen kee jedhu kaffalamuuf mirga qabda.

body.en: You have a right to be paid what your contract says. Start a record today in your private log: each month, the amount you should get, what you got, and the date. Keep photos of your contract and any payment slips or bank messages. Ask your employer politely, and tell your agency. If you are still not paid, you can complain to the labour ministry or ask your embassy for help. See your country's rights page for the complaint channels.
body.am: በውልዎ የተጻፈውን ደሞዝ የማግኘት መብት አለዎት። ዛሬውኑ በግል ማስታወሻዎ መመዝገብ ይጀምሩ፤ በየወሩ ማግኘት የነበረብዎን፣ ያገኙትን እና ቀኑን። የውልዎን፣ የክፍያ ደረሰኞችን ወይም የባንክ መልእክቶችን ፎቶ ያስቀምጡ። አሰሪዎን በትሕትና ይጠይቁ፣ ኤጀንሲዎንም ያሳውቁ። አሁንም ካልተከፈለዎት ለሠራተኛ ሚኒስቴር ማመልከት ወይም ኤምባሲዎን መጠየቅ ይችላሉ። የአቤቱታ መንገዶችን በአገርዎ የመብት ገጽ ይመልከቱ።
body.om: Waan waliigalteen kee jedhu kaffalamuuf mirga qabda. Har'uma galmee dhuunfaa kee keessatti galmeessuu jalqabi: ji'a ji'aan, hamma argachuu qabdu, hamma argatte fi guyyaa. Suuraa waliigaltee keetii fi ragaa kaffaltii ykn ergaa baankii kaa'i. Hojjechiisaa kee kabajaan gaafadhu, ejensii kees beeksisi. Ammas yoo hin kaffalamne, ministeera hojjettootaatti komii dhiyeessuu ykn embaasii kee gaafachuu dandeessa. Karaalee komii fuula mirgaa biyya keetii keessatti ilaali.

title.en: I never get a day off. Is that allowed?
title.am: አንድም የእረፍት ቀን አላገኝም። ይህ ይፈቀዳል?
title.om: Guyyaa boqonnaa tokkollee hin argadhu. Kun hayyamamaadhaa?

summary.en: You deserve rest.
summary.am: እረፍት ይገባዎታል።
summary.om: Boqonnaan siif ni mala.

body.en: You deserve rest. Most of these countries now have rules about a weekly day off and daily rest for domestic workers, but the details are different in each country. Check your country's rights page. Write your working hours and days off in your private log. Talk calmly with your employer about a rest day. If nothing changes, you can contact the labour ministry or your embassy.
body.am: እረፍት ይገባዎታል። አብዛኞቹ እነዚህ አገሮች ለቤት ሠራተኞች ሳምንታዊ የእረፍት ቀንና የዕለት እረፍት ደንብ አላቸው፤ ዝርዝሩ ግን በየአገሩ ይለያያል። የአገርዎን የመብት ገጽ ይመልከቱ። የሥራ ሰዓትዎንና የእረፍት ቀናትዎን በግል ማስታወሻዎ ይጻፉ። ስለ እረፍት ቀን ከአሰሪዎ ጋር በእርጋታ ይነጋገሩ። ምንም ካልተለወጠ ሠራተኛ ሚኒስቴርን ወይም ኤምባሲዎን ማግኘት ይችላሉ።
body.om: Boqonnaan siif ni mala. Biyyoonni kunneen baay'een isaanii hojjettoota manaatiif guyyaa boqonnaa torbanii fi boqonnaa guyyaa guyyaa irratti seera qabu, garuu bal'inni isaa biyyaa biyyatti garaa garummaa qaba. Fuula mirgaa biyya keetii ilaali. Sa'aatii hojii fi guyyoota boqonnaa kee galmee dhuunfaa keessatti barreessi. Waa'ee guyyaa boqonnaa hojjechiisaa kee wajjin tasgabbiin haasa'i. Yoo homtuu hin jijjiiramne, ministeera hojjettootaa ykn embaasii kee quunnamuu dandeessa.

title.en: I work from early morning to late at night and I am always tired. What can I do?
title.am: ከማለዳ እስከ ሌሊት እሠራለሁ፤ ሁልጊዜ ደክሞኛል። ምን ማድረግ እችላለሁ?
title.om: Ganama barii hanga halkan dheeraatti nan hojjedha, yeroo hunda nan dadhabaa. Maal gochuu danda'a?

summary.en: Very long hours with no sleep are harmful, and it is right to ask for rest.
summary.am: ያለ እንቅልፍ ረጅም ሰዓት መሥራት ይጎዳል፤ እረፍት መጠየቅ ትክክል ነው።
summary.om: Sa'aatii dheeraa hirriba malee hojjechuun miidhaa qaba; boqonnaa gaafachuun sirrii dha.

body.en: Very long hours with no sleep are harmful, and it is right to ask for rest. Write down when you start and stop each day in your private log. That record helps if you complain later. Look at your country's rights page to see the rules on hours and rest. Try to eat, drink water and sleep when you can. If you feel unwell or unsafe, use Help numbers or the SOS button.
body.am: ያለ እንቅልፍ ረጅም ሰዓት መሥራት ይጎዳል፤ እረፍት መጠየቅ ትክክል ነው። በየቀኑ የሚጀምሩበትንና የሚጨርሱበትን ሰዓት በግል ማስታወሻዎ ይጻፉ። ይህ መዝገብ በኋላ ቅሬታ ካቀረቡ ይረዳዎታል። ስለ ሥራ ሰዓትና እረፍት ደንቦቹን በአገርዎ የመብት ገጽ ይመልከቱ። በቻሉ ጊዜ ይመገቡ፣ ውሃ ይጠጡ፣ ይተኙ። ጤና ካልተሰማዎት ወይም ደኅንነት ካልተሰማዎት «የእርዳታ ቁጥሮች»ን ወይም የSOS ቁልፉን ይጠቀሙ።
body.om: Sa'aatii dheeraa hirriba malee hojjechuun miidhaa qaba; boqonnaa gaafachuun sirrii dha. Guyyaa guyyaan yeroo jalqabdu fi xumurtu galmee dhuunfaa kee keessatti barreessi. Galmeen kun yoo booda komii dhiyeessite si gargaara. Seera sa'aatii hojii fi boqonnaa fuula mirgaa biyya keetii keessatti ilaali. Yeroo dandeessutti nyaadhu, bishaan dhugi, rafi. Yoo dhukkubsatte ykn nageenya dhabde, 'Lakkoofsota Gargaarsaa' ykn furtuu SOS fayyadami.

title.en: I am sick and my employer will not take me to a doctor. What should I do?
title.am: ታምሜያለሁ፤ አሰሪዬ ወደ ሐኪም አይወስደኝም። ምን ላድርግ?
title.om: Nan dhukkubsadha, hojjechiisaan koo gara ogeessa fayyaa na hin geessu. Maal gochuu qaba?

summary.en: Your health matters.
summary.am: ጤናዎ አስፈላጊ ነው።
summary.om: Fayyaan kee barbaachisaa dha.

body.en: Your health matters. If it is serious (trouble breathing, heavy bleeding, chest pain, fainting, a bad injury), call the ambulance number in Help numbers now or press SOS. If it is not urgent, tell your employer clearly what you feel and ask for a doctor. Write down your symptoms and dates in your private log. Your country's rights page explains what health care the law says you should get. Your embassy or agency can also help.
body.am: ጤናዎ አስፈላጊ ነው። ከባድ ከሆነ (መተንፈስ መቸገር፣ ብዙ ደም መፍሰስ፣ የደረት ሕመም፣ መውደቅ፣ ከባድ ጉዳት) አሁኑኑ በ«የእርዳታ ቁጥሮች» ያለውን የአምቡላንስ ቁጥር ይደውሉ ወይም SOS ይጫኑ። አስቸኳይ ካልሆነ የሚሰማዎትን ለአሰሪዎ በግልጽ ይንገሩና ሐኪም ይጠይቁ። ምልክቶችንና ቀኖችን በግል ማስታወሻዎ ይጻፉ። ሕጉ ምን ዓይነት የጤና አገልግሎት እንደሚሰጥዎ በአገርዎ የመብት ገጽ ይገኛል። ኤምባሲዎ ወይም ኤጀንሲዎ ሊረዱ ይችላሉ።
body.om: Fayyaan kee barbaachisaa dha. Yoo cimaa ta'e (hafuura baafachuu dadhabuu, dhiigni baay'ee dhangala'uu, dhukkubbii qomaa, kufuu, miidhaa cimaa), amma lakkoofsa ambulaansii 'Lakkoofsota Gargaarsaa' keessa jiru bilbili ykn SOS tuqi. Yoo ariifachiisaa hin taane, waan sitti dhaga'amu hojjechiisaa keetti ifatti himiitii ogeessa fayyaa gaafadhu. Mallattoolee fi guyyoota galmee dhuunfaa keessatti barreessi. Tajaajila fayyaa seerri siif kennu fuula mirgaa biyya keetii keessatti argatta. Embaasiin kee ykn ejensiin kee si gargaaruu danda'u.

title.en: My employer hits me or threatens me. What can I do?
title.am: አሰሪዬ ይመታኛል ወይም ያስፈራራኛል። ምን ማድረግ እችላለሁ?
title.om: Hojjechiisaan koo na reebu ykn na sodaachisa. Maal gochuu danda'a?

summary.en: No one has the right to hurt you.
summary.am: ማንም ሊጎዳዎ መብት የለውም።
summary.om: Namni kamiyyuu si miidhuuf mirga hin qabu.

body.en: No one has the right to hurt you. This is not your fault. If you are in danger now, press SOS or call the police or emergency number in Help numbers. When you are safe, keep evidence if you can: photos of injuries, dates and what happened, in your private log. Contact your embassy, a shelter or a support organisation from Help numbers. You can also complain to the labour ministry or police. You do not have to face this alone.
body.am: ማንም ሊጎዳዎ መብት የለውም። ይህ የእርስዎ ጥፋት አይደለም። አሁን አደጋ ላይ ከሆኑ SOS ይጫኑ ወይም በ«የእርዳታ ቁጥሮች» ያለውን የፖሊስ ወይም የአደጋ ጊዜ ቁጥር ይደውሉ። ደኅንነትዎ ሲጠበቅ ከቻሉ ማስረጃ ያስቀምጡ፤ የጉዳት ፎቶ፣ ቀንና የሆነውን በግል ማስታወሻዎ። ኤምባሲዎን፣ መጠለያ ወይም የድጋፍ ድርጅት ከ«የእርዳታ ቁጥሮች» ያግኙ። ለሠራተኛ ሚኒስቴር ወይም ለፖሊስ ማመልከትም ይችላሉ። ብቻዎን መጋፈጥ የለብዎትም።
body.om: Namni kamiyyuu si miidhuuf mirga hin qabu. Kun dogoggora kee miti. Yoo amma balaa keessa jirta ta'e, SOS tuqi ykn lakkoofsa poolisii ykn balaa tasaa 'Lakkoofsota Gargaarsaa' keessa jiru bilbili. Yeroo nagaa taatetti, yoo dandeesse ragaa kuusi: suuraa miidhaa, guyyaa fi waan ta'e galmee dhuunfaa keessatti. Embaasii kee, iddoo baqannaa ykn dhaabbata deeggarsaa 'Lakkoofsota Gargaarsaa' irraa quunnamu. Ministeera hojjettootaa ykn poolisiitti komii dhiyeessuus dandeessa. Kana qofaa kee hin qabattu.

title.en: I am locked in the house and not given enough food. What can I do?
title.am: ቤት ውስጥ ተቆልፎብኛል፤ በቂ ምግብ አይሰጠኝም። ምን ማድረግ እችላለሁ?
title.om: Mana keessatti cufamee jira, nyaata gahaa hin argadhu. Maal gochuu danda'a?

summary.en: Being locked in or kept hungry is abuse, and it can be a sign of forced labour or trafficking.
summary.am: መቆለፍ ወይም መራብ ጥቃት ነው፤ የግዳጅ ሥራ ወይም የሰዎች ዝውውር ምልክት ሊሆን ይችላል።
summary.om: Cufamuu ykn beelaan turuun miidhaa dha; mallattoo hojii dirqamaa ykn daldala namootaa ta'uu danda'a.

body.en: Being locked in or kept hungry is abuse, and it can be a sign of forced labour or trafficking. It is not your fault. If you are in danger, press SOS or call the emergency number in Help numbers. If you can, quietly send your location to your trusted contact. Contact your embassy or an anti-trafficking or support organisation from Help numbers. Write down dates and what happens in your private log.
body.am: መቆለፍ ወይም መራብ ጥቃት ነው፤ የግዳጅ ሥራ ወይም የሰዎች ዝውውር ምልክት ሊሆን ይችላል። የእርስዎ ጥፋት አይደለም። አደጋ ላይ ከሆኑ SOS ይጫኑ ወይም በ«የእርዳታ ቁጥሮች» ያለውን የአደጋ ጊዜ ቁጥር ይደውሉ። ከቻሉ ያሉበትን ቦታ በጸጥታ ለሚያምኑት ሰው ይላኩ። ኤምባሲዎን ወይም የፀረ-ሕገወጥ ዝውውር ወይም የድጋፍ ድርጅት ከ«የእርዳታ ቁጥሮች» ያግኙ። ቀኖችንና የሚሆነውን በግል ማስታወሻዎ ይጻፉ።
body.om: Cufamuu ykn beelaan turuun miidhaa dha; mallattoo hojii dirqamaa ykn daldala namootaa ta'uu danda'a. Dogoggora kee miti. Yoo balaa keessa jirta, SOS tuqi ykn lakkoofsa balaa tasaa 'Lakkoofsota Gargaarsaa' keessa jiru bilbili. Yoo dandeesse, bakka jirtu callisaan nama amanattutti ergi. Embaasii kee ykn dhaabbata daldala namootaa ittisu ykn deeggarsaa 'Lakkoofsota Gargaarsaa' irraa quunnamu. Guyyoota fi waan ta'u galmee dhuunfaa keessatti barreessi.

title.en: Someone forced me into sex. What can I do?
title.am: አንድ ሰው በግድ ወሲብ ፈጸመብኝ። ምን ማድረግ እችላለሁ?
title.om: Namni tokko humnaan wal-qunnamtii saalaa narratti raawwate. Maal gochuu danda'a?

summary.en: I am so sorry this happened.
summary.am: ይህ ስለደረሰብዎ በጣም አዝናለሁ።
summary.om: Kun waan sirra ga'eef baay'een gadda.

body.en: I am so sorry this happened. It is not your fault. First, get to a safe place if you can; press SOS or call the emergency number in Help numbers if you are in danger. See a doctor as soon as possible. Medicine to prevent HIV (PEP) must be started within 72 hours. Emergency contraception works up to 5 days after, and works best the sooner you take it. Reporting to police is your choice. Your embassy, a shelter or a support organisation can help you. You are not alone.
body.am: ይህ ስለደረሰብዎ በጣም አዝናለሁ። የእርስዎ ጥፋት አይደለም። በመጀመሪያ ከቻሉ ደኅንነቱ ወደተጠበቀ ቦታ ይሂዱ፤ አደጋ ላይ ከሆኑ SOS ይጫኑ ወይም በ«የእርዳታ ቁጥሮች» ያለውን የአደጋ ጊዜ ቁጥር ይደውሉ። በተቻለ ፍጥነት ሐኪም ያግኙ። ኤች አይ ቪን የሚከላከለው መድኃኒት (PEP) በ72 ሰዓት ውስጥ መጀመር አለበት። የድንገተኛ ጊዜ የእርግዝና መከላከያ እስከ 5 ቀን ድረስ ይሠራል፤ ቶሎ ሲወሰድ የበለጠ ይሠራል። ለፖሊስ ማሳወቅ የእርስዎ ምርጫ ነው። ኤምባሲዎ፣ መጠለያ ወይም የድጋፍ ድርጅት ሊረዱዎት ይችላሉ። ብቻዎን አይደሉም።
body.om: Kun waan sirra ga'eef baay'een gadda. Dogoggora kee miti. Jalqaba, yoo dandeesse bakka nagaa dhaqi; yoo balaa keessa jirta SOS tuqi ykn lakkoofsa balaa tasaa 'Lakkoofsota Gargaarsaa' keessa jiru bilbili. Hamma dandeessu dafii ogeessa fayyaa argadhu. Qorichi HIV ittisu (PEP) sa'aatii 72 keessatti jalqabamuu qaba. Qorichi ulfa ittisu kan yeroo tasaa hanga guyyaa 5tti hojjeta; yeroo dafee fudhatamu caalaatti hojjeta. Poolisiitti himuun filannoo kee ti. Embaasiin kee, iddoon baqannaa ykn dhaabbanni deeggarsaa si gargaaruu danda'u. Ati qofaa kee miti.

title.en: I want to go home before my contract ends. How?
title.am: ውሌ ሳያልቅ ወደ አገሬ መመለስ እፈልጋለሁ። እንዴት?
title.om: Waliigalteen koo osoo hin xumuramin gara biyyaatti deebi'uu barbaada. Akkamitti?

summary.en: You can ask for help to go home.
summary.am: ወደ አገርዎ ለመመለስ እርዳታ መጠየቅ ይችላሉ።
summary.om: Gara biyyaatti deebi'uuf gargaarsa gaafachuu dandeessa.

body.en: You can ask for help to go home. First, try to collect any wages you are owed and keep copies of your documents. Talk to your agency and your employer if it is safe. Your embassy can advise you and, if your passport is not with you, may help with a travel document. The rules on who pays the ticket are different in each country; see your country's rights page. Read 'Preparing to return' before you leave.
body.am: ወደ አገርዎ ለመመለስ እርዳታ መጠየቅ ይችላሉ። በመጀመሪያ ያልተከፈለዎትን ደሞዝ ለመቀበል ይሞክሩ፣ የሰነዶችዎን ቅጂ ያስቀምጡ። ደኅንነቱ ከተጠበቀ ከኤጀንሲዎና ከአሰሪዎ ጋር ይነጋገሩ። ኤምባሲዎ ምክር ሊሰጥዎ ይችላል፤ ፓስፖርትዎ ከእርስዎ ጋር ካልሆነም የጉዞ ሰነድ ለማግኘት ሊረዳዎ ይችላል። ትኬቱን ማን እንደሚከፍል ደንቡ በየአገሩ ይለያያል፤ የአገርዎን የመብት ገጽ ይመልከቱ። ከመሄድዎ በፊት «ለመመለስ መዘጋጀት»ን ያንብቡ።
body.om: Gara biyyaatti deebi'uuf gargaarsa gaafachuu dandeessa. Jalqaba mindaa siif hin kaffalamne argachuuf yaali, garagalcha sanadoota keetii kuusi. Yoo nagaa ta'e ejensii fi hojjechiisaa kee wajjin haasa'i. Embaasiin kee gorsa siif kennuu danda'a; paaspoortiin kee si bira yoo hin jirre, sanada imalaa argachuuf si gargaaruu danda'a. Tikeetii eenyu akka kaffalu seerri biyyaa biyyatti adda; fuula mirgaa biyya keetii ilaali. Osoo hin deemin dura 'Deebi'uuf qophaa'uu' dubbisi.

title.en: My job or salary is different from what my contract says. What can I do?
title.am: ሥራዬ ወይም ደሞዜ በውሌ ከተጻፈው የተለየ ነው። ምን ማድረግ እችላለሁ?
title.om: Hojiin koo ykn mindaan koo waan waliigaltee koo keessatti barreeffame irraa adda. Maal gochuu danda'a?

summary.en: Your signed contract is what counts.
summary.am: የሚቆጠረው የፈረሙት ውል ነው።
summary.om: Kan lakkaa'amu waliigaltee mallatteessite dha.

body.en: Your signed contract is what counts. Keep a photo of the contract you signed in Ethiopia. Write down how your real job and pay are different, with dates, in your private log. Tell your agency, both the one in Ethiopia and the one in the destination country. If it is not fixed, you can complain to the labour ministry or ask your embassy. See your country's rights page for how.
body.am: የሚቆጠረው የፈረሙት ውል ነው። በኢትዮጵያ የፈረሙትን ውል ፎቶ ያስቀምጡ። እውነተኛው ሥራዎና ክፍያዎ እንዴት እንደሚለይ ከቀን ጋር በግል ማስታወሻዎ ይጻፉ። በኢትዮጵያና በመዳረሻ አገሩ ያሉትን ሁለቱንም ኤጀንሲዎች ያሳውቁ። ካልተስተካከለ ለሠራተኛ ሚኒስቴር ማመልከት ወይም ኤምባሲዎን መጠየቅ ይችላሉ። እንዴት እንደሆነ የአገርዎን የመብት ገጽ ይመልከቱ።
body.om: Kan lakkaa'amu waliigaltee mallatteessite dha. Suuraa waliigaltee Itoophiyaatti mallatteessite kuusi. Hojiin fi mindaan kee dhugaa akkamitti akka adda ta'e, guyyaa wajjin galmee dhuunfaa keessatti barreessi. Ejensii Itoophiyaa fi kan biyya itti deemteetii lamaanuu beeksisi. Yoo hin sirreeffamne, ministeera hojjettootaatti komii dhiyeessuu ykn embaasii kee gaafachuu dandeessa. Akkamitti akka ta'e fuula mirgaa biyya keetii ilaali.

title.en: I think I am pregnant. I am scared. What should I do?
title.am: እርጉዝ የሆንኩ ይመስለኛል። ፈርቻለሁ። ምን ማድረግ አለብኝ?
title.om: Ulfa kan qabu natti fakkaata. Nan sodaadha. Maal gochuu qaba?

summary.en: It is normal to feel scared.
summary.am: መፍራት የተለመደ ነው።
summary.om: Sodaachuun waan baramaa dha.

body.en: It is normal to feel scared. You are not alone, and you deserve care without judgement. In some of these countries, pregnancy outside marriage can bring legal problems, so get confidential advice before you tell people you do not trust. Your embassy, IOM or a support organisation in Help numbers can advise you. See a doctor for a pregnancy check. Do not take pills or treatments from unknown sellers; they can be very dangerous. If you have heavy bleeding, strong belly pain or fever, call the ambulance number now.
body.am: መፍራት የተለመደ ነው። ብቻዎን አይደሉም፤ ያለ ፍርድ እንክብካቤ ይገባዎታል። በአንዳንዶቹ በእነዚህ አገሮች ከጋብቻ ውጭ እርግዝና የሕግ ችግር ሊያመጣ ስለሚችል ለማያምኗቸው ሰዎች ከመናገርዎ በፊት ሚስጥራዊ ምክር ያግኙ። ኤምባሲዎ፣ IOM ወይም በ«የእርዳታ ቁጥሮች» ያለ የድጋፍ ድርጅት ሊመክርዎ ይችላል። ለእርግዝና ምርመራ ሐኪም ያግኙ። ከማያውቋቸው ሻጮች ኪኒን ወይም ሕክምና አይውሰዱ፤ በጣም አደገኛ ሊሆን ይችላል። ብዙ ደም ቢፈስ፣ ከባድ የሆድ ሕመም ወይም ትኩሳት ቢኖርዎ አሁኑኑ የአምቡላንስ ቁጥር ይደውሉ።
body.om: Sodaachuun waan baramaa dha. Ati qofaa kee miti; murtii malee kunuunsi siif mala. Biyyoota kanneen keessaa tokko tokkotti ulfi gaa'ela alaa rakkoo seeraa fiduu waan danda'uuf, namoota hin amanneetti osoo hin himin dura gorsa iccitii argadhu. Embaasiin kee, IOM ykn dhaabbanni deeggarsaa 'Lakkoofsota Gargaarsaa' keessa jiru si gorsuu danda'u. Qorannoo ulfaatiif ogeessa fayyaa argadhu. Kiniinii ykn yaala gurgurtoota hin beekne irraa hin fudhatin; baay'ee balaafamaa ta'uu danda'a. Yoo dhiigni baay'een si irraa dhangala'e, garaan si dhukkube ykn ho'i qaama si qabe, amma lakkoofsa ambulaansii bilbili.

title.en: How can I avoid getting pregnant while I work abroad?
title.am: ውጭ አገር እየሠራሁ እርግዝናን እንዴት መከላከል እችላለሁ?
title.om: Biyya alaatti osoon hojjechaa jiruu akkamitti ulfa ittisuu danda'a?

summary.en: This is your choice and your body.
summary.am: ይህ የእርስዎ ምርጫና የእርስዎ ሰውነት ነው።
summary.om: Kun filannoo kee fi qaama kee ti.

body.en: This is your choice and your body. Long-acting methods such as an implant, an injection or an IUD are easiest to start in Ethiopia before you leave, at a health centre or family planning clinic. Condoms also protect against HIV and other infections. If you had sex without protection, emergency contraception works up to 5 days after, best as soon as possible. Ask a health worker which method suits you.
body.am: ይህ የእርስዎ ምርጫና የእርስዎ ሰውነት ነው። እንደ ኢምፕላንት፣ መርፌ ወይም IUD ያሉ ረጅም ጊዜ የሚቆዩ ዘዴዎችን ከመሄድዎ በፊት በኢትዮጵያ በጤና ጣቢያ ወይም በቤተሰብ ዕቅድ ክሊኒክ መጀመር ቀላል ነው። ኮንዶም ከኤች አይ ቪና ከሌሎች በሽታዎችም ይከላከላል። ያለ መከላከያ ወሲብ ከፈጸሙ፣ የድንገተኛ ጊዜ መከላከያ እስከ 5 ቀን ይሠራል፤ በተቻለ ፍጥነት ቢወሰድ ይሻላል። የትኛው ዘዴ እንደሚስማማዎ የጤና ባለሙያ ይጠይቁ።
body.om: Kun filannoo kee fi qaama kee ti. Malli yeroo dheeraa turu kan akka impilaantii, lilmoo ykn IUD, osoo hin deemin dura Itoophiyaatti buufata fayyaa ykn kilinika karoora maatii keessatti jalqabuun salphaa dha. Kondoomiin HIV fi dhukkuboota biroo irraas ni eega. Yoo eegumsa malee wal-qunnamtii saalaa raawwatte, qorichi ulfa ittisu kan yeroo tasaa hanga guyyaa 5tti hojjeta; hamma danda'ametti dafee fudhachuu wayya. Mala kamtu siif akka ta'u hojjetaa fayyaa gaafadhu.

title.en: I feel very lonely and sad all the time. Is something wrong with me?
title.am: ሁልጊዜ በጣም ብቸኝነትና ሐዘን ይሰማኛል። የሆነ ችግር አለብኝ?
title.om: Yeroo hunda kophummaa fi gadda guddaa natti dhaga'ama. Wanti na mudate jiraa?

summary.en: Nothing is wrong with you.
summary.am: ምንም ችግር የለብዎትም።
summary.om: Homtuu si hin mudanne.

body.en: Nothing is wrong with you. Being far from home, working hard and feeling alone is very heavy, and many women feel this way. Small things can help: a short call or message to someone you love, prayer, slow breathing, a little routine each day, and sleep when you can. Use the mood check-in in DadaLink. If the sadness does not go away, or you cannot eat or sleep, please reach out to your embassy or a support organisation in Help numbers.
body.am: ምንም ችግር የለብዎትም። ከቤት ርቆ፣ ጠንክሮ እየሠሩ ብቸኝነት መሰማት በጣም ከባድ ነው፤ ብዙ ሴቶችም እንዲህ ይሰማቸዋል። ትናንሽ ነገሮች ይረዳሉ፤ ለሚወዱት ሰው አጭር ጥሪ ወይም መልእክት፣ ጸሎት፣ በቀስታ መተንፈስ፣ በየቀኑ ትንሽ ልማድ፣ እና በቻሉ ጊዜ እንቅልፍ። በDadaLink ያለውን የስሜት መከታተያ ይጠቀሙ። ሐዘኑ ካልሄደ ወይም መብላትና መተኛት ካልቻሉ፣ እባክዎ ኤምባሲዎን ወይም በ«የእርዳታ ቁጥሮች» ያለ የድጋፍ ድርጅት ያግኙ።
body.om: Homtuu si hin mudanne. Mana irraa fagaachuun, cimsanii hojjechuun fi kophummaan baay'ee ulfaata; dubartoonni baay'een akkasuma itti dhaga'ama. Wantoonni xixiqqoon ni gargaaru: nama jaallattuuf bilbila gabaabaa ykn ergaa, kadhannaa, suuta hafuura baafachuu, guyyaa guyyaan aadaa xiqqaa, fi yeroo dandeessutti hirriba. Hordoffii miiraa DadaLink keessa jiru fayyadami. Yoo gaddi sun hin deemne ykn nyaachuu fi rafuu dadhabde, maaloo embaasii kee ykn dhaabbata deeggarsaa 'Lakkoofsota Gargaarsaa' keessa jiru quunnamu.

title.en: I do not want to live anymore.
title.om: Lammata jiraachuu hin barbaadu.

summary.en: I am really glad you told me.
summary.am: ስለነገሩኝ በጣም ደስ ብሎኛል።
summary.om: Waan natti himteef baay'een gammade.

body.en: I am really glad you told me. You matter, and you deserve help right now. If you might hurt yourself soon, please press SOS or call the emergency number in Help numbers. Tell someone you trust how you feel today: a friend, family member or your embassy. Move away from anything you could use to hurt yourself. These feelings can change with support. You do not have to carry this alone.
body.am: ስለነገሩኝ በጣም ደስ ብሎኛል። እርስዎ አስፈላጊ ነዎት፤ አሁኑኑ እርዳታ ይገባዎታል። በቅርቡ ራስዎን ሊጎዱ የሚችሉ ከሆነ፣ እባክዎ SOS ይጫኑ ወይም በ«የእርዳታ ቁጥሮች» ያለውን የአደጋ ጊዜ ቁጥር ይደውሉ። ዛሬውኑ ለሚያምኑት ሰው የሚሰማዎትን ይንገሩ፤ ጓደኛ፣ ቤተሰብ ወይም ኤምባሲዎ። ራስዎን ለመጉዳት ሊጠቀሙበት ከሚችሉት ነገር ይራቁ። እነዚህ ስሜቶች በድጋፍ ሊለወጡ ይችላሉ። ይህንን ብቻዎን መሸከም የለብዎትም።
body.om: Waan natti himteef baay'een gammade. Ati barbaachisaa dha, amma gargaarsi siif mala. Yoo dhiyootti of miidhuu dandeessa ta'e, maaloo SOS tuqi ykn lakkoofsa balaa tasaa 'Lakkoofsota Gargaarsaa' keessa jiru bilbili. Har'uma waan sitti dhaga'amu nama amanattutti himi: hiriyaa, maatii ykn embaasii kee. Waan ittiin of miidhuu dandeessu irraa fagaadhu. Miirri kun deeggarsaan jijjiiramuu danda'a. Kana qofaa kee baachuu hin qabdu.

title.en: The agency is asking me for a lot of money. Is that allowed?
title.am: ኤጀንሲው ብዙ ገንዘብ እየጠየቀኝ ነው። ይህ ይፈቀዳል?
title.om: Ejensiin maallaqa baay'ee na gaafachaa jira. Kun hayyamamaadhaa?

summary.en: Be careful.
summary.am: ይጠንቀቁ።
summary.om: Of eeggadhu.

body.en: Be careful. Ethiopian law sets rules on what a licensed agency may charge a worker; see 'Money, fees and debt' and the Ethiopia rights page. Always ask for a written receipt for any payment. Do not borrow money from a broker to pay fees. If an agency asks for money that the rules do not allow, or will not give a receipt, report it to the Ministry of Labour and Skills.
body.am: ይጠንቀቁ። የኢትዮጵያ ሕግ ፈቃድ ያለው ኤጀንሲ ከሠራተኛ ምን ሊያስከፍል እንደሚችል ደንብ ያስቀምጣል፤ «ገንዘብ፣ ክፍያና ዕዳ»ን እና የኢትዮጵያን የመብት ገጽ ይመልከቱ። ለማንኛውም ክፍያ ሁልጊዜ የጽሑፍ ደረሰኝ ይጠይቁ። ክፍያ ለመክፈል ከደላላ ገንዘብ አይበደሩ። ኤጀንሲው ደንቡ የማይፈቅደውን ገንዘብ ከጠየቀ ወይም ደረሰኝ ካልሰጠ ለሥራና ክህሎት ሚኒስቴር ያሳውቁ።
body.om: Of eeggadhu. Seerri Itoophiyaa ejensiin hayyama qabu hojjetaa irraa maal kaffalchiisuu akka danda'u ni murteessa; 'Maallaqa, kaffaltii fi liqii' fi fuula mirgaa Itoophiyaa ilaali. Kaffaltii kamiifuu yeroo hunda nagahee barreeffamaa gaafadhu. Kaffaltii kaffaluuf delaalaa irraa maallaqa hin liqeeffatin. Yoo ejensiin maallaqa seerri hin hayyamne si gaafate ykn nagahee siif kennuu dide, Ministeera Hojii fi Ogummaatti himi.

title.en: A broker says he can send me abroad quickly without an agency. Is it safe?
title.am: አንድ ደላላ ያለ ኤጀንሲ በፍጥነት ወደ ውጭ ሊልከኝ እንደሚችል ይናገራል። ደኅንነቱ የተጠበቀ ነው?
title.om: Delaalaan tokko ejensii malee dafee biyya alaatti na erguu akka danda'u jedha. Nageenya qabaa?

summary.en: This is risky.
summary.am: ይህ አደገኛ ነው።
summary.om: Kun balaa qaba.

body.en: This is risky. Going through an unlicensed broker or an illegal route can lead to debt, abuse, trafficking or being stuck without papers, and you lose protections that come with a registered contract. Use only an agency licensed by Ethiopia's Ministry of Labour and Skills. Ask to see its licence and check it. Use the agency check in DadaLink, and read 'Licensed agencies vs brokers'.
body.am: ይህ አደገኛ ነው። ፈቃድ በሌለው ደላላ ወይም በሕገወጥ መንገድ መሄድ ወደ ዕዳ፣ ጥቃት፣ የሰዎች ዝውውር ወይም ያለ ሰነድ መቅረት ሊያደርስ ይችላል፤ በተመዘገበ ውል የሚገኘውን ጥበቃም ያጣሉ። በኢትዮጵያ ሥራና ክህሎት ሚኒስቴር ፈቃድ የተሰጠውን ኤጀንሲ ብቻ ይጠቀሙ። ፈቃዱን እንዲያሳይዎ ይጠይቁና ያረጋግጡ። በDadaLink ያለውን የኤጀንሲ ማረጋገጫ ይጠቀሙ፣ «ፈቃድ ያላቸው ኤጀንሲዎችና ደላሎች»ን ያንብቡ።
body.om: Kun balaa qaba. Delaalaa hayyama hin qabneen ykn karaa seeraan alaa deemuun gara liqii, miidhaa, daldala namootaa ykn sanada malee hafuutti geessuu danda'a; eegumsa waliigaltee galmaa'een dhufu ni dhabda. Ejensii Ministeera Hojii fi Ogummaa Itoophiyaatiin hayyama argate qofa fayyadami. Hayyama isaa akka si agarsiisu gaafadhuu mirkaneeffadhu. Mirkaneessa ejensii DadaLink keessa jiru fayyadami, 'Ejensiiwwan hayyama qaban fi delaalota' dubbisi.

title.en: How do I know if my agency is legal and licensed?
title.am: ኤጀንሲዬ ሕጋዊና ፈቃድ ያለው መሆኑን እንዴት ማወቅ እችላለሁ?
title.om: Ejensiin koo seeraan kan hojjetu fi hayyama kan qabu ta'uu isaa akkamiin beekuu danda'a?

summary.en: Under Ethiopia's Overseas Employment Proclamation No.
summary.am: በኢትዮጵያ የውጭ አገር ሥራ ስምሪት አዋጅ ቁጥር 1389/2025 መሠረት ለኤጀንሲዎች ፈቃድ የሚሰጠው የሥራና ክህሎት ሚኒስቴር ብቻ ነው፤ በሥራ ገበያ መረጃ ሥርዓት (LMIS) በኩል።
summary.om: Akka Labsii Hojii Biyya Alaa Itoophiyaa Lakk.

body.en: Under Ethiopia's Overseas Employment Proclamation No. 1389/2025, only the Ministry of Labour and Skills (MoLS) licenses agencies, through the Labour Market Information System (LMIS). A licence lasts one year and must be renewed every year. Before you pay or sign: ask to see the licence on the office wall and check the name, countries and date; ask MoLS or your regional labour office if the agency is licensed now (the number is in the help directory); and make sure you are registered in LMIS. A legal agency may not take any money or gifts from you for the job. If it does, report it to MoLS. Read 'Licensed agencies and illegal brokers'.
body.am: በኢትዮጵያ የውጭ አገር ሥራ ስምሪት አዋጅ ቁጥር 1389/2025 መሠረት ለኤጀንሲዎች ፈቃድ የሚሰጠው የሥራና ክህሎት ሚኒስቴር ብቻ ነው፤ በሥራ ገበያ መረጃ ሥርዓት (LMIS) በኩል። ፈቃድ የሚያገለግለው ለአንድ ዓመት ሲሆን በየዓመቱ መታደስ አለበት። ከመክፈልሽ ወይም ከመፈረምሽ በፊት፦ በቢሮው ግድግዳ ላይ ያለውን ፈቃድ እንዲያሳዩሽ ጠይቂና ስሙን፣ አገሮቹንና ቀኑን ተመልከቺ፤ ኤጀንሲው አሁን ፈቃድ እንዳለው ሚኒስቴሩን ወይም የክልልሽን የሥራ ቢሮ ጠይቂ (ስልክ ቁጥሩ በእርዳታ ማውጫው ውስጥ አለ)፤ በLMIS መመዝገብሽንም አረጋግጪ። ሕጋዊ ኤጀንሲ ለሥራው ከአንቺ ምንም ገንዘብ ወይም ስጦታ መቀበል የለበትም። ከተቀበለ ለሚኒስቴሩ አሳውቂ። «ፈቃድ ያላቸው ኤጀንሲዎችና ሕገ ወጥ ደላሎች»ን አንብቢ።
body.om: Akka Labsii Hojii Biyya Alaa Itoophiyaa Lakk. 1389/2025tti, ejansiiwwaniif hayyama kan kennu Ministeera Hojii fi Ogummaa (MoLS) qofa, Sirna Odeeffannoo Gabaa Hojii (LMIS) keessaan. Hayyamni waggaa tokkoof hojjeta, waggaa waggaanis haaromfamuu qaba. Osoo hin kaffalin ykn hin mallatteessin dura: hayyama keenyan waajjiraa irra jiru akka si agarsiisan gaafadhuu maqaa, biyyoota fi guyyaa isaa ilaali; ejansichi amma hayyama qabaachuu isaa Ministeerichaa ykn waajjira hojii naannoo kee gaafadhu (lakkoofsi isaa galmee gargaarsaa keessa jira); LMIS keessatti galmaa'uu kees mirkaneeffadhu. Ejansiin seeraan hojjetu hojii kanaaf maallaqa ykn kennaa kamiyyuu si irraa fudhachuu hin qabu. Yoo fudhate, Ministeerichatti gabaasi. 'Ejansiiwwan hayyama qaban fi deelaalota seeraan alaa' dubbisi.

title.en: Which documents should I copy before I leave?
title.am: ከመሄዴ በፊት የትኞቹን ሰነዶች መቅዳት አለብኝ?
title.om: Osoon hin deemin dura sanadoota kamii garagalchuu qaba?

summary.en: Take clear photos of your passport, visa, signed contract, Ethiopian ID, the agency's name and licence, and your employer's name, address and phone.
summary.am: የፓስፖርትዎን፣ የቪዛዎን፣ የፈረሙትን ውል፣ የኢትዮጵያ መታወቂያዎን፣ የኤጀንሲውን ስምና ፈቃድ፣ እንዲሁም የአሰሪዎን ስም፣ አድራሻና ስልክ ግልጽ ፎቶ ያንሱ።
summary.om: Suuraa ifaa paaspoortii, viizaa, waliigaltee mallatteessite, waraqaa eenyummaa Itoophiyaa, maqaa fi hayyama ejensii, akkasumas maqaa, teessoo fi bilbila hojjechiisaa keetii kaasi.

body.en: Take clear photos of your passport, visa, signed contract, Ethiopian ID, the agency's name and licence, and your employer's name, address and phone. Keep them in a safe place on your phone, and give copies to someone you trust at home. Also write the most important numbers on paper, in case your phone is taken. Never hand over your original documents to a broker.
body.am: የፓስፖርትዎን፣ የቪዛዎን፣ የፈረሙትን ውል፣ የኢትዮጵያ መታወቂያዎን፣ የኤጀንሲውን ስምና ፈቃድ፣ እንዲሁም የአሰሪዎን ስም፣ አድራሻና ስልክ ግልጽ ፎቶ ያንሱ። በስልክዎ ደኅንነቱ የተጠበቀ ቦታ ያስቀምጡ፤ ቅጂዎችን በቤት ላለ ለሚያምኑት ሰው ይስጡ። ስልክዎ ቢወሰድ እንዲረዳ በጣም አስፈላጊ ቁጥሮችን በወረቀት ላይም ይጻፉ። ዋና ሰነዶችዎን ለደላላ በጭራሽ አይስጡ።
body.om: Suuraa ifaa paaspoortii, viizaa, waliigaltee mallatteessite, waraqaa eenyummaa Itoophiyaa, maqaa fi hayyama ejensii, akkasumas maqaa, teessoo fi bilbila hojjechiisaa keetii kaasi. Bilbila kee irratti bakka nagaa kaa'i, garagalchaa nama mana jiru kan amanattuuf kenni. Yoo bilbilli kee fudhatame jedhee lakkoofsota baay'ee barbaachisoo waraqaa irrattis barreessi. Sanadoota kee jalqabaa delaalaaf gonkumaa hin kennin.

title.en: How do I contact the Ethiopian embassy, and what can they do?
title.am: የኢትዮጵያ ኤምባሲን እንዴት ማግኘት እችላለሁ? ምንስ ሊያደርጉልኝ ይችላሉ?
title.om: Embaasii Itoophiyaa akkamitti quunnamuu danda'a, maal naaf gochuu danda'u?

summary.en: The embassy and consulate numbers for your country are in Help numbers in DadaLink.
summary.am: የአገርዎ የኤምባሲና የቆንስላ ቁጥሮች በDadaLink «የእርዳታ ቁጥሮች» ውስጥ አሉ።
summary.om: Lakkoofsonni embaasii fi koonsilaa biyya keetii DadaLink keessatti 'Lakkoofsota Gargaarsaa' keessa jiru.

body.en: The embassy and consulate numbers for your country are in Help numbers in DadaLink. They work offline, so save them now. When you call, say your full name, passport number if you know it, your employer's name and city, and what help you need. The embassy can give advice, contact authorities, help with travel documents and, in some cases, help you get to a shelter or go home. It cannot always solve everything quickly, so also keep your own records.
body.am: የአገርዎ የኤምባሲና የቆንስላ ቁጥሮች በDadaLink «የእርዳታ ቁጥሮች» ውስጥ አሉ። ያለ ኢንተርኔት ይሠራሉ፤ አሁኑኑ ያስቀምጧቸው። ሲደውሉ ሙሉ ስምዎን፣ ካወቁት የፓስፖርት ቁጥርዎን፣ የአሰሪዎን ስምና ከተማ እንዲሁም ምን እርዳታ እንደሚፈልጉ ይናገሩ። ኤምባሲው ምክር ሊሰጥ፣ ባለሥልጣናትን ሊያገኝ፣ በጉዞ ሰነድ ሊረዳ፣ አንዳንድ ጊዜም ወደ መጠለያ ወይም ወደ አገር እንዲሄዱ ሊረዳ ይችላል። ሁሉንም ነገር ሁልጊዜ በፍጥነት ላይፈታ ስለሚችል የራስዎን መዝገብም ይያዙ።
body.om: Lakkoofsonni embaasii fi koonsilaa biyya keetii DadaLink keessatti 'Lakkoofsota Gargaarsaa' keessa jiru. Interneetii malee hojjetu; amma kuusi. Yeroo bilbiltu maqaa kee guutuu, yoo beekte lakkoofsa paaspoortii, maqaa fi magaalaa hojjechiisaa keetii, akkasumas gargaarsa maalii akka barbaaddu himi. Embaasiin gorsa kennuu, abbootii taayitaa quunnamuu, sanada imalaatiin gargaaruu, yeroo tokko tokkos iddoo baqannaa ykn biyyatti akka deebitu si gargaaruu danda'a. Yeroo hunda waan hunda dafee furuu dhiisuu waan danda'uuf galmee mataa keetiis qabadhu.

title.en: If I leave my employer's house, will I be in trouble with the law?
title.am: የአሰሪዬን ቤት ጥዬ ብወጣ በሕግ ችግር ውስጥ እገባለሁ?
title.om: Yoon mana hojjechiisaa koo dhiisee bahe, rakkoo seeraa keessa nan seenaa?

summary.en: It can be risky.
summary.am: አደጋ ሊኖረው ይችላል።
summary.om: Balaa qabaachuu danda'a.

body.en: It can be risky. In several of these countries an employer can report a worker as 'absent' or 'absconded', and this can affect your legal status, so it is safer to get help before you leave if you can. Contact the labour ministry, your embassy or a shelter from Help numbers. If you are in danger, your safety comes first: press SOS or call emergency. Take your phone and copies of documents. Do not go with strangers who promise jobs.
body.am: አደጋ ሊኖረው ይችላል። በብዙዎቹ በእነዚህ አገሮች አሰሪ ሠራተኛውን «ጠፍቷል» ወይም «አምልጧል» ብሎ ሪፖርት ማድረግ ይችላል፤ ይህ የሕግ ሁኔታዎን ሊነካ ስለሚችል ከቻሉ ከመውጣትዎ በፊት እርዳታ ማግኘት ይሻላል። ሠራተኛ ሚኒስቴርን፣ ኤምባሲዎን ወይም መጠለያን ከ«የእርዳታ ቁጥሮች» ያግኙ። አደጋ ላይ ከሆኑ ደኅንነትዎ ይቀድማል፤ SOS ይጫኑ ወይም የአደጋ ጊዜ ቁጥር ይደውሉ። ስልክዎንና የሰነድ ቅጂዎችን ይያዙ። ሥራ ከሚያስገቡ ከማያውቋቸው ሰዎች ጋር አይሂዱ።
body.om: Balaa qabaachuu danda'a. Biyyoota kanneen keessaa hedduu keessatti hojjechiisaan hojjetaa 'hin argamne' ykn 'baqate' jedhee gabaasuu danda'a; kun haala seeraa kee tuquu waan danda'uuf, yoo dandeesse osoo hin bahin dura gargaarsa argachuu wayya. Ministeera hojjettootaa, embaasii kee ykn iddoo baqannaa 'Lakkoofsota Gargaarsaa' irraa quunnamu. Yoo balaa keessa jirta, nageenyi kee dursa: SOS tuqi ykn lakkoofsa balaa tasaa bilbili. Bilbila kee fi garagalcha sanadootaa qabadhu. Namoota hin beekne kan hojii siif waadaa galan wajjin hin deemin.

title.en: Can I change to a different employer?
title.om: Gara hojjechiisaa biraatti jijjiiramuu nan danda'aa?

summary.en: Sometimes, yes, but the rules are very different in each country and often need the labour ministry, the employer or the agency to agree.
summary.am: አንዳንድ ጊዜ ይቻላል፤ ደንቦቹ ግን በየአገሩ በጣም ይለያያሉ፤ ብዙ ጊዜም የሠራተኛ ሚኒስቴር፣ የአሰሪው ወይም የኤጀንሲው ስምምነት ያስፈልጋል።
summary.om: Yeroo tokko tokko ni danda'ama, garuu seerri biyyaa biyyatti baay'ee adda; yeroo baay'ee walii galtee ministeera hojjettootaa, hojjechiisaa ykn ejensii barbaada.

body.en: Sometimes, yes, but the rules are very different in each country and often need the labour ministry, the employer or the agency to agree. Some countries allow a transfer in cases such as unpaid wages or abuse. Check your country's rights page, and ask the labour ministry or your embassy before you act. Keep records of any problems in your private log; they can support your request.
body.am: አንዳንድ ጊዜ ይቻላል፤ ደንቦቹ ግን በየአገሩ በጣም ይለያያሉ፤ ብዙ ጊዜም የሠራተኛ ሚኒስቴር፣ የአሰሪው ወይም የኤጀንሲው ስምምነት ያስፈልጋል። አንዳንድ አገሮች ደሞዝ ሳይከፈል ሲቀር ወይም ጥቃት ሲኖር ዝውውር ይፈቅዳሉ። የአገርዎን የመብት ገጽ ይመልከቱ፤ እርምጃ ከመውሰድዎ በፊት ሠራተኛ ሚኒስቴርን ወይም ኤምባሲዎን ይጠይቁ። ማንኛውንም ችግር በግል ማስታወሻዎ ይመዝግቡ፤ ጥያቄዎን ሊደግፍ ይችላል።
body.om: Yeroo tokko tokko ni danda'ama, garuu seerri biyyaa biyyatti baay'ee adda; yeroo baay'ee walii galtee ministeera hojjettootaa, hojjechiisaa ykn ejensii barbaada. Biyyoonni tokko tokko yeroo mindaan hin kaffalamne ykn miidhaan jiru jijjiirraa ni hayyamu. Fuula mirgaa biyya keetii ilaali, osoo tarkaanfii hin fudhatin dura ministeera hojjettootaa ykn embaasii kee gaafadhu. Rakkoo kamiyyuu galmee dhuunfaa keessatti galmeessi; gaaffii kee deeggaruu danda'a.

title.en: I was arrested or I am in a deportation centre. What are my rights?
title.am: ታስሬያለሁ ወይም በማባረሪያ ማዕከል ውስጥ ነኝ። መብቶቼ ምንድን ናቸው?
title.om: Hidhameera ykn giddugala baasiinsaa keessa jira. Mirgoonni koo maal fa'i?

summary.en: You can ask to contact the Ethiopian embassy or consulate.
summary.am: የኢትዮጵያ ኤምባሲን ወይም ቆንስላን ለማግኘት መጠየቅ ይችላሉ።
summary.om: Embaasii ykn koonsilaa Itoophiyaa quunnamuuf gaafachuu dandeessa.

body.en: You can ask to contact the Ethiopian embassy or consulate. Tell officials your full name and that you are Ethiopian. Ask for medical care if you are sick, pregnant or injured. Do not sign papers you do not understand; ask for an interpreter. If you have unpaid wages, tell the embassy so it can be recorded. Read 'Detention and deportation' for more.
body.am: የኢትዮጵያ ኤምባሲን ወይም ቆንስላን ለማግኘት መጠየቅ ይችላሉ። ለባለሥልጣናት ሙሉ ስምዎንና ኢትዮጵያዊት መሆንዎን ይንገሩ። ከታመሙ፣ እርጉዝ ከሆኑ ወይም ከተጎዱ ሕክምና ይጠይቁ። የማይረዱትን ወረቀት አይፈርሙ፤ አስተርጓሚ ይጠይቁ። ያልተከፈለ ደሞዝ ካለዎት እንዲመዘገብ ለኤምባሲው ይንገሩ። ለበለጠ «እስርና ማባረር»ን ያንብቡ።
body.om: Embaasii ykn koonsilaa Itoophiyaa quunnamuuf gaafachuu dandeessa. Abbootii taayitaatti maqaa kee guutuu fi Itoophiyaawittii ta'uu kee himi. Yoo dhukkubsatte, ulfa qabaatte ykn miidhamte yaala fayyaa gaafadhu. Waraqaa hin hubanne hin mallatteessin; hiikaa gaafadhu. Yoo mindaa hin kaffalamne qabaatte, akka galmeeffamuuf embaasiitti himi. Dabalataaf 'Hidhaa fi baasiinsa' dubbisi.

title.en: I came home but my employer still owes me money. Can I still get it?
title.am: ወደ አገሬ ተመልሻለሁ፤ ግን አሰሪዬ አሁንም ገንዘብ አለብኝ። አሁንም ማግኘት እችላለሁ?
title.om: Gara biyyaatti deebi'eera, garuu hojjechiisaan koo ammallee maallaqa na qaba. Ammallee argachuu nan danda'aa?

summary.en: It is harder after you return, but sometimes possible.
summary.am: ከተመለሱ በኋላ ከባድ ነው፤ አንዳንድ ጊዜ ግን ይቻላል።
summary.om: Erga deebitee booda ulfaataa dha, garuu yeroo tokko tokko ni danda'ama.

body.en: It is harder after you return, but sometimes possible. Gather your proof: contract, wage records from your private log, messages and bank slips. Contact the agency that sent you, and the Ministry of Labour and Skills. You can also ask the embassy in the country where you worked about a claim. Read 'Claiming unpaid wages after return' for the steps.
body.am: ከተመለሱ በኋላ ከባድ ነው፤ አንዳንድ ጊዜ ግን ይቻላል። ማስረጃዎን ያሰባስቡ፤ ውል፣ ከግል ማስታወሻዎ የደሞዝ መዝገብ፣ መልእክቶችና የባንክ ደረሰኞች። የላከዎትን ኤጀንሲና የሥራና ክህሎት ሚኒስቴርን ያግኙ። በሠሩበት አገር ያለውን ኤምባሲም ስለ አቤቱታ መጠየቅ ይችላሉ። ደረጃዎቹን «ከተመለሱ በኋላ ያልተከፈለ ደሞዝ መጠየቅ» ውስጥ ያንብቡ።
body.om: Erga deebitee booda ulfaataa dha, garuu yeroo tokko tokko ni danda'ama. Ragaa kee walitti qabi: waliigaltee, galmee mindaa galmee dhuunfaa keessaa, ergaawwan fi nagahee baankii. Ejensii si erge fi Ministeera Hojii fi Ogummaa quunnamu. Embaasii biyya itti hojjette keessa jiru waa'ee komii gaafachuus dandeessa. Tarkaanfiiwwan 'Mindaa hin kaffalamne erga deebi'anii booda gaafachuu' keessatti dubbisi.

title.en: I just came back and I feel lost. Where can I get support?
title.am: አሁን ተመልሻለሁ፤ ግራ ተጋብቻለሁ። ድጋፍ ከየት ማግኘት እችላለሁ?
title.om: Amma deebi'e, burjaaja'eera. Deeggarsa eessaa argachuu danda'a?

summary.en: Coming home can be hard, even when you are glad to be back.
summary.am: ወደ ቤት መመለስ ቢያስደስትም ከባድ ሊሆን ይችላል።
summary.om: Gara manaatti deebi'uun, yeroo itti gammaddellee, ulfaachuu danda'a.

body.en: Coming home can be hard, even when you are glad to be back. Feeling tired, sad, angry or worried is a normal reaction. You can look for returnee services, health and mental-health support in Help numbers (Ethiopia). Some organisations help with shelter, counselling, skills training and small business support. Take things one step at a time, and talk to someone you trust.
body.am: ወደ ቤት መመለስ ቢያስደስትም ከባድ ሊሆን ይችላል። ድካም፣ ሐዘን፣ ቁጣ ወይም ጭንቀት መሰማት የተለመደ ምላሽ ነው። የተመላሾች አገልግሎቶችን፣ የጤናና የአእምሮ ጤና ድጋፍ በ«የእርዳታ ቁጥሮች» (ኢትዮጵያ) ውስጥ መፈለግ ይችላሉ። አንዳንድ ድርጅቶች በመጠለያ፣ በምክር፣ በክህሎት ስልጠናና በአነስተኛ ንግድ ድጋፍ ይረዳሉ። ነገሮችን ደረጃ በደረጃ ይውሰዱ፤ ከሚያምኑት ሰው ጋር ይነጋገሩ።
body.om: Gara manaatti deebi'uun, yeroo itti gammaddellee, ulfaachuu danda'a. Dadhabbiin, gaddi, aariin ykn yaaddoon sitti dhaga'amuun deebii baramaa dha. Tajaajila deebi'ootaa, deeggarsa fayyaa fi fayyaa sammuu 'Lakkoofsota Gargaarsaa' (Itoophiyaa) keessatti barbaaduu dandeessa. Dhaabbileen tokko tokko iddoo baqannaa, gorsa, leenjii ogummaa fi deeggarsa daldala xiqqaatiin gargaaru. Wantoota tarkaanfii tarkaanfiin fudhadhu, nama amanattu wajjin haasa'i.
